ex.cn: 她最近的一部小说受到评论家的猛烈批评。

senses.def: behaviour that is very cruel and violent

ex.en: The police were shocked by the savagery of the attacks.
ex.cn: 警方对这些惨无人道的袭击感到震惊。

senses.def: a wide flat open area of land, especially in Africa, that is covered with grass but has few trees
senses.chn: 萨瓦纳（尤指非洲的稀树草原）

senses.def: a person with great knowledge and ability
a person who is less intelligent than others but who has particular unusual abilities that other people do not have
senses.chn: 独通一行的人；独开一窍的人

senses.def: to keep sb/sth safe from death, harm, loss, etc.

ex.en: to save sb's life
ex.cn: 救某人的命

ex.en: Doctors were unable to save her.
ex.cn: 医生未能把她救活。

ex.en: He's trying to save their marriage.
ex.cn: 他试图挽救他们的婚姻。

ex.en: She needs to win the next two games to save the match.
ex.cn: 只有下面的两场获胜，她才能挽回败局。

ex.en: Thanks for doing that. You saved my life (= helped me a lot).
ex.cn: 谢谢你这么做。你帮了我大忙。

ex.en: to save a rare species (from extinction)
ex.cn: 拯救珍稀物种（免于灭绝）

senses.def: to keep money instead of spending it, especially in order to buy a particular thing

ex.en: I'm not very good at saving.
ex.cn: 我不大攒得住钱。

ex.en: I'm saving for a new bike.
ex.cn: 我正攒钱想买辆新自行车。

ex.en: We've been saving up to go to Australia.
ex.cn: 我们一直在攒钱，打算去澳大利亚。

ex.en: You should save a little each week.
ex.cn: 你应该每星期存一点钱。

ex.en: I've saved almost £100 so far.
ex.cn: 我至今已经攒了差不多 100 英镑了。

ex.en: I'm saving for a new car.
ex.cn: 我正攒钱想买辆新车。

senses.def: to collect sth because you like it or for a special purpose

ex.en: I've been saving theatre programmes for years.
ex.cn: 我收藏剧院的节目单已有多年了。

ex.en: If you save ten tokens you can get a T-shirt.
ex.cn: 积十张礼品券便可得到一件 T 恤衫。

senses.def: to keep sth to use or enjoy in the future

ex.en: He's saving his strength for the last part of the race.
ex.cn: 他保存体力，以便在比赛的最后阶段发力。

ex.en: We'll eat some now and save some for tomorrow.
ex.cn: 我们现在吃一些，留一些明天吃。

ex.en: Save some food for me.
ex.cn: 给我留点吃的。

ex.en: Save me some food.
ex.cn: 给我留点吃的。

senses.def: to avoid wasting sth or using more than necessary

ex.en: We'll take a cab to save time.
ex.cn: 我们坐出租车，好节省时间。

ex.en: Book early and save £50!
ex.cn: 及早订票，可省 50 英镑！

ex.en: We should try to save water.
ex.cn: 我们应设法节约用水。

ex.en: The government is trying to save £1 million on defence.
ex.cn: 政府力图在国防开支上节约 100 万英镑。

ex.en: If we go this way it will save us two hours on the trip.
ex.cn: 如果走这条路，可以缩短两小时的行程。

ex.en: I save on fares by walking to work.
ex.cn: 我步行上班，可以省车钱。

senses.def: to avoid doing sth difficult or unpleasant; to make sb able to avoid doing sth difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: 避免，免得（出现困难或不愉快的事）

ex.en: The prize money saved her from having to find a job.
ex.cn: 这笔奖金使她不用非得找工作。

ex.en: She did it herself to save argument.
ex.cn: 她自己去做了，以免发生争论。

ex.en: Thanks for sending that letter for me—it saved me a trip.
ex.cn: 多谢你替我把那封信寄了，省得我跑一趟。

ex.en: He's grown a beard to save shaving.
ex.cn: 他留起了胡子，省得再刮脸。

ex.en: If you phone for an appointment, it'll save you waiting.
ex.cn: 如果电话预约，你就免得等了。

senses.def: to prevent an opponent's shot from going in the goal

ex.en: to save a penalty
ex.cn: 扑出一个点球

ex.en: The goalie saved Johnson's long-range shot.
ex.cn: 守门员扑出了约翰逊的远射。

ex.en: The goalie saved brilliantly from Johnson's long-range shot.
ex.cn: 守门员漂亮地扑挡了约翰逊的远射。

senses.def: to make a computer keep work, for example by putting it on a disk

ex.en: Save data frequently.
ex.cn: 资料要经常存盘。

senses.def: to be completely unable to do sth
senses.chn: 完全干不了某事；死也做不了某事

ex.en: He can't interview people to save his life.
ex.cn: 要他的命，他也采访不了人。

senses.def: to rescue sb from a very difficult situation
to prevent failure or defeat, when this seems certain to happen

ex.en: Gerrard's late goal saved the day for Liverpool.
ex.cn: 杰拉德后来的进球为利物浦队挽回了败局。

senses.def: to avoid or help sb avoid embarrassment

ex.en: She was fired, but she saved face by telling everyone she'd resigned.
ex.cn: 她被解雇了，但她爱面子，逢人便说是她辞职了。

senses.def: used to tell sb that it is not worth wasting time and effort saying sth because it will not change anything

ex.en: Save your breath—you'll never persuade her.
ex.cn: 不用白费口舌了，你永远说服不了她。

senses.def: to try to avoid death, punishment, etc., especially by leaving others in an extremely difficult situation
senses.chn: （尤指不惜置他人于困境而）保全自己的性命，使自己免受惩罚

ex.en: To save his own skin, he lied and blamed the accident on his friend.
ex.cn: 为了自保，他竟然说谎，把事故的责任推到朋友身上。

senses.def: an action by the goalkeeper that stops a goal being scored

ex.en: He made a spectacular save.
ex.cn: 他那扑救的动作令人叹为观止。

senses.def: except sth

ex.en: They knew nothing about her save her name.
ex.cn: 除名字外，他们对她一无所知。

senses.def: except

ex.en: They found out nothing more save that she had borne a child.
ex.cn: 他们只查到她生过一个孩子，其他情况一无所知。

example.en: to save sb's life
example.cn: 救某人的命

example.en: to save a rare species (from extinction)
example.cn: 拯救珍稀物种（免于灭绝）

example.en: She saved a little girl from falling into the water.
example.cn: 她救下一个眼看要落入水中的小女孩。

example.en: I'm saving for a new bike.
example.cn: 我正攒钱想买辆新自行车。

example.en: You should save a little each week.
example.cn: 你应该每星期存一点钱。

example.en: He's saving his strength for the last part of the race.
example.cn: 他保存体力，以便在比赛的最后阶段发力。

example.en: Save me some food.
example.cn: 给我留点吃的。

example.en: The government is trying to save £1 million on defence.
example.cn: 政府力图在国防开支上节约 100 万英镑。

example.en: If we go this way it will save us two hours on the trip.
example.cn: 如果走这条路，可以缩短两小时的行程。

example.en: I save on fares by walking to work.
example.cn: 我步行上班，可以省车钱。

example.en: The prize money saved her from having to find a job.
example.cn: 这笔奖金使她不用非得找工作。

example.en: He's grown a beard to save shaving.
example.cn: 他留起了胡子，省得再刮脸。

example.en: If you phone for an appointment, it'll save you waiting.
example.cn: 如果电话预约，你就免得等了。

senses.def: a person who saves money and puts it in a bank, etc. for future use
something that helps you spend less money or use less of the thing mentioned

ex.en: a money/time saver
ex.cn: 省钱／省时的事物

senses.def: used to tell sb that it is not worth wasting time and effort saying sth because it will not change anything

ex.en: Save your breath—you'll never persuade her.
ex.cn: 不用白费口舌了，你永远说服不了她。

senses.def: a street in London, England with many shops/stores that sell expensive clothes for men that are often specially made for each person
senses.chn: 萨维尔街，裁缝街（英国伦敦的一条街道，聚集了售卖高档定制男装的店铺）

ex.en: He was wearing a Savile Row suit.
ex.cn: 他穿着在伦敦裁缝街定制的西装。

senses.def: an amount of sth such as time or money that you do not need to use or spend

ex.en: Buy three and make a saving of 55p.
ex.cn: 买三件就能节省 55 便士。

ex.en: With the new boiler you can make big savings on fuel bills.
ex.cn: 用这种新锅炉，能省一大笔燃料开销。

senses.def: money that you have saved, especially in a bank, etc.

ex.en: He put all his savings into buying a boat.
ex.cn: 他用全部积蓄买了一条船。

ex.en: I opened a savings account at my local bank.
ex.cn: 我在本地银行开了一个储蓄账户。

senses.def: that prevents the waste of the thing mentioned or stops it from being necessary

ex.en: energy-saving modifications
ex.cn: 节能改装

ex.en: labour-saving devices
ex.cn: 节省人力的装置

ex.en: space-saving fitted furniture
ex.cn: 节省空间的定做的家具

senses.def: the one good quality that a person or thing has that prevents them or it from being completely bad
senses.chn: 仅有的优点；唯一可取之处

senses.def: an organization like a bank that lends money to people who want to buy a house. People also save money with a building society.
senses.chn: 房屋互助协会（提供住房贷款及储蓄服务）

senses.def: a person who rescues sb/sth from a dangerous or difficult situation

ex.en: The new manager has been hailed as the saviour of the club.
ex.cn: 新任主教练被誉为俱乐部的救星。

senses.def: used in the Christian religion as another name for Jesus Christ
a child who is born through IVF in order to ensure that they have organs or cells that can be used to treat an older brother or sister with a serious medical condition
senses.chn: 救命手足，兄姐救星（生下来是为了给患有重病的哥哥或姐姐提供器官或细胞移植的小孩，通过体外受精方式出生）

senses.def: the ability to behave in the appropriate way in social situations
senses.chn: （应付裕如的）社交能力，处世能力

senses.def: to enjoy the full taste or flavour of sth, especially by eating or drinking it slowly

ex.en: He ate his meal slowly, savouring every mouthful.
ex.cn: 他慢慢地吃着，细细地品味每一口美食。

senses.def: to enjoy a feeling or an experience thoroughly

ex.en: I wanted to savour every moment.
ex.cn: 我要细心品味，一刻也不错过。

senses.def: to seem to have an amount of sth, especially sth bad
senses.chn: 意味着；有点…，带有几分…（尤指坏事）

ex.en: His recent comments savour of hypocrisy.
ex.cn: 他最近那番评论显得有点虚伪。

senses.def: a taste or smell, especially a pleasant one

ex.en: For Emma, life had lost its savour.
ex.cn: 对埃玛来说，生活已失去乐趣。

senses.def: to seem to have an amount of sth, especially sth bad
senses.chn: 意味着；有点…，带有几分…（尤指坏事）

ex.en: His recent comments savour of hypocrisy.
ex.cn: 他最近那番评论显得有点虚伪。

senses.def: having a taste that is salty, not sweet

ex.en: savoury snacks
ex.cn: 咸味点心

senses.def: having a pleasant taste or smell
senses.chn: 好吃的；好闻的；香的；美味的

ex.en: a savoury smell from the kitchen
ex.cn: 从厨房里传来的香味

senses.def: a small amount of a food with a salty taste, not a sweet one, often served at a party, etc.
senses.chn: （在聚会等活动中常吃的）咸味小吃

senses.def: a type of cabbage with leaves that are not smooth
practical knowledge or understanding of sth

ex.en: political savvy
ex.cn: 政治见识

senses.def: having practical knowledge and understanding of sth; having common sense
senses.chn: 有见识的；懂实际知识的；通情达理的

ex.en: savvy shoppers
ex.cn: 精明的购物者

senses.def: a tool that has a long blade with sharp points (called teeth) along one of its edges. A saw is moved backwards and forwards by hand or driven by electricity and is used for cutting wood or metal.
a short phrase or sentence that states a general truth about life or gives advice
to use a saw to cut sth

ex.en: The workmen sawed and hammered all day.
ex.cn: 工人整天又锯又锤。

ex.en: He accidentally sawed through a cable.
ex.cn: 他不小心锯断了电缆。

ex.en: She sawed the plank in half.
ex.cn: 她把木板锯成两截。

senses.def: to move sth backwards and forwards on sth as if using a saw
senses.chn: 拉锯似的来回移动（某物）

ex.en: She sawed away at her violin.
ex.cn: 她不停地拉着小提琴。

ex.en: He was sawing energetically at a loaf of bread.
ex.cn: 他正用力切着一条面包。

senses.def: to cut sth and bring it to the ground using a saw

ex.en: The tree had to be sawn down.
ex.cn: 这棵树只好锯倒。

senses.def: to remove sth by cutting it with a saw

ex.en: We sawed the dead branches off the tree.
ex.cn: 我们锯掉了树上的枯枝。

senses.def: to cut sth into pieces with a saw

ex.en: We sawed the wood up into logs.
ex.cn: 我们把木头锯成很多块木材。

example.en: He accidentally sawed through a cable.
example.cn: 他不小心锯断了电缆。

example.en: She sawed the plank in half.
example.cn: 她把木板锯成两截。

senses.def: a doctor or surgeon
very small pieces of wood that fall as powder when wood is cut with a saw
a wooden frame that supports wood that is being cut with a saw
the Muslim practice of not eating or drinking in the day during the ninth month of the Muslim year, called Ramadan
senses.chn: 斋戒（伊斯兰历九月里的日间禁饮食）

senses.def: a factory in which wood is cut into boards using machinery
a shotgun with part of its barrel cut off
to remove sth by cutting it with a saw

ex.en: We sawed the dead branches off the tree.
ex.cn: 我们锯掉了树上的枯枝。

senses.def: a member of a race of people once living in NW Germany, some of whom settled in Britain in the 5th and 6th centuries
senses.chn: 撒克逊人（早期居住在今德国西北部，后其中一部分于 5、6 世纪定居在不列颠）

senses.def: a metal musical instrument that you blow into, used especially in jazz
a person who plays the saxophone
to speak or tell sb sth, using words

ex.en: 'Hello!' she said.
ex.cn: “你好！” 她说。

ex.en: 'That was marvellous,' said Daniel.
ex.cn: “好极了。” 丹尼尔说。

ex.en: Be quiet, I have something to say.
ex.cn: 安静，我有话要说。

ex.en: I didn't believe a word she said.
ex.cn: 她说的话我一个字都不信。

ex.en: That's a terrible thing to say.
ex.cn: 这话说不得。

ex.en: He knew that if he wasn't back by midnight, his parents would have something to say about it (= be angry).
ex.cn: 他知道，要是他半夜还不回去，父母就会不高兴。

senses.def: to repeat words, phrases, etc.

ex.en: to say a prayer
ex.cn: 祷告

ex.en: Try to say that line with more conviction.
ex.cn: 朗诵这一句时语气要更加坚定。

senses.def: to express an opinion on sth

ex.en: Say what you like (= although you disagree) about her, she's a fine singer.
ex.cn: 随你怎么说，反正她唱歌唱得很好。

ex.en: I'll say this for them, they're a very efficient company.
ex.cn: 我要为他们说句公道话，他们公司的效率的确很高。

ex.en: Anna thinks I'm lazy— what do you say (= what is your opinion)?
ex.cn: 安娜觉得我懒，你说呢？

ex.en: I can't say I blame her for resigning (= I think she was right).
ex.cn: 她辞职，我不能说她不对。

ex.en: I say (= suggest) we go without them.
ex.cn: 依我说，我们自己去，不带他们。

ex.en: I wouldn't say they were rich (= in my opinion they are not rich).
ex.cn: 要我说的话，他们并不富裕。

senses.def: to suggest or give sth as an example or a possibility

ex.en: You could learn the basics in, let's say, three months.
ex.cn: 比方说，三个月你就可以掌握基本知识。

ex.en: Let's take any writer, say (= for example) Dickens…
ex.cn: 我们随便举一个作家为例，比如说狄更斯…

ex.en: Say you lose your job: what would you do then?
ex.cn: 假设你把工作丢了，那你怎么办呢？

senses.def: to make thoughts, feelings, etc. clear to sb by using words, looks, movements, etc.
senses.chn: 表明，显示，表达（思想、感情）

ex.en: His angry glance said it all.
ex.cn: 他那愤愤的一瞥就道出了一切。

ex.en: That says it all really, doesn't it?(= it shows clearly what is true)
ex.cn: 这实际上就说明了一切，是不是？

ex.en: Just what is the artist trying to say in her work?
ex.cn: 这位艺术家究竟要在作品中表现什么呢？

senses.def: to give particular information or instructions

ex.en: The notice said 'Keep Out'.
ex.cn: 告示上写着 “禁止入内”。

ex.en: The clock said three o'clock.
ex.cn: 时钟显示三点整。

ex.en: The instructions say (that) we should leave it to set for four hours.
ex.cn: 说明书上说我们应让它凝结四小时。

ex.en: The book doesn't say where he was born.
ex.cn: 书上没说他是在哪儿出生的。

ex.en: The guidebook says to turn left.
ex.cn: 旅游指南上说应向左拐。

senses.def: very quickly; in a very short time
senses.chn: 转瞬间；一刹那；说时迟，那时快

senses.def: to be very obvious or easy to predict

ex.en: Of course I'll help you. That goes without saying.
ex.cn: 我当然会帮你。这还用说吗？

senses.def: to be ready, unwilling, etc. to talk or give your views on sth

ex.en: She doesn't have much to say for herself (= doesn't take part in conversation).
ex.cn: 她没多少要说的。

ex.en: He had plenty to say for himself (= he had a lot of opinions and was willing to talk).
ex.cn: 他有一肚子的话要说。

ex.en: Late again—what have you got to say for yourself (= what is your excuse)?
ex.cn: 又迟到了，这回你有什么借口呢？

senses.def: used to introduce an opinion that makes what you have just said seem less strong
senses.chn: （用以缓和语气）虽然这么说，话虽如此

ex.en: I sometimes get worried in this job. Having said that, I enjoy doing it, it's a challenge.
ex.cn: 我有时会为这份工作而感到忧虑。话虽如此，我还是很喜欢干的，因为这是一个挑战。

senses.def: used for emphasis to say 'yes'

ex.en: 'Does she see him often?' 'I'll say! Nearly every day.'
ex.cn: “她常去找他吗？” “没错！差不多天天去。”

senses.def: used to emphasize an opinion
senses.chn: （强调所发表的意见）我必须说

ex.en: Well, I must say, that's the funniest thing I've heard all week.
ex.cn: 嘿，我要说，这是我整整一周听到的最好笑的事情。

senses.def: used to express surprise, shock, etc.

ex.en: I say! What a huge cake!
ex.cn: 乖乖！多大的一个蛋糕啊！

senses.def: used to attract sb's attention or introduce a new subject of conversation
senses.chn: （用以引起注意或引出新的话题）

ex.en: I say, can you lend me five pounds?
ex.cn: 我说，你能借我五英镑吗？

senses.def: it shows a good/bad quality that sb/sth has
senses.chn: 说明某人（或某事物）很好（或不怎么样等）

ex.en: It says a lot for her that she never lost her temper.
ex.cn: 她从没发过脾气，这说明她很有涵养。

ex.en: It didn't say much for their efficiency that the order arrived a week late.
ex.cn: 订货晚到了一个星期，可见他们的效率难以恭维。

senses.def: used to say that you would like sth or to accept sth that is offered

ex.en: I wouldn't say no to a pizza.
ex.cn: 我倒是想来块比萨饼。

ex.en: 'Tea, Brian?' 'I wouldn't say no.'
ex.cn: “要喝茶吗，布赖恩？” “好哇。”

senses.def: a bad situation will pass or be forgotten most quickly if nothing more is said about it
senses.chn: 只要没人再说，事情就会过去

senses.def: the best thing to do is say as little as possible about sth
do not stop hoping
senses.chn: 别泄气；别气馁；不言放弃

senses.def: to be very shy or gentle

ex.en: He's so nervous he wouldn't say boo to a goose.
ex.cn: 他紧张得连大气都不敢喘。

senses.def: used to introduce a stronger way of describing sth
senses.chn: （引出语气更重的描述）即使不是…，虽不能说…

ex.en: a difficult, not to say impossible, task
ex.cn: 即便不是办不到，也是难办到的一项任务

senses.def: used to ask sb to smile before you take their photograph
senses.chn: （照相前请人微笑时）说 “茄子”；笑一笑

senses.def: to refuse an offer, a suggestion, etc.

ex.en: If you don't invest in this, you're saying no to a potential fortune.
ex.cn: 你如果不在这上面投资，那是存心不想发财。

senses.def: used to say that you understand exactly what sb means or is trying to say, so it is unnecessary to say anything more

ex.en: 'They went to Paris together.' 'Say no more!'
ex.cn: “他们一起去了巴黎。” “我早知道了！”

senses.def: to say exactly what you feel or think
used to express surprise at what sb has just said

ex.en: 'He's getting married.' 'Say what?'
ex.cn: “他快结婚了。” “你说什么？”

senses.def: used to ask sb to tell you when you should stop pouring a drink or serving food for them because they have enough
senses.chn: （给饮料或食物时说）够了请说一声

senses.def: in other words

ex.en: three days from now, that is to say on Friday
ex.cn: 三天以后，也就是说星期五

senses.def: used to say that sth is not very unusual or special
senses.chn: 也没什么了不起；这说明不了什么

ex.en: She's a better player than me, but that's not saying much (= because I am a very bad player).
ex.cn: 她比我高明，但那也没什么了不起（因为我很差）。

senses.def: used to introduce an opinion that makes what you have just said seem less strong
used to say that it is impossible to predict what might happen

ex.en: There's no saying how he'll react.
ex.cn: 很难说他会有何种反应。

senses.def: there are/are not good reasons for doing sth, believing sth or agreeing with sth
senses.chn: 有（或没有太多等）理由去做（或相信、同意）某事

senses.def: without exaggerating at all

ex.en: I was surprised, to say the least.
ex.cn: 毫不夸张地说，我感到吃惊。

senses.def: used to introduce a further fact or thing in addition to those already mentioned

ex.en: It was too expensive, to say nothing of the time it wasted.
ex.cn: 这太贵了，更不用说它浪费的时间了。

senses.def: I agree completely

ex.en: 'We must stand up for ourselves.' 'Well said, John.'
ex.cn: “我们必须自己起来保护自己。” “说得好，约翰。”

senses.def: would you like sth/to do sth?

ex.en: What do you say to eating out tonight?
ex.cn: 今晚到外边吃饭，怎么样？

ex.en: Let's go away for a weekend. What do you say?
ex.cn: 我们出去过周末，你说好不好？

senses.def: a particular person must be obeyed
senses.chn: 凡是…说的，都得照办；无论…说什么，都能行得通

ex.en: Sarah wanted the kitchen painted green, and what she says, goes.
ex.cn: 萨拉想把厨房刷成绿色，而她说什么，就得照办。

senses.def: used to agree to sb's suggestion because you do not want to argue
senses.chn: （因不想争论而同意）由你，随你

senses.def: when everything is considered

ex.en: I know you're upset, but when all's said and done it isn't exactly a disaster.
ex.cn: 我知道你挺沮丧的，但说到底，事情并没什么大不了的。

senses.def: used to say that nobody knows the answer to a question

ex.en: Who can say what will happen next year?
ex.cn: 谁能说得出明年会发生什么事？

senses.def: used to disagree with a statement or an opinion

ex.en: Who says I can't do it?
ex.cn: 谁说我干不了这个？

senses.def: used to say that sth might happen or might have happened in a particular way, because nobody really knows
senses.chn: （表示说不定某事会发生或本来会发生）谁说得准（…）

ex.en: Who's to say we would not have succeeded if we'd had more time?
ex.cn: 要是时间更充裕，没准儿我们就已成功了，谁说得准呢？

senses.def: I agree with you completely
senses.chn: 让你说对了；一点没错；正是这样

ex.en: 'He's in a bad mood today.' 'You can say that again!'
ex.cn: “他今天情绪不好。” “让你说对了！”

senses.def: used to say that you think the offer you are making is reasonable or generous

ex.en: Look, I'll give you £100 for it. I can't say fairer than that.
ex.cn: 你看，我出 100 英镑买它，这再公道不过了。

senses.def: used to express surprise
senses.chn: 我就知道；不会吧；不至于吧

ex.en: 'They left without us.' 'You don't say!' (= I'm not surprised)
ex.cn: “他们撇下我们自个儿走了。” “真的吗？”

senses.def: used to agree with sb when they say sth about themselves that you would not have been rude enough to say yourself
senses.chn: （同意对方所作而碍于礼貌自己不便作出的评价）这话可是你说的

ex.en: 'I know I'm not the world's greatest cook.' 'You said it!'
ex.cn: “我知道我的饭菜做得不是太好。” “这话可是你说的！”

senses.def: used to agree with sb's suggestion
senses.chn: （同意对方的提议）正合我心意

senses.def: used when you are saying that sth is probable

ex.en: I dare say you know about it already.
ex.cn: 你大概已经知道了。

senses.def: to be much more difficult to do than to talk about
senses.chn: 说时容易做时难；谈何容易

ex.en: 'Why don't you get yourself a job?' 'That's easier said than done.'
ex.cn: “你怎么不给自己找个工作呢？” “那谈何容易呀。”

senses.def: used to say that you understand a situation and there is no need to say any more

ex.en: 'He's a politician, remember.' 'Enough said.'
ex.cn: “记住，他是一个政客。” “不用多说了。”

senses.def: used when you are commenting on a situation and saying that you are happy about it
senses.chn: （表示对某种情况感到高兴）我很高兴地说

ex.en: Most teachers, I'm glad to say, take their jobs very seriously.
ex.cn: 我很高兴地说，多数老师工作都很认真。

senses.def: used when making a suggestion or giving an example
senses.chn: （提议或举例时）譬如说，比方说，例如

ex.en: I can let you have it for, well let's say £100.
ex.cn: 我可以把这东西卖给你，嗯，比如说作价 100 英镑吧。

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying or to ask sb if they really mean what they say
senses.chn: （强调要说的话，或问对方是否真是这个意思）意思是说

ex.en: I mean to say, you should have known how he would react!
ex.cn: 我的意思是说，你本应料到他会作何反应！

ex.en: Do you mean to say you've lost it?
ex.cn: 你是说你把那东西给弄丢了？

senses.def: used when you are going to criticize sb or say sth that might upset them
senses.chn: （批评等之前说）你不会在意我这么说吧

ex.en: That colour doesn't really suit you, if you don't mind my saying so.
ex.cn: 这颜色并不十分适合你。我这么说，你不会介意吧。

senses.def: used to emphasize that the information you are giving is obvious

ex.en: The problem, needless to say, is the cost involved.
ex.cn: 不用说，问题是所涉及的费用。

senses.def: to say sth publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

ex.en: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
ex.cn: 他不想公开赞扬或批评这项提议。

senses.def: used to say that sth was, or will be, done immediately
used for saying that sth is disappointing
senses.chn: （表示某事令人失望）我遗憾地说

ex.en: He didn't accept the job, I'm sorry to say.
ex.cn: 我很遗憾，他不接受那项工作。

senses.def: used to suggest that although you could say more, what you do say will be enough to explain what you mean
senses.chn: 无须多说；只需说…就够了

senses.def: to never say anything good about sb/sth

ex.en: Nobody had a good word to say about him.
ex.cn: 没有一个人说过他好。

senses.def: to give an order; to make a request
senses.chn: 下命令；吩咐一下；提请求

ex.en: Just say the word, and I'll go.
ex.cn: 只要发句话，我就走。

senses.def: the right to influence sth by giving your opinion before a decision is made

ex.en: We had no say in the decision to sell the company.
ex.cn: 在决定出售公司的问题上，我们没有发言权。

ex.en: People want a greater say in local government.
ex.cn: 人们要求在当地的政务中有更大的发言权。

ex.en: The judge has the final say on the sentence.
ex.cn: 法官对判决有最后的决定权。

senses.def: to have the opportunity to express yourself fully about sth

ex.en: She won't be happy until she's had her say.
ex.cn: 她要把话都说出来才舒畅。

senses.def: used for showing surprise or pleasure

ex.en: Say, that's a nice haircut!
ex.cn: 啧啧，这个头发剪得很漂亮！

senses.def: used for attracting sb's attention or for making a suggestion or comment
senses.chn: （提请别人注意、提出建议或作出评论）喂，我说

ex.en: Say, how about going to a movie tonight?
ex.cn: 我说，今晚去看场电影怎么样？

example.en: 'Hello!' she said.
example.cn: “你好！” 她说。

example.en: Be quiet, I have something to say.
example.cn: 安静，我有话要说。

example.en: She said nothing to me about it.
example.cn: 她没有跟我说过这件事。

example.en: I said to myself (= thought), 'That can't be right!'
example.cn: 我心里想：“这不对呀！”

example.en: He said (that) his name was Sam.
example.cn: 他说他叫萨姆。

example.en: It is said that she lived to be over 100.
example.cn: 据说她活了 100 多岁。

example.en: She finds it hard to say what she feels.
example.cn: 她觉得心里的感受难以言述。

example.en: He said to meet him here.
example.cn: 他说来这儿跟他见面。

phrases.pattern: sb/sth is said to be/have sth
phrases.filled: sb/sth is said to be/have sth

example.en: He is said to have been a brilliant scholar.
example.cn: 据说他曾是个了不起的学者。

example.en: You could learn the basics in, let's say, three months.
example.cn: 比方说，三个月你就可以掌握基本知识。

example.en: The book doesn't say where he was born.
example.cn: 书上没说他是在哪儿出生的。

senses.def: to say sth important using only a few words
used to ask sb to smile before you take their photograph
senses.chn: （照相前请人微笑时）说 “茄子”；笑一笑

senses.def: a well-known phrase or statement that expresses sth about life that most people believe is wise and true

ex.en: 'Accidents will happen', as the saying goes.
ex.cn: 常言道：“意外事，总难免。”

senses.def: used to say that you understand exactly what sb means or is trying to say, so it is unnecessary to say anything more

ex.en: 'They went to Paris together.' 'Say no more!'
ex.cn: “他们一起去了巴黎。” “我早知道了！”

senses.def: permission that sb gives to do sth

ex.en: Nothing could be done without her say-so.
ex.cn: 未经她准许，什么都不可以做。

senses.def: based on a statement that sb makes without giving any proof
senses.chn: 仅凭某人的空口白话；听信某人不实之词

ex.en: He hired and fired people on his partner's say-so.
ex.cn: 他雇谁辞谁全听他的合伙人的一句话。

senses.def: used to ask sb to tell you when you should stop pouring a drink or serving food for them because they have enough
senses.chn: （给饮料或食物时说）够了请说一声

senses.def: to say exactly what you feel or think

sb cannot help but do sth.lemma: sb cannot help but do sth

senses.def: used to say that it is impossible to prevent or avoid sth
senses.chn: 某人忍不住（或无法抑制）做某事；不可能避免某事

ex.en: I can't help thinking he knows more than he has told us.
ex.cn: 我总觉得他没把他知道的事全告诉我们。

ex.en: She couldn't help but wonder what he was thinking.
ex.cn: 她不禁琢磨着他在想些什么。

ex.en: It couldn't be helped (= there was no way of avoiding it and we must accept it).
ex.cn: 这是不可避免的。

ex.en: I always end up having an argument with her, I don't know why, I just can't help it.
ex.cn: 我总是和她意见不合，闹得不欢而散，我不知道为什么，我就是忍不住。

ex.en: I couldn't help it if the bus was late (= it wasn't my fault).
ex.cn: 公共汽车晚点了，我没办法。

ex.en: She burst out laughing—she couldn't help herself (= couldn't stop herself).
ex.cn: 她突然大笑起来，不能自已。

sb can take it or leave it.lemma: sb can take it or leave it

senses.def: used to say that you do not care if sb accepts or rejects your offer
senses.chn: 要就要，不要就拉倒；取舍请便

senses.def: used to say that sb does not have a strong opinion about sth
senses.chn: 可有可无；无所谓；无偏好

ex.en: Dancing? I can take it or leave it.
ex.cn: 跳舞？我跳不跳都行。

senses.def: used to say that you are not going to give sb sth that they have asked for
senses.chn: （表示不给他人所要的东西）得不到，空指望

senses.def: used to say that you admire sb because they have done sth difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: （用以夸奖某人完成了艰巨任务）应给某人授勋

senses.def: a bend in a road or pipe that is shaped like an S
used about sb who has died to say that they had a long life
senses.chn: （用以指死者）…够长寿了，终其天年

sb has a face like thunder.lemma: sb has a face like thunder

senses.def: somebody looks very angry
senses.chn: 某人怒气冲冲；某人满面怒容

senses.def: somebody has become successful

ex.en: He knew he had arrived when he was shortlisted for the Man Booker prize.
ex.cn: 入围曼布克小说奖后，他知道自己成功了。

senses.def: used in polite expressions to describe sb as 'very old'

ex.en: He was a man of advanced years.
ex.cn: 他年事已高。

ex.en: Even at my advanced age I still know how to enjoy myself!
ex.cn: 我虽说是黄昏暮年，也还懂得如何找乐儿！

sb's bark is worse than their bite.lemma: sb's bark is worse than their bite

senses.def: used to say that sb is not really as angry or as aggressive as they sound
senses.chn: 嘴硬心软；说话强硬，其实并不伤人；貌似凶狠

senses.def: somebody is very angry and ready to argue or fight
senses.chn: 怒气冲天；怒从心上来；怒不可遏

senses.def: a person or thing that depends completely on sb else and is controlled by them
the last years of sb's life
a person thinks that other people are talking about them, especially in an unkind way
senses.chn: （感到有人议论自己，尤指说闲话而）耳朵发热

ex.en: 'I bumped into your ex-wife last night.' 'I thought I could feel my ears burning!'
ex.cn: “我昨天晚上偶然遇到你的前妻。” “怪不得我好像觉得耳朵发热呢！”

senses.def: a person is trying to listen to sb else's conversation

sb's eyes are bigger than their stomach.lemma: sb's eyes are bigger than their stomach

senses.def: used to say that sb has been greedy by taking more food than they can eat
senses.chn: （表示贪吃）眼大肚皮小，眼馋肚饱

senses.def: used to say that sb will not get a particular job or position because they do not have the appearance, personality, etc. that the employer wants, even when this should not be important
senses.chn: 长相不合格；性格不合适

ex.en: It doesn't matter how well qualified you are, if your face doesn't fit, you don't stand a chance.
ex.cn: 资历多好也没用，如果人家看你不顺眼，你就不会有机会。

senses.def: somebody looks very angry
senses.chn: 某人怒气冲冲；某人满面怒容

senses.def: a situation in which sb loses the trust or respect that people have for them, especially because of sth wrong or immoral that they have done
senses.chn: （尤指因做了错事或不道德之事的）失信

senses.def: a performer, politician, sports player, etc., who is popular where they were born
senses.chn: 故乡的骄子（可指演员、政治家、运动员等）

senses.def: (in the US) a candidate for president who is supported by his or her own state in the first part of a campaign
senses.chn: （美国大选第一阶段）本州支持的总统候选人

senses.def: somebody feels so angry about sth that they feel physically sick
to become angry

ex.en: Ben felt his hackles rise as the speaker continued.
ex.cn: 随着那人不断地讲下去，本不禁怒火中烧。

sb's heart is in their mouth.lemma: sb's heart is in their mouth

senses.def: somebody feels nervous or frightened about sth
senses.chn: 提心吊胆；心提到了嗓子眼儿

sb's heart is in the right place.lemma: sb's heart is in the right place

senses.def: used to say that sb's intentions are kind and sincere even though they sometimes do the wrong thing
senses.chn: 本意是好的；心眼是好的

senses.def: used to say that sb has a sudden feeling of happiness or excitement
used to say that sb has a sudden feeling of fear, excitement, etc.
senses.chn: （表示突然感到恐惧、兴奋等）心里咯噔一下

senses.def: used to say that sb suddenly feels sad or depressed about sth
senses.chn: （表示突然感到悲伤或沮丧）心里一沉

ex.en: My heart sank when I saw how much work there was left.
ex.cn: 我看到还有那么多活没干时，心顿时沉了下去。

ex.en: She watched him go with a sinking heart.
ex.cn: 她心情沉重地看着他走了。

senses.def: used to say that sb is not liked or popular because of sth they have done
something that you particularly dislike
something that you particularly dislike
a person or thing that causes sb to feel great pleasure or satisfaction
senses.chn: 某人引以为荣的人（或事物）

senses.def: when a pregnant woman's waters break, the liquid in her womb passes out of her body just before the baby is born
somebody's promise can be relied on completely
used to warn sb that another person will be very angry with them

sb will not do sth again in a hurry.lemma: sb will not do sth again in a hurry

senses.def: used to say that sb does not want to do sth again because it was not enjoyable

ex.en: I won't be going there again in a hurry—the food was terrible.
ex.cn: 我再不愿去那里了，那里吃的东西糟透了。

sb won't thank you for sth.lemma: sb won't thank you for sth

senses.def: used to say that sb will not be pleased or will be annoyed about sth

ex.en: John won't thank you for interfering.
ex.cn: 你插手，约翰必定十分恼火。

senses.def: a hard dry covering that forms over a wound as it heals
a skin disease of animals
a disease of plants, especially apples and potatoes, that causes a rough surface
a worker who refuses to join a strike or takes the place of sb on strike
senses.chn: 拒绝参加罢工的工人；顶替罢工者上班的工人；工贼

senses.def: a cover for a sword that is made of leather or metal
covered in scabs
a skin disease that causes itching and small red raised spots
offensive or shocking in a sexual way
senses.chn: 猥亵的；淫秽的；有伤风化的

senses.def: having a rough surface

ex.en: scabrous skin
ex.cn: 粗糙的皮肤

senses.def: large numbers or amounts of sth

ex.en: scads of $20 bills
ex.cn: 许多 20 美元的钞票

senses.def: a platform used when executing criminals by cutting off their heads or hanging them from a rope
a structure made of scaffolding, for workers to stand on when they are working on a building
poles and boards that are joined together to make a structure for workers to stand on when they are working high up on the outside wall of a building
used to describe a computer, a network, software, etc. that can be adapted to meet greater needs in the future
senses.chn: （计算机、网络、软件等）可扩展的，可升级的

ex.en: A business database needs to be scalable.
ex.cn: 商业数据库需要具备可以升级的条件。

senses.def: designed to work on a large or small scale, according to needs
senses.chn: 可改变大小的；可缩放的

ex.en: scalable graphics
ex.cn: 可变更大小的图形

senses.def: having size but no direction
senses.chn: 标量的；纯量的；无向量的

senses.def: a person, especially a child, who behaves badly, but not in a serious way
senses.chn: 调皮捣蛋的人，淘气鬼（尤指儿童）

senses.def: to burn yourself or part of your body with very hot liquid or steam

ex.en: Be careful not to scald yourself with the steam.
ex.cn: 小心别让蒸汽把你烫着。

ex.en: Tears scalded her eyes.
ex.cn: 她热泪盈眶。

ex.en: She burned all his letters.
ex.cn: 她把他的信全部付之一炬。

ex.en: The house burned down in 1995.
ex.cn: 那所房子在 1995 年烧毁了。

ex.en: The bodies had been charred beyond recognition.
ex.cn: 这些尸体已烧焦，无法辨认。

ex.en: I scorched my dress when I was ironing it.
ex.cn: 我把自己的连衣裙熨焦了。

senses.def: an injury to the skin from very hot liquid or steam
hot enough to scald

ex.en: scalding water
ex.cn: 滚烫的水

ex.en: Scalding tears poured down her face.
ex.cn: 滚烫的泪水从她脸上扑簌簌地流下来。

senses.def: the size or extent of sth, especially when compared with sth else
senses.chn: （尤指与其他事物相比较时的）规模，范围，程度

ex.en: They entertain on a large scale (= they hold expensive parties with a lot of guests).
ex.cn: 他们大宴宾客。

ex.en: Here was corruption on a grand scale.
ex.cn: 这里的腐败现象曾十分严重。

ex.en: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
ex.cn: 全球 77% 的能量产生自化石燃料。

ex.en: to achieve economies of scale in production (= to produce many items so the cost of producing each one is reduced)
ex.cn: 生产实现规模经济

ex.en: It was impossible to comprehend the full scale of the disaster.
ex.cn: 这场灾难的深重程度当时还无法充分认识。

ex.en: It was not until morning that the sheer scale of the damage could be seen (= how great it was).
ex.cn: 直到早晨才看清了损害的严重程度。

senses.def: a range of levels or numbers used for measuring sth

ex.en: a five-point pay scale
ex.cn: 五分制工资等级

ex.en: to evaluate performance on a scale from 1 to 10
ex.cn: 按 1 到 10 级来评估业绩

senses.def: the set of all the different levels of sth, from the lowest to the highest

ex.en: At the other end of the scale, life is a constant struggle to get enough to eat.
ex.cn: 对于处在社会最底层的人来说，生活就是为吃饱肚子而不断挣扎的过程。

ex.en: the social scale
ex.cn: 社会等级体系

senses.def: a series of marks at regular intervals on an instrument that is used for measuring

ex.en: How much does it read on the scale?
ex.cn: 刻度显示的是多少？

senses.def: an instrument for weighing people or things

ex.en: bathroom/kitchen/weighing scales
ex.cn: 浴室秤；厨房用秤；秤

ex.en: the scales of justice (= represented as the two pans on a balance (5) )
ex.cn: 法律的天平

senses.def: the relation between the actual size of sth and its size on a map, diagram or model that represents it

ex.en: a scale of 1:25 000
a scale model/drawing
ex.cn: 按比例缩放的模型／图画

ex.en: Both plans are drawn to the same scale.
ex.cn: 两张平面图是按同一比例绘制的。

senses.def: a group of people who choose, for example, the members of a sports team
senses.chn: （运动队队员等的）选拔委员会；遴选委员会

senses.def: affecting or concerned with only a small number of people or things from a larger group

ex.en: the selective breeding of cattle
ex.cn: 牛的选择性培育

ex.en: selective strike action
ex.cn: 有选择的罢工行动

senses.def: tending to be careful about what or who you choose
senses.chn: 认真挑选的；严格筛选的

ex.en: You will have to be selective about which information to include in the report.
ex.cn: 究竟要把哪些资料收入报告，你得仔细斟酌挑选。

ex.en: Their admissions policy is very selective.
ex.cn: 他们执行严格挑选的录取政策。

ex.en: a selective school (= one that chooses which children to admit, especially according to ability)
ex.cn: 择优录取学生的学校

senses.def: a system in which people have to spend a period of time in the armed forces by law
a person who chooses the members of a particular sports team
a device in an engine, a piece of machinery, etc. that allows you to choose a particular function
a chemical element. Selenium is a grey substance that is used in making electrical equipment and coloured glass. A lack of selenium in the human body can lead to illnesses such as depression.
senses.chn: 硒（化学元素，用于制造电气设备和有色玻璃，人体缺此元素可致抑郁等病）

senses.def: the type of person you are, especially the way you normally behave, look or feel
senses.chn: （自己的）通常的行为方式，本来面目，惯常心态

ex.en: You'll soon be feeling your old self again (= feeling well or happy again).
ex.cn: 你很快就会恢复原样的。

ex.en: He's not his usual happy self this morning.
ex.cn: 今天早上，他不像平素那样乐呵呵的。

ex.en: Only with a few people could she be her real self (= show what she was really like rather than what she pretended to be).
ex.cn: 只有和某几个人在一起时，她才能表现出真实的自我。

ex.en: his private/professional self (= how he behaves at home/work)
ex.cn: 他在家里／上班时的样子

senses.def: a person's personality or character that makes them different from other people

ex.en: Many people living in institutions have lost their sense of self (= the feeling that they are individual people).
ex.cn: 许多生活在福利院里的人已经失去了个性意识。

ex.en: the inner self (= a person's emotional and spiritual character)
ex.cn: 内心的思想感情

ex.en: a lack of confidence in the self
ex.cn: 缺乏自信

senses.def: your own advantage or pleasure rather than that of other people
senses.chn: 个人利益；一己的享乐；私心

ex.en: She didn't do it for any reason of self.
ex.cn: 她那样做绝不是出于私心。

senses.def: used to refer to a person

ex.en: You didn't hurt your little self, did you?
ex.cn: 小家伙，你没伤着自己吧？

ex.en: We look forward to seeing Mrs Brown and your good self this evening.
ex.cn: 我们期盼今晚能见到布朗夫人和您本人。

senses.def: to not have the strength, influence, etc. that you used to have
senses.chn: 失去昔日的力量（或影响等）；威风不再；不如当年

senses.def: of, to or by yourself or itself

ex.en: self-control
ex.cn: 自我控制

ex.en: self-addressed
ex.cn: 写明回邮地址的

ex.en: self-taught
ex.cn: 自学的

senses.def: only concerned about or interested in yourself
senses.chn: 只顾自己的；只关心自己的

senses.def: behaviour by which a person does harm to himself or herself
a method of learning in which students choose their materials and use them to study on their own
senses.chn: 自主学习法（由学生自选材料并自学）

ex.en: a self-access centre/library
ex.cn: 自主学习中心／图书馆

senses.def: the fact of using your skills and abilities and achieving as much as you can possibly achieve
senses.chn: 自我实现（利用自身技能取得尽可能大的成就）

senses.def: if an envelope is self-addressed, sb has written their own address on it
covered on one side with a sticky substance so that it can be stuck to sth without the use of glue, etc.

ex.en: self-adhesive tape
ex.cn: 自粘胶带

senses.def: the study of your own character and behaviour, especially your reasons for doing things
senses.chn: 自我分析（对自身性格和行为的分析，尤指做事的动机）

senses.def: giving yourself a particular title, job, etc., especially without the agreement of other people
an act or the process of judging your own work or achievements
bought in several parts that you have to put together yourself

ex.en: cheap self-assembly kitchen units
ex.cn: 便宜的自己组装的厨房设备

senses.def: very confident and not afraid to express your opinions
the quality of being very confident and not afraid to express your opinions
senses.chn: 自信且勇于表达；自我肯定

senses.def: the process of judging your own progress, achievements, etc.
a system of paying tax in which you calculate yourself how much you should pay
having a lot of confidence in yourself and your abilities
knowledge and understanding of your own character
the building of homes by their owners; a home that is built in this way
senses.chn: 自己建造住房；自己建造的住房

ex.en: self-build houses
ex.cn: 自建住宅

senses.def: a self-catering holiday is one which provides you with accommodation and the equipment that is necessary to cook your own meals
senses.chn: （度假方式）可自炊的，可下厨煮食的

ex.en: self-catering accommodation
ex.cn: 自炊式住宿

senses.def: tending to think only about yourself and not thinking about the needs or feelings of other people
senses.chn: 自我中心的；只考虑自己的

senses.def: having one colour all over

ex.en: a self-colour carpet
ex.cn: 单色地毯

senses.def: admitting that you are a particular type of person or have a particular problem, especially a bad one
senses.chn: 自己承认的；自己坦白的

ex.en: a self-confessed thief
ex.cn: 自首的窃贼

senses.def: having confidence in yourself and your abilities

ex.en: a self-confident child
ex.cn: 自信的孩子

ex.en: a self-confident manner
ex.cn: 自信的态度

senses.def: a way of behaving that shows that you think you have done sth very well and are pleased with yourself
nervous or embarrassed about your appearance or what other people think of you
senses.chn: （因在意自己的外表或他人的看法）局促不安的，难为情的，不自然的

ex.en: He's always been self-conscious about being so short.
ex.cn: 他老为自己身材矮小而觉得难为情。

senses.def: done in a way that shows you are aware of the effect that is being produced

ex.en: The humour of the play is self-conscious and contrived.
ex.cn: 这部剧的幽默是刻意而为的，而且牵强做作。

senses.def: not needing or depending on other people

ex.en: Her father was a quiet self-contained man.
ex.cn: 她父亲生前是个好静而独立自主的人。

senses.def: able to operate or exist without outside help or influence

ex.en: a self-contained community
ex.cn: 自给自足的社会

ex.en: Each chapter is self-contained and can be studied in isolation.
ex.cn: 每一章均自成一篇，可单独学习。

senses.def: having its own kitchen, bathroom and entrance
senses.chn: 独门独户的；设施齐全的

ex.en: self-contained accommodation
ex.cn: 独门独户、设施齐全的住处

senses.def: containing two ideas or statements that cannot both be true
the ability to remain calm and not show your emotions even though you are feeling angry, excited, etc.

ex.en: to lose/regain your self-control
ex.cn: 失去／恢复自制

ex.en: It took all his self-control not to shout at them.
ex.cn: 他强压怒火，没有冲他们叫嚷。

senses.def: that corrects or adjusts itself without outside help
senses.chn: 自我纠正的；自动校正的；自我调节的

ex.en: The economic market is a self-correcting mechanism, that does not need regulation by government.
ex.cn: 经济市场是一种自我调节的机制，不需要政府调控。

senses.def: the process of looking at and judging your own faults or weaknesses
the act of making yourself believe sth that you know is not true
causing more problems and difficulties instead of solving them; not achieving what you wanted to achieve but having an opposite effect
senses.chn: 事与愿违的；适得其反的；弄巧成拙的

ex.en: Paying children too much attention when they misbehave can be self-defeating.
ex.cn: 孩子有不良行为时，过分关注可能适得其反。

senses.def: something you say or do in order to protect yourself when you are being attacked, criticized, etc.

ex.en: The man later told police that he was acting in self-defence.
ex.cn: 事后那人告诉警察，他当时是出于自卫。

senses.def: the skill of being able to protect yourself from physical attack without using weapons

ex.en: I'm taking classes in self-defence.
ex.cn: 我在上课学防身术。

senses.def: the act of making yourself believe sth that you know is not true
the act of not having or doing the things you like, either because you do not have enough money, or for moral or religious reasons
done in a way that makes your own achievements or abilities seem unimportant

ex.en: He gave a self-deprecating shrug.
ex.cn: 他自谦地耸耸肩。

senses.def: to destroy itself, usually by exploding

ex.en: This tape will self-destruct in 30 seconds.
ex.cn: 这盘磁带将在 30 秒后自毁。

ex.en: In the last half hour of the movie the plot rapidly self-destructs.
ex.cn: 在电影的最后半个小时里，故事情节迅速了结。

senses.def: the act of doing things to deliberately harm yourself
the right of a country or a region and its people to be independent and to choose their own government and political system
senses.chn: （国家或地区及其人民的）自决权

senses.def: the right or ability of a person to control their own fate
the process by which a person's character and abilities are developed
senses.chn: （在性格、能力方面的）自我发展，自我提高

ex.en: Staff are encouraged to use the library for professional self-development.
ex.cn: 鼓励员工利用图书馆提高自己的专业水平。

senses.def: the ability to make yourself do sth, especially sth difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: 自律能力；自我约束能力

ex.en: It takes a lot of self-discipline to go jogging in winter.
ex.cn: 在冬天跑步是需要很大的自律力的。

senses.def: the process of understanding more about yourself in order to make yourself happier

ex.en: David left his boring job to go on a journey of self-discovery.
ex.cn: 戴维辞掉了他那份无聊的工作，开始了寻找自我之旅。

senses.def: the feeling that you are not good enough
a self-drive car is one that you hire and drive yourself
a self-drive holiday is one on which you use your own car or a car you hire to travel to the holiday area
having learned things by reading books, etc. rather than at school or college
senses.chn: 自我教育的；自学的；自修的

senses.def: not wanting to attract attention to yourself or your abilities

ex.en: He was a shy, self-effacing man.
ex.cn: 他是个腼腆谦逊的人。

senses.def: working for yourself and not employed by a company, etc.
senses.chn: 个体经营的；单干的；自雇的

ex.en: a self-employed musician
ex.cn: 自己单干的乐师

ex.en: retirement plans for the self-employed (= people who are self-employed)
ex.cn: 个体经营者退休计划

senses.def: a feeling of being happy with your own character and abilities

ex.en: to have high/low self-esteem
ex.cn: 自尊心强／弱

ex.en: You need to build your self-esteem.
ex.cn: 你需要树立自尊心。

senses.def: obvious and needing no further proof or explanation
senses.chn: 显而易见的；不言而喻的；明摆着的

ex.en: The dangers of such action are self-evident.
ex.cn: 这样的行动，其危险是明摆着的。

ex.en: a self-evident truth
ex.cn: 不证自明的真理

senses.def: the study of your own behaviour and beliefs to find out if they are right or wrong
the act of checking your body for any signs of illness
easy to understand and not needing any more explanation
senses.chn: 无须解释的；明白易晓的；一目了然的

senses.def: the expression of your thoughts or feelings, especially through activities such as writing, painting, dancing, etc.
senses.chn: 自我表现，自我表达（尤指通过写作、绘画、舞蹈等活动）

ex.en: You should encourage your child's attempts at self-expression.
ex.cn: 你应当鼓励孩子尝试表达自我。

senses.def: a self-fulfilling prophecy is one that becomes true because people expect it to be true and behave in a way that will make it happen
senses.chn: （预言等）自我应验的，自我实现的

ex.en: If you expect to fail, you will fail. It's a self-fulfilling prophecy.
ex.cn: 你如果预期失败，就会失败。这是一种自我应验的预测。

senses.def: the feeling of being happy and satisfied that you have everything you want or need
senses.chn: 自我实现感；自我满足感

senses.def: the government or control of a country or an organization by its own people or members, not by others
the practice of deliberately injuring yourself, for example by cutting yourself, as a result of having serious emotional or mental problems
senses.chn: （故意）自我伤害（常由情感、精神问题所致）

senses.def: the act of relying on your own efforts and abilities in order to solve your problems, rather than depending on other people for help
a photo of yourself that you take, typically with a smartphone or a webcam, and usually put on a social networking site
the opinion or idea you have of yourself, especially of your appearance or abilities

ex.en: to have a positive/negative self-image
ex.cn: 有着正面的／负面的自我形象

senses.def: thinking that you are more important than other people
senses.chn: 自大的；妄自尊大的；自负的

senses.def: a self-imposed task, duty, etc. is one that you force yourself to do rather than one that sb else forces you to do
senses.chn: 自己强加的；自愿负担的；自己规定的

senses.def: the process by which a person improves their knowledge, status, character, etc. by their own efforts
senses.chn: （在知识、地位、性格等方面的）自我改进，自我提高

senses.def: caused by yourself

ex.en: self-induced vomiting
ex.cn: 自导呕吐

senses.def: allowing yourself to have or do things that you like, especially when you do this too much or too often
a self-inflicted injury, problem, etc. is one that you cause for yourself
senses.chn: 自己造成的；加于自身的

ex.en: a self-inflicted wound
ex.cn: 自伤

senses.def: the fact of sb only considering their own interests and of not caring about things that would help other people

ex.en: Not all of them were acting out of self-interest.
ex.cn: 他们当中，并非所有人的行动都是出于利己的目的。

senses.def: caring only about yourself rather than about other people

ex.en: selfish behaviour
ex.cn: 自私的行为

ex.en: Do you think I'm being selfish by not letting her go?
ex.cn: 你觉得我不让她走是自私吗？

ex.en: What a selfish thing to do!
ex.cn: 这样做，多么自私！

ex.en: It was selfish of him to leave all the work to you.
ex.cn: 他把所有的工作都推给你，真是自私。

senses.def: an understanding of yourself
thinking more about the needs, happiness, etc. of other people than about your own

ex.en: a life of selfless service to the community
ex.cn: 无私服务于社会的一生

senses.def: the feeling that your own happiness and wishes are important
having become rich and successful through your own hard work rather than having had money given to you
senses.chn: 靠自己奋斗成功的；白手起家的

ex.en: He was proud of the fact that he was a self-made man.
ex.cn: 他为自己白手起家而自豪。

senses.def: if a person is self-motivated, they are capable of hard work and effort without the need for encouragement
senses.chn: 自我激励的；自我勉励的；主动的

senses.def: the act of wounding yourself, especially when this is a sign of mental illness
believing that your own opinions are always right and refusing to listen to those of other people
senses.chn: 刚愎自用的；固执己见的

senses.def: continuing without any outside influence
senses.chn: 自我持续的；自我继续的

ex.en: Revenge leads to a self-perpetuating cycle of violence.
ex.cn: 冤冤相报会导致永不休止的暴力。

senses.def: a feeling of pity for yourself, especially because of sth unpleasant or unfair that has happened to you

ex.en: She's not someone who likes to wallow in self-pity.
ex.cn: 她不是那种喜欢自怜的人。

senses.def: a painting, etc. that you do of yourself
able to remain calm and confident in a difficult situation
senses.chn: 沉着的；镇定的；泰然自若的

senses.def: the fact of protecting yourself in a dangerous or difficult situation

ex.en: She was held back by some sense of self-preservation.
ex.cn: 一种自我保护意识使她没有贸然行动。

senses.def: giving yourself a particular title, job, etc. without the agreement or permission of other people
the activity of making people notice you and your abilities, especially in a way that annoys other people

ex.en: The article was a piece of blatant self-promotion.
ex.cn: 这篇文章是露骨的自我吹捧。

senses.def: flour that contains baking powder
the fact of using your skills and abilities and achieving as much as you can possibly achieve
senses.chn: 自我实现（利用自身技能取得尽可能大的成就）

senses.def: referring to the fact of actually being a work of literature, or to the author, or to other works that the author has written
senses.chn: 自我指涉的，自指的（即指向同一文学作品，或涉及作者或作者的其他作品）

senses.def: a good opinion of yourself, which is considered bad if you have too little or too much

ex.en: He suffers from a lack of self-regard.
ex.cn: 他缺乏自尊。

senses.def: something that is self-regulating controls itself

ex.en: a self-regulating economy
ex.cn: 自我调节的经济

senses.def: able to do or decide things by yourself, rather than depending on other people for help
senses.chn: 自立的；自力更生的；自主的

senses.def: a feeling of pride in yourself that what you do, say, etc. is right and good
having pride in yourself because you believe that what you do is right and good

ex.en: No self-respecting journalist would ever work for that newspaper.
ex.cn: 凡有自尊心的记者都不会为那家报纸工作。

senses.def: the ability to stop yourself doing or saying sth that you want to because you know it is better not to

ex.en: She exercised all her self-restraint and kept quiet.
ex.cn: 她好不容易才忍住没说话。

senses.def: feeling or behaving as if what you say or do is always morally right, and other people are wrong
senses.chn: 以正人君子自居的；自以为正直的

senses.def: flour that contains baking powder
the governing of a country or an area by its own people
the act of not allowing yourself to have or do sth in order to help other people

ex.en: the courage and self-sacrifice of those who fought in the war
ex.cn: 投身战争的人的勇气和自我牺牲精神

senses.def: used to emphasize that two people or things are the same

ex.en: Jane had been wondering that selfsame thing.
ex.cn: 简也一直在为同一件事纳闷。

senses.def: too pleased with yourself or your own achievements
senses.chn: 自鸣得意的；沾沾自喜的

ex.en: He had a self-satisfied smirk on his face.
ex.cn: 他脸上挂着得意扬扬的笑容。

senses.def: interested only in your own needs and interests rather than thinking about the needs of other people
a situation in which people decide for themselves to do sth rather than being chosen to do it
a self-service shop/store, restaurant, etc. is one in which customers serve themselves and then pay for the goods
senses.chn: 自我服务的；（商店）自选的；（餐厅）自助的

senses.def: interested only in gaining an advantage for yourself
senses.chn: 只为个人打算的；一心谋私利的

senses.def: a person who is able to work on their own and make their own decisions without needing anyone to tell them what to do
senses.chn: 有主见的人；做事主动的人

senses.def: a service that provides a place where you can store things and a key so that you can get them when you need them

ex.en: self-storage facilities/units
ex.cn: 自助寄存设备

senses.def: the activity of learning about sth without a teacher to help you
using a name or title that you have given yourself, especially when you do not have the right to do it
able to do or produce everything that you need without the help of other people

ex.en: The country is totally self-sufficient in food production.
ex.cn: 在粮食生产上，这个国家完全做到了自给自足。

senses.def: having enough money to be able to operate without financial help from other people
senses.chn: 资金自给的；经济独立的

senses.def: having learned sth by reading books, etc., rather than by sb teaching you

ex.en: a self-taught artist
ex.cn: 自学成才的艺术家

senses.def: a device in a camera that creates a delay before the photograph is taken, which allows you to take a photograph of yourself by pressing the button and then getting in position
determined to do what you want without caring about other people
a feeling of confidence in yourself that you are a good and useful person
an imaginary creature which sometimes looks like a human and sometimes looks like a seal
to give sth to sb in exchange for money

ex.en: I sold my car to James for £800.
ex.cn: 我把我的汽车转让给了詹姆斯，获得 800 英镑。

ex.en: I sold James my car for £800.
ex.cn: 我以 800 英镑把我的汽车卖给了詹姆斯。

ex.en: They sold the business at a profit/loss (= they gained/lost money when they sold it).
ex.cn: 他们把公司赢利／亏本让出。

ex.en: We offered them a good price but they wouldn't sell.
ex.cn: 我们开了个好价钱，但他们不愿卖。

senses.def: to offer sth for people to buy

ex.en: Most supermarkets sell a range of organic products.
ex.cn: 多数超级市场都经销一系列有机产品。

ex.en: Do you sell stamps?
ex.cn: 你这儿卖邮票吗？

ex.en: to sell insurance
ex.cn: 卖保险

senses.def: to be bought by people in the way or in the numbers mentioned; to be offered at the price mentioned

ex.en: The magazine sells 300 000 copies a week.
ex.cn: 这本杂志一周售出 30 万册。

ex.en: The book sold well and was reprinted many times.
ex.cn: 这本书销路不错，重印了好多次。

ex.en: The new design just didn't sell (= nobody bought it).
ex.cn: 新款式无人问津。

ex.en: The pens sell for just 50p each.
ex.cn: 这些钢笔每支只卖 50 便士。

senses.def: to make people want to buy sth

ex.en: You may not like it but advertising sells.
ex.cn: 你也许不喜欢广告，但它能促销。

ex.en: It is quality not price that sells our products.
ex.cn: 我们的产品销路好，靠的是质量，而不是价格。

senses.def: to persuade sb that sth is a good idea, service, product, etc.; to persuade sb that you are the right person for a job, position, etc.
senses.chn: 推荐；推销；自荐；自我推销

ex.en: Now we have to try and sell the idea to management.
ex.cn: 现在，我们必须设法说服管理层采纳这个意见。

ex.en: You really have to sell yourself at a job interview.
ex.cn: 应聘面试的时候，你真得推销你自己。

senses.def: to accept money or a reward from sb for doing sth that is against your principles
to be very enthusiastic about sth
to have sex with sb in exchange for money
to give poor or unfair treatment to sb you have promised to help

senses.chn: （尤指已退休）年纪大的，老年的

ex.en: Get one third off rail fares with a senior railcard.
ex.cn: 持有老年火车通行优惠卡可减免三分之一车费。

ex.en: senior discounts/concessions
ex.cn: 老年折扣／优惠

senses.def: used after the name of a man who has the same name as his son, to avoid confusion
senses.chn: （父子同名时，加在父亲的名字前）老，大

senses.def: for children over the age of 11 or 13
senses.chn: 中等的，中学的（招收 11 或 13 岁以上学生）

senses.def: connected with the last year in high school or college

ex.en: the senior prom
ex.cn: 毕业年级舞会

senses.def: a person who is older than sb else

ex.en: She was ten years his senior.
ex.cn: 她比他大十岁。

ex.en: My brother is my senior by two years.
ex.cn: 我哥哥比我大两岁。

senses.def: a person who is higher in rank or status
senses.chn: 级别（或地位）较高者；上级；上司

ex.en: She felt unappreciated both by her colleagues and her seniors.
ex.cn: 她觉得无论同事还是上司都不赏识她。

senses.def: adults or people who have reached an advanced level
senses.chn: 资深成人运动员；高水平运动员

ex.en: tennis coaching for juniors and seniors
ex.cn: 初、高级网球训练

senses.def: a child at a senior school; an older child in a school
(in the US and some other countries) a student in the last year at a high school or college
senses.chn: （美国等若干国家高中和大学的）毕业班学生

ex.en: high school seniors
ex.cn: 高中毕业班学生

senses.def: an older person, especially sb who has retired from work. People often call sb a 'senior citizen' to avoid saying that they are old or using the expression 'old-age pensioner'.
senses.chn: 资深公民，老年人（委婉说法，尤指退休者）

senses.def: a room used for social activities by teaching staff in a college or university
senses.chn: （大学的）教师联谊活动室，教师交谊厅

senses.def: (in the US) a school for young people between the ages of 14 and 18
the fact of being older or of a higher rank than others

ex.en: a position of seniority
ex.cn: 高级职位

senses.def: the rank that you have in a company because of the length of time you have worked there

ex.en: a lawyer with five years' seniority
ex.cn: 有五年从业经验的律师

ex.en: Should promotion be based on merit or seniority?
ex.cn: 提拔一个人应当看业绩，还是看资历？

senses.def: an occasion when sb forgets sth, or does not think clearly (thought to be typical of what happens when people get older)
senses.chn: 年长表现（幽默表达，指人失忆、忘事、糊涂的状况）

ex.en: It was an important meeting and a bad time to have a senior moment.
ex.cn: 那是个重要会议，可不能犯糊涂。

senses.def: a feeling that you get when sth affects your body

ex.en: a tingling/burning, etc. sensation
ex.cn: 刺痛、烧灼等的感觉

ex.en: I had a sensation of falling, as if in a dream.
ex.cn: 我有一种坠落的感觉，像在梦中似的。

senses.def: the ability to feel through your sense of touch

ex.en: She seemed to have lost all sensation in her arms.
ex.cn: 她的两条胳膊好像完全失去知觉了。

senses.def: a general feeling or impression that is difficult to explain; an experience or a memory
senses.chn: 直觉；莫名其妙的感觉；经历；回忆

ex.en: He had the eerie sensation of being watched.
ex.cn: 他不安地感到有人在监视他。

ex.en: When I arrived, I had the sensation that she had been expecting me.
ex.cn: 我到那儿后，感觉到她一直在等着我。

senses.def: very great surprise, excitement, or interest among a lot of people; the person or the thing that causes this surprise
senses.chn: 轰动；哗然；引起轰动的人（或事物）

ex.en: News of his arrest caused a sensation.
ex.cn: 他被捕的消息引起了轰动。

ex.en: The band became a sensation overnight.
ex.cn: 一夜之间，这支乐队名声大振。

senses.def: causing great surprise, excitement, or interest

ex.en: The result was a sensational 4–1 victory.
ex.cn: 比赛结果是轰动性的，以 4:1 狂胜对手。

senses.def: trying to get your interest by presenting facts or events as worse or more shocking than they really are
senses.chn: 哗众取宠的；耸人听闻的

senses.def: extremely good; wonderful

ex.en: You look sensational in that dress!
ex.cn: 你穿这件连衣裙漂亮极了！

senses.def: a way of getting people's interest by using shocking words or by presenting facts and events as worse or more shocking than they really are
senses.chn: （指行文或报道）耸人听闻，哗众取宠

senses.def: to exaggerate a story so that it seems more exciting or shocking than it really is
senses.chn: 故作耸人听闻地夸张；大肆渲染

senses.def: one of the five powers (sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch) that your body uses to get information about the world around you
senses.chn: 感觉官能（即视、听、嗅、味、触五觉）

ex.en: the five senses
ex.cn: 五种感觉官能

ex.en: Dogs have a keen (= strong) sense of smell.
ex.cn: 狗的嗅觉很灵敏。

ex.en: the sense organs (= eyes, ears, nose, etc.)
ex.cn: 感觉器官

ex.en: I could hardly believe the evidence of my own senses (= what I could see, hear, etc.).
ex.cn: 我简直不敢相信自己的感觉。

ex.en: The mixture of sights, smells and sounds around her made her senses reel.
ex.cn: 四周的景象、气味和声音纷至沓来，使她晕头转向。

senses.def: a feeling about sth important

ex.en: He felt an overwhelming sense of loss.
ex.cn: 他感到非常失落。

ex.en: a strong sense of purpose/identity/duty, etc.
ex.cn: 强烈的目标感、很强的身份认同感、很强的责任感等

ex.en: Helmets can give cyclists a false sense of security.
ex.cn: 头盔能给骑自行车的人一种虚假的安全感。

ex.en: I had the sense that he was worried about something.
ex.cn: 我感觉他有心事。

senses.def: an understanding about sth; an ability to judge sth

ex.en: One of the most important things in a partner is a sense of humour (= the ability to find things funny or make people laugh).
ex.cn: 作为一个生活伴侣，最重要的素质之一是幽默感。

ex.en: He has a very good sense of direction (= finds the way to a place easily).
ex.cn: 他的方向感很强。

ex.en: She has lost all sense of direction in her life.
ex.cn: 她完全丧失了生活的方向。

ex.en: Always try to keep a sense of proportion (= of the relative importance of different things).
ex.cn: 对事情随时都要把握好孰轻孰重。

ex.en: a sense of rhythm/timing
ex.cn: 节奏感；时机感

ex.en: Alex doesn't have any dress sense (= does not know which clothes look attractive).
ex.cn: 亚历克斯对服装毫无鉴赏力。

senses.def: good understanding and judgement; knowledge of what is sensible or practical behaviour
senses.chn: 见识；良好的判断；清醒的认识

ex.en: You should have the sense to take advice when it is offered.
ex.cn: 你要知道好歹，别人给你忠告，就该接受。

ex.en: There's no sense in (= it is not sensible) worrying about it now.
ex.cn: 现在大可不必为那件事忧虑。

ex.en: Can't you talk sense (= say sth sensible)?
ex.cn: 你就不能说点正经的？

ex.en: There's a lot of sense in what Mary says.
ex.cn: 玛丽说得很在理。

senses.def: a normal state of mind; the ability to think clearly
senses.chn: 健全的心智；清醒的思维能力；理智

ex.en: If she threatens to leave, it should bring him to his senses.
ex.cn: 假如她威胁着要走，说不定他会清醒过来。

ex.en: He waited for Dora to come to her senses and return.
ex.cn: 他盼着多拉冷静下来后回来。

ex.en: Are you out of your senses? You'll be killed!
ex.cn: 你疯了吗？你会丢了性命的！

ex.en: Why does she want to marry him? She must have taken leave of her senses.
ex.cn: 她怎么会要嫁给他呢？她准是脑子有毛病了。

senses.def: the meaning that a word or phrase has; a way of understanding sth
senses.chn: 意义；含义；理解…的方式；看待…的角度

ex.en: The word 'love' is used in different senses by different people.
ex.cn: “爱” 这个字不同的人用来表示不同的意思。

ex.en: education in its broadest sense
ex.cn: 最广泛意义上的教育

ex.en: He was a true friend, in every sense of the word (= in every possible way).
ex.cn: 无论从哪个角度讲，他都是个真正的朋友。

ex.en: In a sense (= in one way) it doesn't matter any more.
ex.cn: 从某种意义上说，这事已无关紧要了。

ex.en: In some senses (= in one or more ways) the criticisms were justified.
ex.cn: 在一定意义上，那些批评意见是有道理的。

ex.en: In no sense can the issue be said to be resolved.
ex.cn: 无论如何这个问题都不能说已经解决了。

senses.def: to try and persuade sb to stop behaving in a stupid way, sometimes using rough or violent methods
senses.chn: 开导某人别干傻事；强使某人理智行事

senses.def: to have a meaning that you can easily understand

ex.en: This sentence doesn't make sense.
ex.cn: 这个句子不通。

senses.def: to be a sensible thing to do

ex.en: It makes sense to buy the most up-to-date version.
ex.cn: 买最新的版本是明智的。

ex.en: There are strict medicals for pilots, which makes good sense.
ex.cn: 飞行员要接受严格的体检，这是很有道理的。

senses.def: to be easy to understand or explain
senses.chn: 表述清楚；易于理解；道理明显

ex.en: John wasn't making much sense on the phone.
ex.cn: 约翰在电话上说得不大清楚。

ex.en: Who would send me all these flowers? It makes no sense.
ex.cn: 谁会给我送这么多花呢？真不可思议。

senses.def: to understand sth that is difficult or has no clear meaning
senses.chn: 理解，弄懂（不易理解的事物）

senses.def: to start to be sensible or reasonable
senses.chn: 变得明智起来；开始明白事理

senses.def: a feeling or understanding that an event is important or special

ex.en: Candles on the table gave the evening a sense of occasion.
ex.cn: 桌上点了一些蜡烛，使得那个晚上有一种特别的气氛。

senses.def: to start behaving as if you are crazy
to become aware of sth even though you cannot see it, hear it, etc.

ex.en: Sensing danger, they started to run.
ex.cn: 他们感到有危险，撒腿就跑。

ex.en: Lisa sensed that he did not believe her.
ex.cn: 莉萨意识到他不相信她。

ex.en: Thomas, she sensed, could convince anyone of anything.
ex.cn: 她觉得，托马斯能说服任何人相信任何事。

ex.en: He sensed someone moving around behind him.
ex.cn: 他感觉有人在他后面走动。

ex.en: He sensed something move in the bushes.
ex.cn: 他察觉到灌木丛中有什么东西在动。

ex.en: She could sense how nervous he was.
ex.cn: 她能感觉到他有多紧张。

senses.def: to discover and record sth

ex.en: equipment that senses the presence of toxic gases
ex.cn: 检测有毒气体的设备

example.en: Sensing danger, they started to run.
example.cn: 他们感到有危险，撒腿就跑。

example.en: Lisa sensed that he did not believe her.
example.cn: 莉萨意识到他不相信她。

example.en: He sensed someone moving around behind him.
example.cn: 他感觉有人在他后面走动。

example.en: He sensed something move in the bushes.
example.cn: 他察觉到灌木丛中有什么东西在动。

example.en: She could sense how nervous he was.
example.cn: 她能感觉到他有多紧张。

senses.def: having no meaning or purpose

ex.en: senseless violence
ex.cn: 无谓的暴力

ex.en: His death was a senseless waste of life.
ex.cn: 他白浪费了性命，死得毫无意义。

ex.en: It's senseless to continue any further.
ex.cn: 再继续下去毫无意义。

senses.def: unconscious

ex.en: He was beaten senseless.
ex.cn: 他被打昏了。

ex.en: She drank herself senseless.
ex.cn: 她喝得不省人事。

senses.def: not using good judgement

ex.en: The police blamed senseless drivers who went too fast.
ex.cn: 警察责怪莽撞司机开快车。

senses.def: the ability to experience and understand deep feelings, especially in art and literature
senses.chn: （尤指文艺方面的）感受能力，鉴赏力，敏感性

ex.en: a man of impeccable manners, charm and sensibility
ex.cn: 一个有魅力、懂感情、举止无可挑剔的男人

ex.en: artistic sensibility
ex.cn: 艺术鉴赏力

senses.def: a person's feelings, especially when the person is easily offended or influenced by sth
senses.chn: （尤指易受伤害或影响的）感情

ex.en: The article offended her religious sensibilities.
ex.cn: 那篇文章伤害了她的宗教感情。

senses.def: able to make good judgements based on reason and experience rather than emotion; practical
senses.chn: 明智的；理智的；合理的；切合实际的

ex.en: She's a sensible sort of person.
ex.cn: 她属于那种通情达理的人。

ex.en: I think that's a very sensible idea.
ex.cn: 我看这个主意很妥当。

ex.en: Say something sensible.
ex.cn: 说点正经的。

ex.en: I think the sensible thing would be to take a taxi home.
ex.cn: 我想还是坐出租车回家比较好。

ex.en: She gave me some very sensible advice.
ex.cn: 她给了我一些非常合理的建议。

ex.en: It wasn't very sensible to go out on your own so late at night.
ex.cn: 这么晚一个人单独外出是不太明智的。

senses.def: useful rather than fashionable

ex.en: sensible shoes
ex.cn: 朴实而舒适的鞋

senses.def: aware of sth

ex.en: I am sensible of the fact that mathematics is not a popular subject.
ex.cn: 我知道数学课不受欢迎。

senses.def: aware of and able to understand other people and their feelings
senses.chn: 体贴的；体恤的；善解人意的

ex.en: a sensitive and caring man
ex.cn: 体贴的男人

ex.en: She is very sensitive to other people's feelings.
ex.cn: 她很能体谅他人的感情。

senses.def: able to understand art, music and literature and to express yourself through them
senses.chn: 感觉敏锐的；艺术感觉好的；有悟性的

ex.en: an actor's sensitive reading of the poem
ex.cn: 演员对那首诗富有表现力的朗诵

ex.en: a sensitive portrait
ex.cn: 栩栩如生的画像

senses.def: easily offended or upset
senses.chn: 易生气的；易被惹恼的；神经过敏的

ex.en: You're far too sensitive.
ex.cn: 你也太敏感了。

ex.en: He's very sensitive about his weight.
ex.cn: 他很忌讳别人说他胖。

ex.en: She's very sensitive to criticism.
ex.cn: 她一听批评就急。

senses.def: that you have to treat with great care because it may offend people or make them angry or embarrassed

ex.en: Health care is a politically sensitive issue.
ex.cn: 医疗卫生是一个政治敏感问题。

senses.def: reacting quickly or more than usual to sth

ex.en: sensitive areas of the body
ex.cn: 身体的敏感区

ex.en: My teeth are very sensitive to cold food.
ex.cn: 我的牙齿对冷食过敏。

ex.en: She gave me some very sensible advice.
ex.cn: 她给了我一些非常合理的建议。

ex.en: It wasn't very sensible to go out on your own so late at night.
ex.cn: 这么晚一个人单独外出是不太明智的。

ex.en: a soap for sensitive skin
ex.cn: 敏感皮肤用的肥皂

ex.en: This movie may upset a sensitive child.
ex.cn: 这部影片可能使敏感的孩子感到难过。

senses.def: able to measure very small changes

ex.en: a sensitive instrument
ex.cn: 灵敏的仪器

ex.en: The Stock Exchange is very sensitive to political change.
ex.cn: 证券市场对政局变化非常敏感。

senses.def: to mention a subject that makes sb feel angry, upset, embarrassed, etc.

ex.en: You touched a raw nerve when you mentioned his first wife.
ex.cn: 你谈起他的第一任妻子，这就触到了他的痛处。

example.en: She is very sensitive to other people's feelings.
example.cn: 她很能体谅他人的感情。

example.en: He's very sensitive about his weight.
example.cn: 他很忌讳别人说他胖。

senses.def: the ability to understand other people's feelings

ex.en: sensitivity to the needs of children
ex.cn: 体察孩子们的需要

ex.en: She pointed out with tact and sensitivity exactly where he had gone wrong.
ex.cn: 她明确指出了他的错误所在，既委婉又体贴。

senses.def: the ability to understand art, music and literature and to express yourself through them

ex.en: She played with great sensitivity.
ex.cn: 她的表演很有悟性。

senses.def: a tendency to be easily offended or upset by sth
senses.chn: 容易生气；易被惹恼；敏感

ex.en: He's a mixture of anger and sensitivity.
ex.cn: 他气量小又太敏感。

ex.en: She was blind to the feelings and sensitivities of other people.
ex.cn: 她无视他人的情感和敏感之处。

senses.def: the fact of needing to be treated very carefully because it may offend or upset people

ex.en: Confidentiality is important because of the sensitivity of the information.
ex.cn: 这情报很敏感，务必保密。

senses.def: the quality of reacting quickly or more than usual to sth

ex.en: food sensitivity
ex.cn: 食物过敏

ex.en: allergies and sensitivities
ex.cn: 过敏反应

ex.en: Some children develop a sensitivity to cow's milk.
ex.cn: 有的孩子对牛奶过敏。

ex.en: The eyes of some fish have a greater sensitivity to light than ours do.
ex.cn: 有些鱼的眼睛比人类的眼睛对光更敏感。

senses.def: the ability to measure very small changes

ex.en: the sensitivity of the test
ex.cn: 测试的灵敏度

senses.def: to make sb/sth more aware of sth, especially a problem or sth bad
senses.chn: 使敏感（尤指对问题或不好的事）；使意识到

ex.en: People are becoming more sensitized to the dangers threatening the environment.
ex.cn: 人们越来越意识到危害环境的各种因素。

senses.def: to make sb/sth sensitive to physical or chemical changes, or to a particular substance
a device that can react to light, heat, pressure, etc. in order to make a machine, etc. do sth or show sth
senses.chn: （探测光、热、压力等的）传感器，敏感元件

ex.en: security lights with an infrared sensor (= that come on when a person is near them)
ex.cn: 带红外线传感器的保安灯

senses.def: connected with your physical senses

ex.en: sensory organs
ex.cn: 感觉器官

ex.en: sensory deprivation
ex.cn: 感觉丧失

senses.def: connected with your physical feelings; giving pleasure to your physical senses, especially sexual pleasure
senses.chn: 感官的；肉欲的；愉悦感官的

ex.en: sensual pleasure
ex.cn: 感官之乐

senses.def: suggesting an interest in physical pleasure, especially sexual pleasure
senses.chn: 喜欢感官享受的；耽于肉欲的

ex.en: sensual lips
ex.cn: 性感的嘴唇

ex.en: He was darkly sensual and mysterious.
ex.cn: 他耽于肉欲，而且让人捉摸不透。

senses.def: giving pleasure to your senses

ex.en: sensuous music
ex.cn: 悦耳的音乐

ex.en: I'm drawn to the poetic, sensuous qualities of her paintings.
ex.cn: 我喜欢她的画中那种充满诗意、赏心悦目的特性。

senses.def: suggesting an interest in sexual pleasure

ex.en: his full sensuous lips
ex.cn: 他的丰满性感的嘴唇

senses.def: a set of words expressing a statement, a question or an order, usually containing a subject and a verb. In written English sentences begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop/period ( . ), a question mark ( ? ) or an exclamation mark/exclamation point ( ! ).
the punishment given by a court

ex.en: a jail/prison sentence
ex.cn: 判处监禁

ex.en: a light/heavy sentence
ex.cn: 轻判；重判

ex.en: to be under sentence of death
ex.cn: 被判处死刑

ex.en: The judge passed sentence (= said what the punishment would be).
ex.cn: 法官宣布了判决。

ex.en: The prisoner has served (= completed) his sentence and will be released tomorrow.
ex.cn: 犯人已服刑期满，明天将获释。

senses.def: to say officially in court that sb is to receive a particular punishment

ex.en: to be sentenced to death/life imprisonment/three years in prison
ex.cn: 被判死刑／终身监禁／三年徒刑

senses.def: an adverb that expresses the speaker's attitude towards, or gives the subject of, the whole of the rest of the sentence

ex.en: In 'Luckily, I didn't tell anyone' and 'Financially, we have a serious problem', 'luckily' and 'financially' are sentence adverbs.
ex.cn: 在句子 Luckily, I didn't tell anyone 和 Financially, we have a serious problem 中，luckily 和 financially 是句副词。

senses.def: a person who decides on the punishment for sb who is guilty of a crime

ex.en: The judge was considered a tough sentencer.
ex.cn: 那位法官公认量刑严厉。

senses.def: trying to sound important or intelligent, especially by expressing moral judgements
senses.chn: 多格言警句的；（尤指）说教式的

senses.def: able to see or feel things through the senses
senses.chn: 有感觉能力的；有知觉力的

ex.en: Man is a sentient being.
ex.cn: 人是有感觉的生物。

senses.def: a feeling or an opinion, especially one based on emotions

ex.en: the spread of nationalist sentiments
ex.cn: 民族主义情绪的传播

ex.en: This is a sentiment I wholeheartedly agree with.
ex.cn: 这种观点我完全赞同。

ex.en: Public sentiment is against any change to the law.
ex.cn: 公众的意见是反对对该法律作任何修改。

senses.def: feelings of pity, romantic love, sadness, etc. which may be too strong or not appropriate
senses.chn: （失之过度或不恰当的）伤感，柔情，哀伤

ex.en: There was no fatherly affection, no display of sentiment.
ex.cn: 没有温情脉脉的父爱流露。

ex.en: There is no room for sentiment in business.
ex.cn: 在生意场上心肠不能软。
