ex.cn: 我把他的投诉放到一边，等时间充裕些再处理。

ex.en: Leaving that to one side for a moment, are there any other questions?
ex.cn: 把这个先放一放，还有没有别的问题？

senses.def: to support and agree with sb
senses.chn: 站在某人一边；和某人观点一致

ex.en: I'm definitely on your side in this.
ex.cn: 在这个问题上，我毫不含糊地站在你这一边。

ex.en: Whose side are you on anyway?
ex.cn: 你到底赞成谁的观点呢？

senses.def: the aspect of a situation that is the opposite of or contrasts with the one you have been talking about
close together and facing in the same direction

ex.en: There were two children ahead, walking side by side.
ex.cn: 前面有两个孩子肩并肩走着。

senses.def: together, without any difficulties

ex.en: We have been using both systems, side by side, for two years.
ex.cn: 两年来，两套系统我们一直同时使用，互不影响。

ex.en: The two communities exist happily side by side.
ex.cn: 两个群体和睦共处，相安无事。

senses.def: to express support for sb in a disagreement
senses.chn: 表示支持一方；表明立场

ex.en: She didn't think it was wise to take sides in their argument.
ex.cn: 对于他们的辩论，她觉得向着谁都不明智。

senses.def: to speak to sb in private, especially in order to warn or tell them about sth
senses.chn: 把某人拉到一边（悄悄说话）

senses.def: before a particular time, event, age, etc.

ex.en: They aren't likely to arrive this side of midnight.
ex.cn: 午夜之前他们不大可能赶到。

senses.def: to be bad-tempered for the whole day for no particular reason
senses.chn: （无缘由地）一起床就整天情绪不好

senses.def: the boyfriend or girlfriend of sb who is already married or in a steady sexual relationship with sb else
to be cheerful or positive about a bad situation, for example by thinking only of the advantages and not the disadvantages
senses.chn: （对坏情况）持乐观态度，看到光明的一面

senses.def: used to introduce the good points about sb/sth, especially after the bad points have been mentioned
senses.chn: （尤用于提及缺点之后）就优点方面而言

senses.def: on the woman's side of the family
to show too much of a good quality

ex.en: I thought it was better to err on the side of caution (= to be too careful rather than take a risk).
ex.cn: 我认为宁可过于谨慎也不要冒风险。

senses.def: said about people who never seem happy with what they have and always think that other people have a better situation than they have
senses.chn: 草是那边绿；这山望着那山高

senses.def: to know where you can get an advantage for yourself
to be forced to change from feeling pleased or satisfied to feeling disappointed or annoyed
senses.chn: 转喜为忧；得意变成失意；笑脸变为苦脸

senses.def: with the top part turned to the top; in the correct, normal position
senses.chn: 正面朝上；位置正确；在正常位置

ex.en: I dropped my toast, but luckily it fell right side up.
ex.cn: 我把烤面包掉在地上，但幸好它正面朝上。

senses.def: being especially careful; taking no risks

ex.en: I took some extra cash just to be on the safe side.
ex.cn: 我多带了一些现金，以防万一。

senses.def: to laugh a lot at sb/sth
a person or thing that repeatedly annoys sb or stops them from doing sth
senses.chn: 不断让人烦心的人（或事）；肉中刺；眼中钉

senses.def: used to say that sb can wait for sth to happen or can wait before doing sth
senses.chn: 有的是时间（等待某事发生或做某事）

senses.def: used to talk about two ways of looking at the same situation
from or living in a poor area or part of town
senses.chn: 来自（城里的）贫民区；住在贫穷的地区（或城区）

senses.def: in trouble with the police
to support one person or group in an argument against sb else
senses.chn: 支持某人（反对…）；和某人站在一起（反对…）

ex.en: The kids always sided with their mother against me.
ex.cn: 孩子们总是和妈妈站在一边，跟我唱对台戏。

senses.def: a short article in a newspaper or magazine that is printed next to a main article, and gives extra information
a narrow area on the side of a computer screen or a web page that is separate from the main part of the page
senses.chn: （电脑屏幕或网页的）侧边栏，边注栏

senses.def: an issue, event, action, etc. that is less important than the main one
senses.chn: 次要问题（或事件、行动等）

ex.en: The promoter provided free concerts as a sidebar to the festival.
ex.cn: 筹办单位举办免费音乐会为节日助兴。

senses.def: (in a court of law) a discussion between the judge and the lawyers that the jury cannot hear
senses.chn: （法庭上）旁厅会议（法官和律师之间避开陪审团的小会）

senses.def: a piece of furniture in a dining room for putting food on before it is served, with drawers for storing knives, forks, etc.
hair that grows down the sides of a man's face in front of his ears
close together and facing in the same direction

ex.en: There were two children ahead, walking side by side.
ex.cn: 前面有两个孩子肩并肩走着。

senses.def: together, without any difficulties

ex.en: We have been using both systems, side by side, for two years.
ex.cn: 两年来，两套系统我们一直同时使用，互不影响。

ex.en: The two communities exist happily side by side.
ex.cn: 两个群体和睦共处，相安无事。

senses.def: a small vehicle attached to the side of a motorcycle in which a passenger can ride
a small amount of food, for example a salad, served with the main course of a meal
an extra and usually bad effect that a drug has on you, as well as curing illness or pain
an unexpected result of a situation or course of action that happens as well as the result you were aiming for
to kick a ball with the inside part of your foot
an issue that is less important than the main issue, and may take attention away from it
a person who helps another more important or more intelligent person

ex.en: Batman and his young sidekick Robin
ex.cn: 蝙蝠侠和他的年轻助手罗宾

senses.def: a piece of information, usually given by accident or in connection with another subject, that helps you to understand sb/sth
senses.chn: 意外线索；侧面了解的情况；间接消息

senses.def: either of a pair of small lights at the front of a vehicle
an activity that you do as well as your main job in order to earn extra money
the lines along the two long sides of a sports field, tennis court , etc. that mark the outer edges; the area just outside these
senses.chn: （球场等的）边线，两侧场外区域

ex.en: The coach stood on the sidelines yelling instructions to the players.
ex.cn: 教练站在场外，大声指挥运动员。

senses.def: watching sth but not actually involved in it
senses.chn: 从旁观者的角度；置身局外

ex.en: He was content to watch from the sidelines as his wife built up a successful business empire.
ex.cn: 他满足于站在一旁，看妻子一步步地建立起一个成功的商业帝国。

senses.def: to prevent sb from playing in a team, especially because of an injury
senses.chn: 使退出比赛，使下场（尤指由于受伤）

ex.en: The player has been sidelined by a knee injury.
ex.cn: 这名队员因膝部受伤而下场。

senses.def: to prevent sb from having an important part in sth that other people are doing
senses.chn: 把…排除在核心之外；使靠边

ex.en: The vice-president is increasingly being sidelined.
ex.cn: 副总统被日益排挤到权力中心之外。

senses.def: out of the corner of your eye, especially in a way that is secret or disapproving
senses.chn: 侧眼偷看的；斜着眼看的；睨视的

ex.en: She cast a sidelong glance at Eric to see if he had noticed her blunder.
ex.cn: 她偷偷斜扫了埃里克一眼，看他有没有留意到她的错误。

senses.def: coming from the side rather than from the front or back

ex.en: The car hit us side-on.
ex.cn: 那辆车从侧面撞了我们。

senses.def: a small amount of food ordered in a restaurant to go with the main dish, but served separately

ex.en: a side order of fries
ex.cn: 另点的一份炸薯条

senses.def: a small plate used for bread or other food that goes with a meal
related to the stars that are far away, not the sun or planets
a smaller and less important road leading off a main road
if you ride a horse side-saddle, you ride with both your legs on the same side of the horse
a salad served with the main course of a meal
a separate small show or attraction at a fair or circus where you pay to see a performance or take part in a game
senses.chn: （游园会或马戏中穿插的）小节目，杂耍

senses.def: an activity or event that is much less important than the main activity or event
extremely funny; making people laugh a lot
senses.chn: 滑稽透顶的；令人捧腹的

ex.en: side-splitting anecdotes
ex.cn: 滑稽可笑的奇闻逸事

senses.def: to avoid answering a question or dealing with a problem

ex.en: Did you notice how she neatly sidestepped the question?
ex.cn: 你有没有注意到她多么巧妙地回避了那个问题？

senses.def: to avoid sth, for example being hit, by stepping to one side
senses.chn: 横跨一步躲过；侧移一步闪过

ex.en: He cleverly sidestepped the tackle.
ex.cn: 他巧妙地一晃，绕过阻截队员。

senses.def: a less important street leading off a road in a town
a hit from the side

ex.en: a sideswipe by a truck
ex.cn: 卡车的擦撞

senses.def: a critical comment made about sb/sth while you are talking about sb/sth completely different
senses.chn: 借机抨击；借题发挥的批评

ex.en: It was a good speech, but he couldn't resist taking a sideswipe at his opponent.
ex.cn: 他的讲话不错，可他还是忍不住借机把对手抨击了一番。

senses.def: to make sb start to talk about or do sth that is different from the main thing that they are supposed to be talking about or doing
senses.chn: 使转变话题；使转移目标

ex.en: I was supposed to be writing a letter but I'm afraid I got sidetracked.
ex.cn: 我本来应该在写信，但后来恐怕是分心干别的去了。

senses.def: a view of sth from the side

ex.en: The picture shows a side view of the house.
ex.cn: 这张图是房子的侧面。

senses.def: a flat part at the side of a road for people to walk on
an artist who draws pictures in chalk on the pavement/ sidewalk , hoping to get money from people who pass
senses.chn: 街头画家，马路画家（在人行道上用粉笔作画讨钱）

senses.def: to, towards or from the side

ex.en: a sideward glance
ex.cn: 斜视的一眼

senses.def: to, towards or from the side

ex.en: He looked sideways at her.
ex.cn: 他斜着眼看她。

ex.en: The truck skidded sideways across the road.
ex.cn: 卡车横着滑到公路另一侧。

ex.en: He has been moved sideways (= moved to another job at the same level as before, not higher or lower).
ex.cn: 他平级调动工作了。

senses.def: with one side facing forwards

ex.en: She sat sideways on the chair.
ex.cn: 她侧坐在椅子上。

senses.def: to surprise or shock sb so much that they are unable to react immediately
senses.chn: 使某人惊讶得不知所措（或目瞪口呆）

senses.def: hair growing on the sides of a man's face down to, but not on, the chin
a poisonous N American snake that moves sideways across the desert by throwing its body in an S shape
senses.chn: 侧进蛇，角响尾蛇（北美沙漠地带毒蛇）

senses.def: a short track beside a main railway/railroad line, where trains can stand when they are not being used
material used to cover and protect the outside walls of buildings
to walk somewhere in a shy or uncertain way as if you do not want to be noticed
senses.chn: 犹犹豫豫地走；羞怯地走；悄悄地走

ex.en: She sidled up to me and whispered something in my ear.
ex.cn: 她悄悄走上前来，对我耳语了几句。

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'sudden infant death syndrome' (the sudden death while sleeping of a baby which appears to be healthy)
a military operation in which an army tries to capture a town by surrounding it and stopping the supply of food, etc. to the people inside
senses.chn: （军队对城镇的）围困，包围，围攻，封锁

ex.en: the siege of Troy
ex.cn: 特洛伊之围

ex.en: The siege was finally lifted (= ended) after six months.
ex.cn: 六个月后封锁最终解除了。

ex.en: The police placed the city centre under a virtual state of siege (= it was hard to get in or out).
ex.cn: 警方可说是已封锁了市中心。

senses.def: a situation in which the police surround a building where people are living or hiding, in order to make them come out
surrounded by an army or the police in a siege
being criticized all the time or put under pressure by problems, questions, etc.
senses.chn: 一再遭到批评的；受…困扰的

senses.def: to begin a siege of a town, building, etc.
senses.chn: 围困，围攻（城镇、建筑物等）

senses.def: to surround a building, especially in order to speak to or question the person or people living or working there
senses.chn: 包围（某建筑物，旨在和里面的人对话或质询）

senses.def: a feeling that you are surrounded by enemies and must protect yourself
senses.chn: 受围心态（感觉周围都是敌人因而必须自卫）

senses.def: the standard unit for measuring how well an object conducts electricity
a type of dark yellow or red clay used for giving colour to paints, etc.
a long range of steep mountains with sharp points, especially in Spain and America
senses.chn: （尤指西班牙和美洲的）锯齿状山脉

ex.en: the Sierra Nevada
ex.cn: 内华达山脉

senses.def: a country in western Africa
(a person) from Sierra Leone
senses.chn: 塞拉利昂人；塞拉利昂的；塞拉利昂人的

senses.def: a rest or sleep taken in the early afternoon, especially in hot countries
senses.chn: （尤指在气候炎热的国家的）午睡，午休

ex.en: to have/take a siesta
ex.cn: 睡午觉

senses.def: a tool for separating solids from liquids or larger solids from smaller solids, made of a wire or plastic net attached to a ring. The liquid or small pieces pass through the net but the larger pieces do not.
to have a very bad memory; to forget things easily
to put sth through a sieve
a unit for measuring the effect of radiation
senses.chn: 希沃特（辐射效果单位，简称希）

senses.def: to put flour or some other fine substance through a sieve/ sifter
senses.chn: 筛（面粉或颗粒较细的物质）

ex.en: Sift the flour into a bowl.
ex.cn: 把面粉筛到碗里。

senses.def: to examine sth very carefully in order to decide what is important or useful or to find sth important

ex.en: We will sift every scrap of evidence.
ex.cn: 我们将细查每一点证据。

ex.en: Crash investigators have been sifting through the wreckage of the aircraft.
ex.cn: 调查坠机事件的专家一直在仔细检查飞机残骸。

senses.def: to separate sth from a group of things

ex.en: She looked quickly through the papers, sifting out from the pile anything that looked interesting.
ex.cn: 她很快地翻了一下那摞文件，把所有看着有趣的东西都拣了出来。

senses.def: to remove sth that you do not want from a substance by putting it through a sieve

ex.en: Put the flour through a sieve to sift out the lumps.
ex.cn: 把面粉过筛，除去面块。

senses.def: to separate sth, usually sth you do not want, from a group of things

ex.en: We need to sift out the applications that have no chance of succeeding.
ex.cn: 我们需要剔出那些成功无望的申请。

example.en: Crash investigators have been sifting through the wreckage of the aircraft.
example.cn: 调查坠机事件的专家一直在仔细检查飞机残骸。

senses.def: a small sieve used for sifting flour
a container with a lot of small holes in the top, used for shaking flour or sugar onto things
senses.chn: 撒…瓶（盖上有许多小孔，用于撒面粉等粉状物或糖）

ex.en: a sugar sifter
ex.cn: 撒糖瓶

senses.def: to take and then let out a long deep breath that can be heard, to show that you are disappointed, sad, tired, etc.

ex.en: He sighed deeply at the thought.
ex.cn: 想到这里，他深深叹了口气。

ex.en: She sighed with relief that it was all over.
ex.cn: 事情总算全都过去了，她轻松地舒了一口气。

senses.def: to say sth with a sigh

ex.en: 'Oh well, better luck next time,' she sighed.
ex.cn: “唉，就这样了，但愿下一次运气好些。” 她叹息道。

senses.def: to make a long sound like a sigh
an act or the sound of sighing

ex.en: to give/heave/let out a sigh
ex.cn: 发出叹息

ex.en: a deep sigh
ex.cn: 深深的叹息

ex.en: 'I'll wait,' he said with a sigh.
ex.cn: “我就等呗。” 他叹口气说。

ex.en: We all breathed a sigh of relief when it was over.
ex.cn: 事情过去了，我们大家都松了一口气。

example.en: She sighed with relief that it was all over.
example.cn: 事情总算全都过去了，她轻松地舒了一口气。

senses.def: the ability to see

ex.en: to lose your sight (= to become blind)
ex.cn: 失明

ex.en: She has very good sight.
ex.cn: 她的视力很好。

ex.en: The disease has affected her sight.
ex.cn: 这种病影响了她的视力。

ex.en: He has very little sight in his right eye.
ex.cn: 他右眼视力极弱。

senses.def: the act of seeing sb/sth

ex.en: After ten days at sea, we had our first sight of land.
ex.cn: 我们在海上航行十天之后，首次看见陆地。

ex.en: I have been known to faint at the sight of blood.
ex.cn: 大家都知道，我看到血就会昏倒。

ex.en: The soldiers were given orders to shoot on sight (= as soon as they saw sb).
ex.cn: 士兵得到命令，见人就射击。

ex.en: She caught sight of a car in the distance.
ex.cn: 她看见远处有一辆汽车。

senses.def: the area or distance within which sb can see or sth can be seen

ex.en: There was no one in sight.
ex.cn: 一个人也看不见。

ex.en: At last we came in sight of a few houses.
ex.cn: 最后，我们看到了几座房屋。

ex.en: A bicycle came into sight on the main road.
ex.cn: 大路上出现了一辆自行车。

ex.en: The end is in sight (= will happen soon).
ex.cn: 结局已现端倪。

ex.en: Leave any valuables in your car out of sight.
ex.cn: 把贵重物品留在车里看不见的地方。

ex.en: Keep out of sight (= stay where you cannot be seen).
ex.cn: 不要露面。

senses.def: a thing that you see or can see
senses.chn: 看见（或看得见）的事物；景象；情景

ex.en: It's a spectacular sight as the flamingos lift into the air.
ex.cn: 一群红鹳飞向空中，景象十分壮观。

ex.en: The museum attempts to recreate the sights and sounds of wartime Britain.
ex.cn: 博物馆试图再现战时英国的情景。

ex.en: He was a sorry sight, soaked to the skin and shivering.
ex.cn: 他浑身湿透，打着寒战，一副凄惨的样子。

ex.en: The bird is now a rare sight in this country.
ex.cn: 如今在这个国家，这种鸟已罕见了。

ex.en: The cottage had a delightful sea view.
ex.cn: 这小屋可以看到宜人的海景。

ex.en: It's a spectacular sight as the flamingos lift into the air.
ex.cn: 一群红鹳飞向空中，景象十分壮观。

senses.def: the interesting places, especially in a town or city, that are often visited by tourists

ex.en: We're going to Paris for the weekend to see the sights.
ex.cn: 我们打算去巴黎过周末，参观那里的名胜。

senses.def: a person or thing that looks ridiculous, untidy, unpleasant, etc.
senses.chn: 滑稽可笑（或邋遢、脏乱、讨厌）的人（或物）

ex.en: She looks a sight in that hat!
ex.cn: 她戴着那顶帽子，样子够滑稽的！

senses.def: a device that you look through to aim a gun, etc. or to look at sth through a telescope, etc.

ex.en: He had the deer in his sights now.
ex.cn: 他现在瞄准了那头鹿。

ex.en: Even as a young actress, she always had Hollywood firmly in her sights (= as her final goal).
ex.cn: 她还是年轻演员的时候，就瞄准了好莱坞。

senses.def: when you first begin to consider sth

ex.en: At first sight, it may look like a generous offer, but always read the small print.
ex.cn: 乍一看，对方给出的条件好像很优厚，但任何时候都不要小看那些小号字印刷的附加条款。

senses.def: when you see sb/sth for the first time

ex.en: It was love at first sight (= we fell in love the first time we saw each other).
ex.cn: 我们一见钟情。

senses.def: to hate, etc. sb/sth very much

ex.en: I can't stand the sight of him!
ex.cn: 我看见他就烦！

senses.def: in sb's opinion
senses.chn: 从某人的观点来看；在某人看来

ex.en: We are all equal in the sight of God.
ex.cn: 在上帝眼里我们都是平等的。

senses.def: to become no longer able to see sb/sth

ex.en: They finally lost sight of land.
ex.cn: 他们终于看不见陆地了。

senses.def: to stop considering sth; to forget sth

ex.en: We must not lose sight of our original aim.
ex.cn: 我们决不能忘记我们最初的目标。

senses.def: used to say sb will quickly be forgotten when they are no longer with you
to expect more/less from a situation
senses.chn: 提高／降低要求；眼光变高／变低

senses.def: to decide that you want sth and to try very hard to get it
senses.chn: 以…为奋斗目标；决心做到

ex.en: She's set her sights on getting into Harvard.
ex.cn: 她决心要上哈佛大学。

senses.def: very much better; much too good, etc.

ex.en: She's done a darn sight better than I have.
ex.cn: 她干得比我强多了。

ex.en: It's worth a damn sight more than I thought.
ex.cn: 它的价值比我原先想的高多了。

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
if you buy sth sight unseen, you do not have an opportunity to see it before you buy it
senses.chn: 在未见过的情况下；事先未经检查

senses.def: to appear, especially when moving gradually closer from a long way off

ex.en: A ship hove into sight.
ex.cn: 远处出现了一条船。

senses.def: to recognize sb without knowing them well
impossible for anyone to find or see

ex.en: The children were nowhere to be seen.
ex.cn: 根本看不到孩子们在哪儿。

ex.en: A peace settlement is nowhere in sight (= is not likely in the near future).
ex.cn: 近期内无望和平解决。

senses.def: not pleasant to look at

ex.en: You should have seen him in his swimming trunks—not a pretty sight!
ex.cn: 你应该见识见识他穿游泳裤的样子，真是一景呢！

senses.def: to suddenly see sth, especially sth you have been looking for

ex.en: After twelve days at sea, they sighted land.
ex.cn: 在海上航行十二天后他们看到了陆地。

senses.def: able to see; not blind

ex.cn: 有正常视力的孩子的盲人父母

senses.def: able to see in the way mentioned

ex.cn: 弱视的

ex.en: short-sighted
ex.cn: 近视的

ex.en: long-sighted
ex.cn: 远视的

senses.def: an occasion when sb sees sb/sth, especially sth unusual or sth that lasts for only a short time
senses.chn: 看见，目睹（不寻常或短暂出现的事物）

senses.def: the activity of visiting interesting buildings and places as a tourist

senses.def: an event, an action, a fact, etc. that shows that sth exists, is happening or may happen in the future

ex.cn: 阴沉的天气没有丝毫转晴的迹象。

ex.cn: 她点头示意我们坐下。

ex.cn: 请在这里签名。

ex.cn: 乐队同维京唱片公司签了约。

ex.cn: 现在越来越多的戏剧配上了手语。

ex.cn: 只要在虚线上签名，这车就归你了。

to lose your rights or property by signing a document

ex.cn: 来客均须签到。

ex.cn: 客人离开俱乐部时，你必须为他们签退。

ex.cn: 她在信末写上 “你的珍妮特”。

senses.def: to end a broadcast by saying goodbye or playing a piece of music
senses.chn: （以说再见或播放音乐的形式）结束广播

ex.cn: 这份报告总统尚未批准。

senses.chn: 办理失业登记（以领取失业救济金）

ex.cn: 他签了在部队服役五年的合同。

ex.cn: 为时装表演，公司签约聘了三名顶尖模特儿。

ex.cn: 她签署了转让手续，把房子过到女儿名下。

ex.cn: 有多少个国家签订了关于气候变化的《京都议定书》？

ex.cn: 到目前为止我们有大约 100 人同意提供帮助。

example.en: The band signed with Virgin Records.
example.cn: 乐队同维京唱片公司签了约。

ex.cn: 危险、警告、求救等信号

ex.cn: 收到约定的信号后，他们离开了房间。

ex.cn: （骑车人和驾车人的）示意手势

ex.cn: 减刑会向犯罪分子发出错误的信号。

ex.cn: 头痛可能是紧张的迹象。

ex.cn: 他们根本没说明这项工作该怎样做。

ex.cn: 停车信号

ex.cn: 电视信号

ex.cn: 高频信号

ex.cn: 雷达信号

ex.cn: 探测到／收到信号

ex.cn: 发射信号

ex.cn: 我的手机接收不到信号了。

ex.cn: 等我发出信号后再开枪。

ex.cn: 右转弯前你示意了吗？

ex.cn: 他示意服务员结账。

ex.cn: 他示意要我们去他那儿。

ex.cn: 他拒绝投票以示不满。

ex.cn: 她表示愿意作为候选人参加竞选。

ex.cn: 极大的荣誉

example.cn: 他示意服务员结账。

phrases.filled: signal to/for sb to do sth

example.cn: 他示意要我们去他那儿。

a measure of how much useful information you receive, compared to information which is not useful

ex.cn: 有人在支票上伪造了她的签名。

ex.cn: 他们在请愿书上征集了 1 万人的签名。

ex.cn: 他因在协议上签了字而受到攻击。

senses.def: the act of signing sth

ex.cn: 合同一式两份，将送交您签署。

senses.def: a particular quality that makes sth different from other similar things and makes it easy to recognize
senses.chn: 明显特征；鲜明特色；识别标志

ex.cn: 他总爱用亮丽的色彩。

senses.chn: （尤指对将来有影响的）重要性，意义

ex.cn: 具有重大政治意义的决定

ex.cn: 这种新药对于这种病的治疗有重大的意义。

ex.cn: 他们讨论了这些结果在统计学上的意义。

ex.cn: 她未能充分领会他那番话的意思。

ex.cn: 这些符号有什么特别的含义吗？

ex.cn: 有重大意义的发现

ex.cn: 从统计学的观点看，实验结果意义不明显。

ex.cn: 这两组学生没有明显差别。

ex.cn: 你的工作有了显著改进。

ex.cn: 很明显，女生的考试成绩一般比男生的好。

ex.cn: 值得注意的是，他没有否认可能举行选举。

ex.cn: 她在回答之前意味深长地停顿了一下。

ex.cn: 这个标志说明这些产品符合指定的标准。

ex.cn: 白腰带表示他完全是个新手。

ex.cn: 她笑了笑表示赞同。

ex.cn: 他点头表示同意。

to end a letter

ex.cn: 她在信末写上 “你的珍妮特”。

senses.def: to end a broadcast by saying goodbye or playing a piece of music
senses.chn: （以说再见或播放音乐的形式）结束广播

senses.def: to express your approval of sth formally and definitely

senses.chn: 在签字处签上姓名（表示同意）；签名同意

example.en: to snort with laughter

a person's nose

ex.cn: 正下着大雪。

ex.cn: 积雪开始融化了。

ex.cn: 孩子们正在雪地里玩。

ex.en: 20 cm of snow were expected today.
ex.cn: 原来预计今天下 20 厘米厚的雪。

ex.en: The snow didn't settle (= stay on the ground).
ex.cn: 雪没积起来。

senses.def: an amount of snow that falls in one particular place or at one particular time

ex.cn: 乞力马扎罗山的积雪

senses.def: extremely clean, pure, etc.
when it snows, snow falls from the sky

ex.cn: 大雪下了一整天。

senses.def: to impress sb a lot by the things you say, especially if these are not true or not sincere

ex.en: He really snowed me with all his talk of buying a Porsche.
ex.cn: 他嘴上老说要买一辆保时捷，还真把我唬住了。

senses.def: to be unable to leave a place because of heavy snow

senses.def: a drink that is a mixture of lemonade and a liqueur(= a strong sweet alcoholic drink) made with eggs

senses.def: covered with snow on top
chains that are put on the wheels of a car so that it can drive over snow
senses.chn: 雪地防滑链（汽车在雪地上行驶时用）

senses.def: a well-known phrase such as a quotation or proverb that has been changed in different ways by many speakers and/or writers, for example 'When in Buenos Aires' and 'When in Copenhagen', adapted from the proverb 'When in Rome (do as the Romans do).'
senses.chn: 雪克隆，名言名句改编（为人熟知的名言或谚语等通过替换原文的某些词语而创造出新用法，如 When in Rome (do as the Romans do) 改成 When in Buenos Aires 或 When in Copenhagen 等）

senses.chn: 拒不出席；拒不接受；抵制

senses.chn: 冷落；怠慢的言辞（或行为）

ex.cn: 除了不时听见狗喘气的声音，四下里一片寂静。

ex.cn: 腰间的松紧带使衣服正好紧紧贴在身上。

senses.def: a small comfortable room in a pub, with seats for only a few people

example.en: The child snuggled up to her mother.
example.cn: 孩子依偎着她的母亲。

example.en: He snuggled his head onto her shoulder.
example.cn: 他把头倚在她肩上。

senses.def: to such a great degree
senses.chn: （表示程度）这么，这样，那么，那样，如此

ex.en: Don't look so angry.
ex.cn: 别那样怒气冲冲的。

ex.en: There's no need to worry so.
ex.cn: 没必要这样着急。

ex.en: She spoke so quietly (that) I could hardly hear her.
ex.cn: 她说话轻得我几乎听不见。

ex.en: I'm not so stupid as to believe that.
ex.cn: 我还不至于傻得连那样的话都相信。

ex.en: Would you be so kind as to lock the door when you leave?
ex.cn: 请您离开时把门锁上好吗？

senses.def: very; extremely

ex.en: I'm so glad to see you.
ex.cn: 见到你真高兴。

ex.en: We have so much to do.
ex.cn: 我们有很多事要做。

ex.en: Their attitude is so very English.
ex.cn: 他们的态度是十足的英国人的态度。

ex.en: The article was just so much (= nothing but) nonsense.
ex.cn: 那篇文章纯粹是胡说八道。

ex.en: He sat there ever so quietly.
ex.cn: 他静悄悄地坐在那儿。

ex.en: I do love it so.
ex.cn: 我实在是太喜欢它了。

senses.def: not to the same degree

ex.en: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for a long time.
ex.cn: 我好长时间没有这么快活了。

ex.en: It wasn't so good as last time.
ex.cn: 这次不如上次好。

ex.en: It's not so easy as you'd think.
ex.cn: 不像你想的那么容易。

ex.en: He was not so quick a learner as his brother.
ex.cn: 他学东西不像他哥哥那么快。

ex.en: It's not so much a hobby as a career (= more like a career than a hobby).
ex.cn: 这与其说是爱好，不如说是职业。

ex.en: Off she went without so much as (= without even) a 'goodbye'.
ex.cn: 她连声 “再见” 都没说就走了。

senses.def: used to show the size, amount or number of sth

ex.en: The fish was about so big (= said when using your hands to show the size).
ex.cn: 那条鱼差不多有这么长。

ex.en: There are only so many (= only a limited number of) hours in a day.
ex.cn: 一天不过这么几个小时。

senses.def: used to refer back to sth that has already been mentioned

ex.en: 'Is he coming?' ' I hope so.'
ex.cn: “他来吗？” “我希望他来。”

ex.en: 'Did they mind?' 'I don't think so.'
ex.cn: “他们有没有介意？” “我想没有。”

ex.en: If she notices, she never says so.
ex.cn: 就算她留意到，她也从来不说。

ex.en: I might be away next week. If so, I won't be able to see you.
ex.cn: 下星期我可能外出。要是那样，我就见不到你了。

ex.en: We are very busy— so much so that we won't be able to take time off this year.
ex.cn: 我们很忙，忙得今年都没时间休假了。

ex.en: Programs are expensive, and even more so if you have to keep altering them.
ex.cn: 买软件很贵，要是老得更换，那就更贵了。

senses.def: also

ex.en: Times have changed and so have I.
ex.cn: 时代变了，我也变了。

ex.en: 'I prefer the first version.' ' So do we.'
ex.cn: “我喜欢第一稿。” “我们也是。”

ex.en: 'I'm not hungry.' ' Neither am I / I'm not very hungry either.'
ex.cn: “我不饿。” “我也不太饿。”

senses.def: used to agree that sth is true, especially when you are surprised
senses.chn: （尤指感到惊讶时表示同意）的确如此

ex.en: 'You were there, too.' ' So I was —I'd forgotten.'
ex.cn: “当时你也在那儿。” “是啊，我给忘了。”

ex.en: 'There's another one.' ' So there is.'
ex.cn: “还有一个。” “可不是吗。”

senses.def: used, often with a negative, before adjectives and noun phrases to emphasize sth that you are saying
senses.chn: （常与否定词连用，置于形容词和名词短语前以加强语气）

ex.en: He is so not the right person for you.
ex.cn: 他这个人绝对不适合你。

ex.en: That is so not cool.
ex.cn: 那实在不怎么样。

senses.def: used, especially by children, to say that what sb says is not the case and the opposite is true
senses.chn: （儿童常用以反驳对方）偏偏，就

ex.en: 'You're not telling the truth, are you?' 'I am, so!'
ex.cn: “你说的不是实话，对不对？” “就是实话，就是！”

senses.def: used when you are showing sb how to do sth or telling them how sth happened

ex.en: Stand with your arms out, so.
ex.cn: 两臂伸开站着，像这样。

ex.en: So it was that he finally returned home.
ex.cn: 就这样，他终于回到了家。

senses.def: used at the end of a list to show that it continues in the same way

ex.en: We discussed everything—when to go, what to see and so on.
ex.cn: 我们什么都商量过了，什么时候走、看什么等等。

senses.def: used after a number, an amount, etc. to show that it is not exact

ex.en: There were twenty or so (= about twenty) people there.
ex.cn: 那儿有差不多二十个人。

ex.en: We stayed for an hour or so.
ex.cn: 我们待了一个小时左右。

senses.def: with the intention of doing sth
senses.chn: 为了做某事；以便做某事

ex.en: We went early so as to get good seats.
ex.cn: 为了占到好座位，我们早早就去了。

senses.def: used to show that you accept sth and will not try to change it or cannot change it

ex.en: If he doesn't want to be involved, then so be it.
ex.cn: 要是他不想参与，那就随他的便好了。

senses.def: used to show that you have finished talking about sth
senses.chn: （表示就某事讲完了）关于…就讲这么多，…到此为止

ex.en: So much for the situation in Germany. Now we turn our attention to France.
ex.cn: 德国的形势就讲到这里。现在我们来看看法国的情况。

senses.def: used to suggest that sth has not been successful or useful
senses.chn: （表示行不通或没用）作罢好了，快别提了

ex.en: So much for that idea!
ex.cn: 快别提那个主意了！

senses.def: in such a way that

ex.en: The programme has been so organized that none of the talks overlap.
ex.cn: 日程做了精心安排，以使每一讲都没有重复内容。

senses.def: used to give an important extra reason why sth is true
senses.chn: （表示另外的重要原因）尤其因为

ex.en: His achievement is remarkable; all the more so because he had no help at all.
ex.cn: 他的成就非同一般，而由于他没有得到过任何帮助，更显不凡。

senses.def: used to show the reason for sth

ex.en: It was still painful so I went to see a doctor.
ex.cn: 那地方还疼，因此我去看了医生。

senses.def: used to show the result of sth

ex.en: Nothing more was heard from him so that we began to wonder if he was dead.
ex.cn: 此后再没收到他的消息，于是我们开始怀疑他是不是死了。

senses.def: used to show the purpose of sth

ex.en: But I gave you a map so you wouldn't get lost!
ex.cn: 但我怕你迷路，给过你一张地图！

ex.en: She worked hard so that everything would be ready in time.
ex.cn: 她努力工作，为的是及时做好各项准备。

senses.def: used to introduce the next part of a story

ex.en: So after shouting and screaming for an hour she walked out in tears.

senses.def: if a part of your body is sore, it is painful, and often red, especially because of infection or because a muscle has been used too much

ex.cn: 嗓子疼

ex.en: His feet were sore after the walk.
ex.cn: 他走路把脚都走疼了。

ex.en: My stomach is still sore (= painful) after the operation.
ex.cn: 手术后，我的胃还在疼。

ex.en: Is your knee still painful?
ex.cn: 你的膝盖还疼吗？

ex.en: a series of painful injections
ex.cn: 一次又一次令人痛苦的注射

ex.en: a slow and painful death
ex.cn: 缓慢而痛苦的死亡

senses.def: upset and angry, especially because you have been treated unfairly
a subject that makes you feel angry or upset when it is mentioned

ex.en: It's a sore point with Sue's parents that the children have not been baptized yet.
ex.cn: 孩子们至今未受洗礼，这是休的父母的一块心病。

senses.def: to be very noticeable in an unpleasant way
bad-tempered or in a bad-tempered way
a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
a painful, often red, place on your body where there is a wound or an infection

ex.en: open sores
ex.cn: 开放性溃疡

senses.def: seriously; very much

ex.en: I was sorely tempted to complain, but I didn't.
ex.cn: 我极想发牢骚，但还是没开口。

ex.en: If you don't come to the reunion you'll be sorely missed.
ex.cn: 你要是不来参加团聚，大家会非常想念你的。

senses.def: very small grain grown as food in tropical countries; the plant that produces this grain
a club for a group of women students at an American college or university
a plant with leaves that taste bitter and are used in salads or in making soup or sauces
senses.chn: 酸模，酸叶草（叶子味苦，可用于做色拉、汤或酱汁）

senses.def: a feeling of great sadness because sth very bad has happened

ex.en: He expressed his sorrow at the news of her death.
ex.cn: 听到她的死讯，他表示哀伤。

ex.en: They said that the decision was made more in sorrow than in anger.
ex.cn: 他们说作出这个决定，与其说是出于气愤，不如说是出于悲伤。

senses.def: a very sad event or situation

ex.en: the joys and sorrows of childhood
ex.cn: 童年的欢乐和悲伤

senses.def: to feel or express great sadness

ex.en: the sorrowing relatives
ex.cn: 悲伤的亲属

senses.def: very sad

ex.en: her sorrowful eyes
ex.cn: 她悲伤的双眼

senses.def: feeling sad and sympathetic

ex.en: I'm sorry that your husband lost his job.
ex.cn: 你丈夫把工作丢了，我很惋惜。

ex.en: We're sorry to hear that your father's in hospital again.
ex.cn: 听说你父亲又住院了，我们心里都不好受。

ex.en: No one is sorrier than I am about what happened.
ex.cn: 发生了这样的事，我比谁都难过。

ex.en: I'm sorry you're not well. I hope you feel better soon.
ex.cn: 你身体不适，我很难过。希望你尽快好起来。

ex.en: I am sorry to hear that.
ex.cn: 听到这个消息我很难过。

ex.en: That's bad luck.
ex.cn: 真是不幸。

senses.def: feeling sad and ashamed about sth that has been done

ex.en: We're very sorry about the damage to your car.
ex.cn: 损坏了你的车，我们真是过意不去。

ex.en: He says he's really sorry for taking the car without asking.
ex.cn: 他没打招呼就用了车，他说他为此感到非常抱歉。

ex.en: She was sorry that she'd lost her temper.
ex.cn: 她为自己发了脾气而感到愧疚。

ex.en: If you say you're sorry we'll forgive you.
ex.cn: 你要是道歉，我们就原谅你。

ex.en: I'm so/terribly/very sorry I'm late.
ex.cn: 非常抱歉，我迟到了。

ex.en: I do apologize. I'll get you another cup.
ex.cn: 很抱歉，我再给您拿一杯。

senses.def: feeling disappointed about sth and wishing you had done sth different or had not done sth

ex.en: She was sorry that she'd lost contact with Mary.
ex.cn: 她懊悔跟玛丽失去了联系。

ex.en: You'll be sorry if I catch you!
ex.cn: 要是让我抓着，你会后悔的！

ex.en: I was genuinely sorry to be leaving college.
ex.cn: 大学毕业时，我打心底里舍不得离去。

senses.def: very sad or bad, especially making you feel pity or disapproval

ex.en: The business is in a sorry state.
ex.cn: 公司境况真是糟糕。

ex.en: They were a sorry sight when they eventually got off the boat.
ex.cn: 他们最终从船上下来，一副惨兮兮的样子。

senses.def: to feel pity or sympathy for sb

ex.en: He decided to help Jan as he felt sorry for her.
ex.cn: 他同情简的遭遇，决定帮助她。

senses.def: to feel unhappy; to pity yourself

ex.en: Stop feeling sorry for yourself and think about other people for a change.
ex.cn: 别老觉得自己委屈了，也替别人想一想吧。

senses.def: used when you are apologizing for sth

ex.en: I'm sorry, I forgot.
ex.cn: 对不起，我忘了。

ex.en: Oh, I'm sorry. Have I taken the one you wanted?
ex.cn: 哟，对不起。我是不是拿了你想要的那个？

ex.en: I'm sorry. I can't make it tomorrow.
ex.cn: 很抱歉。我明天不行。

senses.def: used for disagreeing with sb or politely saying 'no'
senses.chn: （表示不同意或委婉地拒绝）对不起

ex.en: I'm sorry, I don't agree.
ex.cn: 对不起，我不同意。

ex.en: I'm sorry, I'd rather you didn't go.
ex.cn: 恕我直言，我看你还是不去为好。

senses.def: used for introducing bad news

ex.en: I'm sorry to have to tell you you've failed.
ex.cn: 我只能遗憾地告诉你，你不及格。

senses.def: used for saying that sth is disappointing
senses.chn: （表示某事令人失望）我遗憾地说

ex.en: He didn't accept the job, I'm sorry to say.
ex.cn: 我很遗憾，他不接受那项工作。

senses.def: used to say that it is wiser to be too careful than to act too quickly and do sth you may later wish you had not
senses.chn: 宁可事先谨慎有余，不要事后追悔莫及

senses.def: used when you are apologizing for sth

ex.en: Sorry I'm late!
ex.cn: 对不起，我来晚了！

ex.en: Did I stand on your foot? Sorry!
ex.cn: 我是不是踩你脚了？抱歉！

ex.en: Sorry to bother you, but could I speak to you for a moment?
ex.cn: 不好意思打搅你，我能不能跟你说几句话？

ex.en: Sorry, we don't allow dogs in the house.
ex.cn: 对不起，我们是不让狗进屋的。

ex.en: He didn't even say sorry.
ex.cn: 他连句道歉的话也没有说。

senses.def: used for asking sb to repeat sth that you have not heard clearly
senses.chn: （请某人重复你没听清楚的话）你说什么，请再说一遍

ex.en: Sorry? Could you repeat the question?
ex.cn: 你说什么？能不能把你的问题再说一遍？

senses.def: used for correcting yourself when you have said sth wrong
senses.chn: （纠正自己说错的话）不对，应该是

ex.en: Take the first turning, sorry, the third turning on the right.
ex.cn: 到第一个，不，到第三个路口往右拐。

example.en: I'm sorry that your husband lost his job.
example.cn: 你丈夫把工作丢了，我很惋惜。

example.en: We're sorry to hear that your father's in hospital again.
example.cn: 听说你父亲又住院了，我们心里都不好受。

example.en: No one is sorrier than I am about what happened.
example.cn: 发生了这样的事，我比谁都难过。

example.en: He says he's really sorry for taking the car without asking.
example.cn: 他没打招呼就用了车，他说他为此感到非常抱歉。

example.en: I was genuinely sorry to be leaving college.
example.cn: 大学毕业时，我打心底里舍不得离去。

senses.def: a group or type of people or things that are similar in a particular way

ex.en: ' What sort of music do you like?' 'Oh, all sorts.'
ex.cn: “你喜欢哪一类音乐？” “噢，哪一类都喜欢。”

ex.en: This sort of problem is quite common./ These sorts of problems are quite common.
ex.cn: 这类问题相当普遍。／这几类问题相当普遍。

ex.en: He's the sort of person who only cares about money.
ex.cn: 他这种人一心只想着钱。

ex.en: For dessert there's a fruit pie of some sort (= you are not sure what kind).
ex.cn: 甜点是一种水果派。

ex.en: Most people went on training courses of one sort or another (= of various types) last year.
ex.cn: 多数人去年都上过这样那样的培训班。

ex.en: There were snacks—peanuts, olives, that sort of thing.
ex.cn: 有各种小吃，花生米、橄榄什么的。

senses.def: a particular type of person

ex.en: My brother would never cheat on his wife; he's not that sort.
ex.cn: 我哥哥永远不会背着妻子在外面拈花惹草，他不是那种人。

senses.def: the process of putting data in a particular order

ex.en: to do a sort
ex.cn: 进行排序

senses.def: used to say that you think sb's behaviour is very strange or unusual but that everyone is different and likes different things
senses.chn: （认为某人行为怪诞或不寻常时说）世界之大无奇不有，林子大了什么鸟都有

senses.def: used when you are saying that sth is not a good example of a particular type of thing
senses.chn: （表示某事物不够好）勉强算的，凑合的

ex.en: He offered us an apology of sorts.
ex.cn: 他给我们勉强道了个歉。

senses.def: ill/sick or upset

ex.en: She was tired and out of sorts by the time she arrived home.
ex.cn: 她回到家里，又累又烦。

senses.def: to some extent but in a way that you cannot easily describe

ex.en: She sort of pretends that she doesn't really care.
ex.cn: 她摆出一副并不真正在乎的样子。

ex.en: 'Do you understand?' 'Sort of.'
ex.cn: “你懂了吗？” “有点懂了。”

senses.def: used for describing sth in a not very exact way
senses.chn: （表示不十分准确）近似于某物，有点像是某物

ex.en: I had a sort of feeling that he wouldn't come.
ex.cn: 我隐约觉得他不会来。

ex.en: They're a sort of greenish-blue colour.
ex.cn: 它们的颜色近乎带点绿的蓝色。

senses.def: used to emphasize that the situation is very different from what has been said
senses.chn: （强调情况与所说的大不相同）决不是那么回事，一点也不，才不哩；没有的事

ex.en: 'I was terrible!' 'You were nothing of the kind.'
ex.cn: “我那时糟透了！” “你才不哩。”

senses.def: to arrange things in groups or in a particular order according to their type, etc.; to separate things of one type from others

ex.en: sorting the mail
ex.cn: 分理信件

ex.en: The computer sorts the words into alphabetical order.
ex.cn: 计算机按字母顺序排列这些单词。

ex.en: Rubbish can easily be separated and sorted into plastics, glass and paper.
ex.cn: 垃圾很容易分开，可归入塑料、玻璃和纸三类。

ex.en: Women and children sorted the ore from the rock.
ex.cn: 妇女和孩子把矿石从岩石中分拣出来。

senses.def: to deal with a problem successfully or organize sth/sb properly

ex.en: I'm really busy—can you sort it?
ex.cn: 我真的很忙，你能处理一下吗？

senses.def: to show or prove who is brave, skilful, etc. and who is not
senses.chn: 表明／证明谁有技能（或更勇敢等）

senses.def: to distinguish people who are good at sth, intelligent, etc. from those who are not
senses.chn: 区分能手与常人；分清智者和庸人

senses.def: to distinguish useful or valuable people or things from ones that are not useful or have no value
senses.chn: 识别优劣；分清好坏；去芜存菁

senses.def: to stop being a problem without anyone having to take action

ex.en: It will all sort itself out in the end.
ex.cn: 问题最后都会自行解决。

senses.def: to organize the contents of sth; to tidy sth

ex.en: The cupboards need sorting out.
ex.cn: 柜橱该整理一下了。

senses.def: to organize sth successfully

ex.en: If you're going to the bus station, can you sort out the tickets for tomorrow?
ex.cn: 你要去汽车站的话，能不能把明天的车票买好？

senses.def: to separate sth from a larger group

ex.en: Could you sort out the toys that can be thrown away?
ex.cn: 你把可以扔掉的玩具挑出来，好吗？

senses.def: to deal with sb's/your own problems successfully
senses.chn: 妥善处理某人（或自己）的问题

ex.en: If you can wait a moment, I'll sort it all out for you.
ex.cn: 要是你能等一会儿，我就可以把什么都给你弄好。

ex.en: You load up the car and I'll sort the kids out.
ex.cn: 你装车，我把孩子们安顿好。

senses.def: to deal with sb who is causing trouble, etc. especially by punishing or attacking them

ex.en: Wait till I get my hands on him—I'll soon sort him out!
ex.cn: 等他落到我手里，我立马就收拾他！

senses.def: to look through a number of things, either in order to find sth or to put them in order

ex.en: I sorted through my paperwork.
ex.cn: 我把文件纸张都归整好了。

ex.en: She sorted through her suitcase for something to wear.
ex.cn: 她翻遍行李箱找件衣服穿。

example.en: sorting the mail
example.cn: 分理信件

example.en: The computer sorts the words into alphabetical order.
example.cn: 计算机按字母顺序排列这些单词。

example.en: Women and children sorted the ore from the rock.
example.cn: 妇女和孩子把矿石从岩石中分拣出来。

senses.def: a number that is used to identify a particular bank
completed, solved or organized
senses.chn: 完成的；已解决的；整理好的

ex.en: Don't worry. We'll soon have this sorted.
ex.cn: 别担心，我们马上把这弄好。

ex.en: It's our problem. We'll get it sorted.
ex.cn: 这是我们的问题，我们来处理。

ex.en: It's all sorted.
ex.cn: 全都弄好了。

ex.en: It's time you got yourself sorted.
ex.cn: 现在你该把自己的事好好安排一下了。

senses.def: a flight that is made by an aircraft during military operations; an attack made by soldiers
senses.chn: （在军事行动中飞机的）出动架次；（军队的）出击

senses.def: a short trip away from your home or the place where you are
an effort that you make to do or join sth new

ex.en: His first sortie into politics was unsuccessful.
ex.cn: 他初涉政坛并不成功。

senses.def: a place where mail is sorted before being delivered
to stop being a problem without anyone having to take action

ex.en: It will all sort itself out in the end.
ex.cn: 问题最后都会自行解决。

senses.def: to some extent but in a way that you cannot easily describe

ex.en: She sort of pretends that she doesn't really care.
ex.cn: 她摆出一副并不真正在乎的样子。

ex.en: 'Do you understand?' 'Sort of.'
ex.cn: “你懂了吗？” “有点懂了。”

senses.def: an act of arranging or organizing the contents of sth in a tidy or neat way and removing things you do not want
a signal or message that a ship or plane sends when it needs urgent help
senses.chn: （船舶或飞机发出的）紧急呼救信号

ex.en: to send an SOS
ex.cn: 发出紧急呼救信号

ex.en: an SOS message
ex.cn: 紧急呼救信号

senses.def: an urgent request for help

ex.en: We've received an SOS from the area asking for food parcels.
ex.cn: 我们收到来自那一地区的紧急求援信息，他们急需食物包。

senses.def: small pieces of meat or vegetables that are cooked on a stick, usually over an open fire
not particularly good or bad; average
senses.chn: 一般的；普通的；中等的；不好也不差的

ex.en: 'How are you feeling today?' 'So-so.'
ex.cn: “你今天感觉怎么样？” “还可以。”

senses.def: used to describe sth that people are saying although it may not be correct

ex.en: She never saw him again—or so the story goes.
ex.cn: 从此她再没有见过他，或者据说如此。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are expressing sth in an unusual or amusing way

ex.en: They were all very similar. All cut from the same cloth, so to speak.
ex.cn: 他们都十分相像。可以说就跟一块布上剪下来似的。

senses.def: in a quiet voice so that not everyone can hear
if you do not have a sou, you have no money at all
to make a soft whistling sound
wanted by many people, because it is of very good quality or difficult to get or to find
senses.chn: 争相获得的；吃香的；广受欢迎的

ex.en: This design is the most sought after.
ex.cn: 这款设计最受欢迎。

ex.en: a much sought-after actress
ex.cn: 非常走红的女演员

senses.def: a market in an Arab country
the spiritual part of a person, believed to exist after death

ex.en: He believed his immortal soul was in peril.
ex.cn: 他认为他不死的灵魂有堕入地狱的危险。

ex.en: The howling wind sounded like the wailing of lost souls (= the spirits of dead people who are not in heaven).
ex.cn: 怒吼的风如同堕入地狱的灵魂在哀声恸哭。

senses.def: a person's inner character, containing their true thoughts and feelings

ex.en: There was a feeling of restlessness deep in her soul.
ex.cn: 她内心深处感到焦躁不安。

senses.def: the spiritual and moral qualities of humans in general
senses.chn: （人类整体的）精神世界（包括精神品质和道德品质）

ex.en: the dark side of the human soul
ex.cn: 人类精神世界中阴暗的一面

senses.def: strong and good human feeling, especially that gives a work of art its quality or enables sb to recognize and enjoy that quality
senses.chn: 真挚情感；高尚情操；气魄

ex.en: It was a very polished performance, but it lacked soul.
ex.cn: 这场演出技艺很精湛，但缺少真挚的情感。

senses.def: a perfect example of a good quality

ex.en: He is the soul of discretion.
ex.cn: 他是谨慎的典范。

senses.def: a person of a particular type

ex.en: She's lost all her money, poor soul.
ex.cn: 可怜的人，她的钱全没了。

ex.en: You're a brave soul.
ex.cn: 你真勇敢。

senses.def: a person

ex.en: There wasn't a soul in sight (= nobody was in sight).
ex.cn: 连个人影都不见。

ex.en: Don't tell a soul (= do not tell anyone).
ex.cn: 谁也别告诉。

ex.en: a village of 300 souls (= with 300 people living there)
ex.cn: 一个 300 人的村子

senses.def: a type of music that expresses strong emotions, made popular by African American musicians
senses.chn: 灵乐，灵歌，灵魂音乐（感情强烈，源于非裔美国人的音乐）

ex.en: a soul singer
ex.cn: 灵乐歌手

senses.def: good for you, even if it seems unpleasant

ex.en: 'Want a ride?' 'No thanks. Walking is good for the soul.'
ex.cn: “搭车吗？” “不，谢谢。步行有步行的好处。”

senses.def: to tell sb your deepest and most private feelings
with all your energy

ex.en: She committed herself body and soul to fighting for the cause.
ex.cn: 她全心全意为这一事业而奋斗。

senses.def: to stay alive with just enough of the food, clothing, etc. that you need

ex.en: They barely have enough money to keep body and soul together.
ex.cn: 他们仅有活命的钱。

senses.def: used to show respect when you are talking about sb who is dead
senses.chn: （对死者表示敬意）魂归天国，安息主怀

senses.def: with a lot of energy and enthusiasm
senses.chn: 满腔热忱干劲十足；全心全意

ex.en: They threw themselves heart and soul into the project.
ex.cn: 他们全心全意地投入了这个项目。

senses.def: the most amusing and interesting person at a party, etc.
senses.chn: （聚会等场合）最活跃风趣的人

senses.def: to do anything, even sth bad or dishonest, in return for money, success or power
very dull and boring, because it has to be repeated many times or because there will never be any improvement
senses.chn: 单调枯燥的；消磨精神的

senses.def: the type of food that was traditionally eaten by black people in the southern US
senses.chn: 美国南方黑人的传统食物

senses.def: expressing deep feelings, especially feelings of sadness or love
senses.chn: 深情的；（尤指）凄婉的，脉脉含情的

ex.en: soulful eyes
ex.cn: 深情的眼睛

ex.en: a soulful song
ex.cn: 一首凄婉的歌

senses.def: lacking any attractive or interesting qualities that make people feel happy
senses.chn: 没有生气的；呆板的；乏味的

ex.en: They live in soulless concrete blocks.
ex.cn: 他们住在了无生气的混凝土楼房里。

senses.def: lacking the ability to feel emotions
a person that you have a special friendship with because you understand each other's feelings and interests
the careful examination of your thoughts and feelings, for example in order to reach the correct decision or solution to sth
something that you can hear

ex.en: a high/low sound
ex.cn: 高的／低的声音

ex.en: a clicking/buzzing/scratching, etc. sound
ex.cn: 咔嗒咔嗒、嗡嗡、嚓嚓等的声音

ex.en: the different sounds and smells of the forest
ex.cn: 森林里的各种声音、各种气息

ex.en: She heard the sound of footsteps outside.
ex.cn: 她听见外面有脚步声。

ex.en: He crept into the house trying not to make a sound.
ex.cn: 他蹑手蹑脚地溜进房子里，尽量不弄出一点声响。

senses.def: continuous rapid movements (called vibrations) that travel through air or water and can be heard when they reach a person's or an animal's ear

ex.en: Sound travels more slowly than light.
ex.cn: 声比光传播得慢。

senses.def: what you can hear coming from a television, radio, etc., or as part of a film/movie

ex.en: Could you turn the sound up/down?
ex.cn: 你能把音量调大／调小一些吗？

ex.en: The sound quality of the tapes was excellent.
ex.cn: 磁带的音响效果极佳。

senses.def: the effect that is produced by the music of a particular singer or group of musicians

ex.en: I like their sound.
ex.cn: 我喜欢他们的音乐风格。

senses.def: an action or event that causes sth important to develop, especially trouble or violence

ex.en: the sparks of revolution
ex.cn: 革命的导火线

senses.def: feelings of anger or excitement between people
senses.chn: 愤怒的情感；激烈的情绪

ex.en: Sparks flew at the meeting (= there was a lot of argument).
ex.cn: 会上争论激烈，火星四溅。

senses.def: a lively and intelligent person, especially sb young
senses.chn: 活泼机灵的人（尤指年轻人）

ex.en: Some bright spark (= stupid person) left the tap running all night.
ex.cn: 不知是哪个聪明人让自来水流了一夜。

senses.def: to cause sth to start or develop, especially suddenly

ex.en: The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
ex.cn: 这一提案将引发全国性的抗议浪潮。

ex.en: Winds brought down power lines, sparking a fire.
ex.cn: 大风刮断电线，引起了火灾。

ex.en: The riots were sparked off by the arrest of a local leader.
ex.cn: 骚乱是因逮捕一名当地领导人而触发的。

senses.def: to produce small flashes of fire or electricity
senses.chn: 冒火花；飞火星；产生电火花

ex.en: a sparking, crackling fire
ex.cn: 噼啪直响、火星飞迸的火

ex.en: The game suddenly sparked to life.
ex.cn: 比赛突然变得激烈起来。

senses.def: to begin a conversation, an argument, a friendship, etc., often suddenly
senses.chn: 激起，突然引发（交谈、争论、友谊等）

ex.en: I tried to spark up a conversation with her.
ex.cn: 我设法跟她攀谈起来。

example.en: The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
example.cn: 这一提案将引发全国性的抗议浪潮。

example.en: The riots were sparked off by the arrest of a local leader.
example.cn: 骚乱是因逮捕一名当地领导人而触发的。

senses.def: to shine brightly with small flashes of light

ex.en: sparkling eyes
ex.cn: 炯炯有神的眼睛

ex.en: Her jewellery sparkled in the candlelight.
ex.cn: 烛光下，她的首饰光彩熠熠。

ex.en: The sun was shining and the sky was blue.
ex.cn: 阳光灿烂，天空一片蓝。

ex.en: Moonlight gleamed on the water.
ex.cn: 月光照在水面上泛起粼粼波光。

ex.en: The end of his cigarette glowed red.
ex.cn: 他的烟头发着微弱的红光。

ex.en: The diamonds sparkled in the light.
ex.cn: 钻石在灯光下闪闪发亮。

senses.def: to be full of life, enthusiasm or humour
senses.chn: 生气勃勃；热情奔放；神采飞扬

ex.en: He always sparkles at parties.
ex.cn: 在各种聚会上，他总是光芒四射。

senses.def: a series of flashes of light produced by light hitting a shiny surface

ex.en: the sparkle of glass
ex.cn: 玻璃闪耀的亮光

ex.en: There was a sparkle of excitement in her eyes.
ex.cn: 她眼里闪耀着激动的光芒。

senses.def: the quality of being lively and original

ex.en: The performance lacked sparkle.
ex.cn: 这场演出缺少亮点。

senses.def: a type of small firework that you hold in your hand and light. It burns with many bright sparks.
shining and flashing with light

ex.en: the calm and sparkling waters of the lake
ex.cn: 平静的波光粼粼的湖水

ex.en: sparkling blue eyes
ex.cn: 亮晶晶的蓝眼睛

senses.def: containing bubbles of gas

ex.en: a sparkling wine
ex.cn: 汽酒

ex.en: sparkling mineral water
ex.cn: 矿泉汽水

senses.def: interesting and amusing

ex.en: a sparkling conversation/personality
ex.cn: 妙趣横生的谈话；风趣的人

senses.def: excellent; of very good quality

ex.en: The champion was in sparkling form.
ex.cn: 夺冠者状态极佳。

senses.def: a part in a car engine that produces a spark (= a flash of electricity) which makes the fuel burn and starts the engine
to begin a conversation, an argument, a friendship, etc., often suddenly
senses.chn: 激起，突然引发（交谈、争论、友谊等）

ex.en: I tried to spark up a conversation with her.
ex.cn: 我设法跟她攀谈起来。

senses.def: full of life; interesting and amusing
senses.chn: 生气勃勃的；充满活力的；有意思的

ex.en: a sparky personality
ex.cn: 活泼的性格

senses.def: a person that you regularly have friendly arguments or discussions with
a person that a boxer regularly practises with
a small brown and grey bird, common in many parts of the world
a small bird of prey of the hawk (= a bird that kills other creatures for food) of the hawk family
only present in small amounts or numbers and often spread over a large area

ex.en: the sparse population of the islands
ex.cn: 那些岛上零星的人口

ex.en: Vegetation becomes sparse higher up the mountains.
ex.cn: 山上越高的地方植物越稀少。

ex.en: The information available on the subject is sparse.
ex.cn: 这个题目资料匮乏。

senses.def: simple or severe; lacking anything that makes life easier or more pleasant
senses.chn: 斯巴达式的；简朴的；清苦的

senses.def: a sudden and often painful contracting of a muscle, which you cannot control

ex.en: a muscle spasm
ex.cn: 肌肉痉挛

ex.en: The injection sent his leg into spasm.
ex.cn: 一针打下去，他的腿就痉挛了。

senses.def: a sudden strong feeling or reaction that lasts for a short time
senses.chn: （感情或反应）一阵阵发作，阵发

ex.en: a spasm of anxiety/anger/coughing/pain, etc.
ex.cn: 突然一阵焦虑、愤怒、咳嗽、疼痛等

senses.def: happening suddenly for short periods of time; not regular or continuous
senses.chn: 一阵阵的；阵发性的；断断续续的

ex.en: There was spasmodic fighting in the area yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天，那一地区发生过零星的战斗。

senses.def: caused by your muscles becoming tight in a way that you cannot control

ex.en: spasmodic movements
ex.cn: 痉挛性动作

senses.def: having or caused by cerebral palsy, an illness which makes it difficult for sb to control their muscles and movements. Using this word is now often considered offensive.
senses.chn: 痉挛性的；痉挛性麻痹的（此词现常被认为有冒犯意）

ex.en: spastic children
ex.cn: 痉挛性麻痹症患儿

ex.en: spastic reactions
ex.cn: 痉挛性麻痹症反应

senses.def: an offensive word, sometimes used by children to mean 'stupid'
senses.chn: （有时儿童用以骂人愚蠢）笨拙的，无能的

senses.def: a short argument or disagreement about sth unimportant
a cloth covering for the ankle that was worn in the past by men over the shoe and fastened with buttons at the side
a large number of things, which are usually unpleasant, that happen suddenly within a short period of time
senses.chn: 一连串，接二连三（通常指不愉快的事物）

ex.en: The bombing was the latest in a spate of terrorist attacks.
ex.cn: 这次炸弹爆炸事件是一连串恐怖主义袭击中最近的一起。

senses.def: containing more water and flowing more strongly than usual

ex.en: After heavy rain, the river was in spate.
ex.cn: 大雨过后，河水暴涨。

ex.en: Celia was in full spate (= completely involved in talking and not likely to stop or able to be interrupted).
ex.cn: 西莉亚口若悬河，滔滔不绝。

senses.def: relating to space and the position, size, shape, etc. of things in it

ex.en: changes taking place in the spatial distribution of the population
ex.cn: 人口的地域分布所发生的变化

ex.en: the development of a child's spatial awareness (= the ability to judge the positions and sizes of objects)
ex.cn: 孩子空间意识的形成

senses.def: to cover sb/sth with drops of liquid, dirt, etc., especially by accident

ex.en: blood-spattered walls
ex.cn: 血染的墙壁

ex.en: As the bus passed, it spattered us with mud.
ex.cn: 公共汽车开过时溅了我们一身泥。

ex.en: Oil was spattered on the floor.
ex.cn: 地板上落满了油点。

senses.def: to fall on a surface in drops, often noisily

ex.en: We heard the rain spattering on the roof.
ex.cn: 我们听见雨点噼里啪啦地打在房顶上。

senses.def: a number of drops of a liquid or small amounts of sth that hit a surface; the noise this makes

ex.en: a spatter of rain against the window
ex.cn: 雨点打在窗户上的噼啪声

ex.en: a spattering of blood
ex.cn: 点点血迹

ex.en: a spatter of applause
ex.cn: 稀稀落落的掌声

example.en: blood-spattered walls
example.cn: 血染的墙壁

example.en: As the bus passed, it spattered us with mud.
example.cn: 公共汽车开过时溅了我们一身泥。

example.en: Oil was spattered on the floor.
example.cn: 地板上落满了油点。

senses.def: a tool with a broad flat blade used for mixing and spreading things, especially in cooking and painting
senses.chn: （烹饪、油漆等活动中用以调拌或涂敷的）铲，刮勺，抹刀，刮刀

senses.def: a kitchen utensil that has a broad flat blade with narrow holes in it, attached to a long handle, used for turning and lifting food when cooking
senses.chn: 煎鱼锅铲，漏铲（铲面有细长孔）

senses.def: a thin flat instrument that doctors use for pressing the tongue down when they are examining sb's throat
to lay eggs
to cause sth to develop or be produced

ex.en: The band's album spawned a string of hit singles.
ex.cn: 这支乐队的专辑带出一连串走红的单曲。

senses.def: a soft substance containing the eggs of fish, frogs etc.
to remove the ovaries of a female animal, to prevent it from breeding
senses.chn: 切除雌兽的卵巢；劁（雌兽）

ex.en: Have you had your cat spayed?
ex.cn: 你的母猫劁了没有？

senses.def: a small shop/store that sb operates from their home, selling food, drinks, cigarettes, etc. to local people, especially in a township
senses.chn: （尤指黑人城镇的）家庭杂货店，街头小店

senses.def: to talk to sb about sth; to have a conversation with sb

ex.en: I've spoken to the manager about it.
ex.cn: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

ex.en: The President refused to speak to the waiting journalists.
ex.cn: 总统拒绝同等候的记者讲话。

ex.en: 'Can I speak to Susan?' 'Speaking.' (= at the beginning of a telephone conversation)
ex.cn: “请让苏珊接电话好吗？” “我就是。”

ex.en: 'Do you know him?' 'Not to speak to.' (= only by sight)
ex.cn: “你认识他吗？” “见过但没说过话。”

ex.en: I saw her in the street but we didn't speak.
ex.cn: 我在街上看见她了，但我们没有谈话。

ex.en: Can I speak with you for a minute?
ex.cn: 我能跟你谈一会儿吗？

senses.def: to use your voice to say sth

ex.en: He can't speak because of a throat infection.
ex.cn: 他嗓子发炎不能说话。

ex.en: Please speak more slowly.
ex.cn: 请讲慢点。

ex.en: Without speaking, she stood up and went out.
ex.cn: 她没有说话，站起身来走了出去。

ex.en: He speaks with a strange accent.
ex.cn: 他说话的口音很特别。

ex.en: She has a beautiful speaking voice.
ex.cn: 她说话的音色很美。

senses.def: to mention or describe sth/sb

ex.en: She still speaks about him with great affection.
ex.cn: 说起他来她依旧一往情深。

ex.en: Witnesses spoke of a great ball of flame.
ex.cn: 目击者都谈到有个大火球。

ex.en: Speaking of travelling, (= referring back to a subject just mentioned) are you going anywhere exciting this year?
ex.cn: 说到旅游，你今年要去什么好玩的地方吗？

ex.en: Nobody mentioned anything to me about it.
ex.cn: 没人跟我提过这事。

ex.en: I promised not to refer to the matter again.
ex.cn: 我答应过再不提这事了。

ex.en: Witnesses spoke of a great ball of flame.
ex.cn: 目击者都谈到有个大火球。

senses.def: to be able to use a particular language

ex.en: to speak several languages
ex.cn: 会讲几种语言

ex.en: to speak a little Urdu
ex.cn: 会说一点乌尔都语

ex.en: Do you speak English?
ex.cn: 你会说英语吗？

senses.def: to use a particular language to express yourself

ex.en: What language is it they're speaking?
ex.cn: 他们讲的是什么语？

ex.en: Would you prefer it if we spoke in German?
ex.cn: 我们用德语讲好吗？

senses.def: speaking the language mentioned

ex.en: French-speaking Canada
ex.cn: 加拿大法语区

ex.en: non-English-speaking students
ex.cn: 不会讲英语的学生

senses.def: to make a speech to an audience

ex.en: to speak in public
ex.cn: 公开演讲

ex.en: to speak on the radio
ex.cn: 在电台上讲话

ex.en: to speak at a conference
ex.cn: 在会上发言

ex.en: Professor Wilson was invited to speak about the results of his research.
ex.cn: 威尔逊教授获邀就自己的研究成果发言。

ex.en: She spoke in favour of the new tax.
ex.cn: 她发表演说，支持新税。

ex.en: He has a number of speaking engagements this week.
ex.cn: 他这个星期安排了几次演讲。

senses.def: to say or state sth

ex.en: She was clearly speaking the truth.
ex.cn: 她讲的显然是实情。

ex.en: He spoke the final words of the play.
ex.cn: 剧中最后的台词是他说的。

senses.def: to be willing to be polite or friendly towards sb, especially after an argument

ex.en: She's not been on speaking terms with her uncle for years.
ex.cn: 多年来她跟她叔叔一直不说话。

ex.en: Are they speaking to each other again yet?
ex.cn: 他们俩和好了没有？

senses.def: used to show that what you are saying is true in a general, etc. way
senses.chn: 总的、一般、粗略、相对等说来

ex.en: Generally speaking, the more you pay, the more you get.
ex.cn: 一般来说，花钱多，买的东西就多。

ex.en: There are, broadly speaking, two ways of doing this.
ex.cn: 大致说来，做这件事有两种方法。

ex.en: Personally speaking, I've always preferred Italian food.
ex.cn: 就我个人来讲，我总是偏爱意大利菜。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

senses.def: such a small amount that it is not worth mentioning

ex.en: They've got no friends to speak of.
ex.cn: 他们没一个像样的朋友。

ex.en: She's saved a little money but nothing to speak of.
ex.cn: 她攒了一点钱，不过数目不值一提。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are expressing sth in an unusual or amusing way

ex.en: They were all very similar. All cut from the same cloth, so to speak.
ex.cn: 他们都十分相像。可以说就跟一块布上剪下来似的。

senses.def: to be so easy to see and understand that you do not need to say anything else about it/them

ex.en: Her success speaks for itself.
ex.cn: 她的成功有目共睹。

senses.def: to express what you think or want yourself, rather than sb else doing it for you
senses.chn: 自己说（而非让别人替自己说）

ex.en: I'm quite capable of speaking for myself, thank you!
ex.cn: 我自己会说，谢谢了！

senses.def: used to tell sb that a general statement they have just made is not true of you
senses.chn: （告诉某人不要以为自己的概括性意见适用于大家）只说你自己，那是你

ex.en: 'We didn't play very well.' 'Speak for yourself!' (= I think that I played well.)
ex.cn: “我们打得不太好。” “是说你自己吧！”

senses.def: used to say that you are the type of person mentioned and are expressing your opinion from that point of view
senses.chn: （表示从某种角度看问题）作为…来说

ex.en: Speaking as a parent, I'm very concerned about standards in education.
ex.cn: 作为家长，我十分关注教育的水准。

senses.def: to say exactly what you think, in a very direct way
senses.chn: 说心里话；说实在的；坦率地说

senses.def: to say sth when you should not, for example because it is not the right time or you are not the right person to say it
senses.chn: 说话不合时宜（或不合身份）

senses.def: to tell you a lot about sth/sb, without the need for words
to say good or bad things about sb
senses.chn: 称赞（或贬损）某人；说某人的好话（或坏话）

senses.def: what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do
people say speak/talk of the devil when sb they have been talking about appears unexpectedly

ex.en: Well, speak of the devil—here's Alice now!
ex.cn: 嗬，说谁谁到——瞧，艾丽斯这就来啦！

senses.def: it is not necessary to give any further explanation about sth because the information that is available already proves that it is true
to say or think bad things about sb

ex.en: Don't speak ill of the dead.
ex.cn: 勿议已故者之短。

senses.def: to be able to communicate easily with another person because you share similar opinions and experience
senses.chn: （因意见和经历相似）能容易地沟通，说得来，有共同语言

senses.def: if you think about it in a particular way; true in some but not all ways
senses.chn: 可以说；不妨说；从某种意义上说

ex.en: All these points of view are related, in a manner of speaking.
ex.cn: 所有这些观点都在某方面相互关联。

senses.def: if you are using words or rules in their exact or correct sense

ex.en: Strictly speaking, the book is not a novel, but a short story.
ex.cn: 严格说来，这部小说不能算长篇，而是短篇。

senses.def: to say sth that you should not because it is the wrong situation or because it offends sb
senses.chn: 说话出格（或冒失、鲁莽、不合时宜）

senses.def: to state the views or wishes of a person or a group; to act as a representative for sb
to be evidence that sth exists or is present

ex.en: Everything here speaks of perfect good taste.
ex.cn: 这里的一切都体现出极为高雅的情趣。

senses.def: to state your opinions publicly, especially in opposition to sth and in a way that takes courage
senses.chn: 挺身（反对某事物）；公开站出来（反对）

senses.def: to talk to sb in a serious way about sth wrong they have done, to try to stop them doing it again
to attract or interest sb/sth

ex.en: The story spoke to him directly.
ex.cn: 这个故事立刻吸引了他。

ex.en: It's a design that speaks to the senses.
ex.cn: 这是一个诉诸感官的设计。

senses.def: to discuss or comment on a topic, problem or situation

ex.en: The show wants to speak to real issues affecting young people.
ex.cn: 这档节目想要讨论深切影响年轻人的问题。

senses.def: to be evidence that sth exists or is true

ex.en: The number of cleaning firms speaks to the fact that cleaning is considered an important service.
ex.cn: 保洁被视为一项重要的服务，保洁公司的数量证明了这个事实。

senses.def: usually used in orders to tell sb to speak more loudly

ex.en: Please speak up—we can't hear you at the back.
ex.cn: 请大声点讲，我们在后面听不见。

senses.def: to say what you think clearly and freely, especially in order to support or defend sb/sth
senses.chn: 明确表态；（尤指为…）说好话，辩护

example.en: I've spoken to the manager about it.
example.cn: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

example.en: Can I speak with you for a minute?
example.cn: 我能跟你谈一会儿吗？

example.en: Would you prefer it if we spoke in German?
example.cn: 我们用德语讲好吗？

senses.def: a place in the US where people could buy alcohol illegally, at the time in the 1920s and 1930s when it was illegal to make or sell alcohol
senses.chn: （美国 20 世纪 20、30 年代禁酒期间）非法经营的酒店

senses.def: a bar like this today that operates legally but secretly
senses.chn: 合法但秘密经营的酒吧

senses.def: a person who gives a talk or makes a speech

ex.en: He was a guest speaker at the conference.
ex.cn: 他是会议的特邀演讲人。

ex.en: She was a brilliant public speaker.
ex.cn: 她很擅长在公开场合演讲。

senses.def: a person who is or was speaking

ex.en: I looked around to see who the speaker was.
ex.cn: 我四下环顾看说话的是谁。

senses.def: a person who speaks a particular language

ex.en: Chinese speakers
ex.cn: 讲汉语的人

ex.en: a native speaker of English
ex.cn: 以英语为母语的人

ex.en: I looked around to see who the speaker was.
ex.cn: 我四下环顾看说话的是谁。

ex.en: a fluent Arabic speaker
ex.cn: 阿拉伯语讲得流利的人

ex.en: The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator.
ex.cn: 理想的候选人定要是善于沟通的人。

ex.en: Myra is a dear, but she's also a terrible gossip.
ex.cn: 迈拉是很可爱，但也是个讨厌的长舌妇。

senses.def: the title of the person whose job is to control the discussions in a parliament

ex.en: the Speaker of the House of Commons/Representatives
ex.cn: 英国下议院／美国众议院议长

senses.def: the part of a radio, computer or piece of musical equipment that the sound comes out of
a telephone that can be used without being held, because it contains a microphone and a loudspeaker
senses.chn: 扬声电话（内置麦克风和扬声器，使用时无须拿起听筒）

senses.def: to state the views or wishes of a person or a group; to act as a representative for sb
used to tell sb that a general statement they have just made is not true of you
senses.chn: （告诉某人不要以为自己的概括性意见适用于大家）只说你自己，那是你

ex.en: 'We didn't play very well.' 'Speak for yourself!' (= I think that I played well.)
ex.cn: “我们打得不太好。” “是说你自己吧！”

senses.def: used to say that you are the type of person mentioned and are expressing your opinion from that point of view
senses.chn: （表示从某种角度看问题）作为…来说
