the way in which a play is produced and presented on stage

ex.en: a modern staging of 'King Lear'
ex.cn: 以现代风格演出的《李尔王》

senses.def: a temporary platform used for standing or working on
a place where people, planes, ships, etc. regularly stop during a long journey
senses.chn: 中途站（或机场、停靠码头）

senses.def: stagnant water or air is not moving and therefore smells unpleasant
not developing, growing or changing
senses.chn: 停滞的；不发展的；无变化的

ex.en: a stagnant economy
ex.cn: 停滞的经济

senses.def: to stop developing or making progress

ex.en: Profits have stagnated.
ex.cn: 利润原地踏步。

ex.en: I feel I'm stagnating in this job.
ex.cn: 我觉得，干这份工作我没有长进。

senses.def: to be or become stagnant

ex.en: The water in the pond was stagnating.
ex.cn: 池塘里的水逐渐变成了死水。

senses.def: the night before a man's wedding, often spent with his male friends
senses.chn: 男子婚前夜（常与男性朋友一同度过）

senses.def: a party that a man has with his male friends just before he gets married, often the night before
senses.chn: 男子婚前聚会（只招待男性朋友）

senses.def: not natural, as if it is being acted by sb in a play
senses.chn: 不自然的；做作的；演戏似的

senses.def: not amusing or interesting; boring and old-fashioned
senses.chn: 没意思的；古板的；一本正经的

senses.def: to leave a mark that is difficult to remove on sth; to be marked in this way

ex.en: I hope it doesn't stain the carpet.
ex.cn: 希望它别把地毯弄脏。

ex.en: This carpet stains easily.
ex.cn: 这块地毯不耐脏。

ex.en: The juice from the berries stained their fingers red.
ex.cn: 浆果汁把他们的手指染成了红色。

senses.def: to change the colour of sth using a coloured liquid

ex.en: to stain wood
ex.cn: 给木料上色

ex.en: Stain the specimen before looking at it under the microscope.
ex.cn: 先把标本染色，再放到显微镜下观察。

ex.en: They stained the floors dark brown.
ex.cn: 他们把地板涂成了深棕色。

senses.def: to damage the opinion that people have of sth

ex.en: The events had stained the city's reputation unfairly.
ex.cn: 这些事件使该市背上了不应有的恶名。

senses.def: a dirty mark on sth, that is difficult to remove

ex.en: a blood/a coffee/an ink, etc. stain
ex.cn: 血迹、咖啡渍、墨痕等

ex.en: stubborn stains (= that are very difficult to remove)
ex.cn: 顽固的污渍

ex.en: How can I get this stain out?
ex.cn: 我怎么才能把这点污渍除去？

ex.en: The carpet has been treated so that it is stain-resistant (= it does not stain easily).
ex.cn: 这地毯已经过处理，不易挂污。

ex.en: The kids left dirty marks all over the kitchen floor.
ex.cn: 孩子们把厨房的地板弄得污迹斑斑。

ex.en: blood stains
ex.cn: 血迹

senses.def: a liquid used for changing the colour of wood or cloth
something that damages a person's reputation, so that people think badly of them

example.en: I hope it doesn't stain the carpet.
example.cn: 希望它别把地毯弄脏。

example.en: The juice from the berries stained their fingers red.
example.cn: 浆果汁把他们的手指染成了红色。

example.en: to stain wood
example.cn: 给木料上色

senses.def: covered with stains or marked with a stain
senses.chn: 满是污痕的；沾有污渍的

ex.en: My dress was stained.
ex.cn: 我的连衣裙弄上了污渍。

ex.en: paint-stained jeans
ex.cn: 沾满油漆的牛仔裤

ex.en: If your hands are dirty, go and wash them.
ex.cn: 要是你的手脏了，就去洗一洗。

ex.en: There were shelves full of dusty books.
ex.cn: 有些书架上全是布满灰尘的书。

ex.en: It's absolutely filthy in here.
ex.cn: 这里面脏得不得了。

ex.en: Don't you come in here with those muddy boots on!
ex.cn: 你不要穿着那双沾满泥浆的靴子进来！

senses.def: pieces of coloured glass that are put together to make windows, especially in churches
a type of steel that does not rust (= change colour)
a set of steps built between two floors inside a building

ex.en: We had to carry the piano up three flights of stairs.
ex.cn: 我们不得不抬着钢琴上了三段楼梯。

ex.en: The children ran up/down the stairs.
ex.cn: 孩子们跑上／跑下楼去。

ex.en: at the bottom/top of the stairs
ex.cn: 在楼梯下端／顶端

ex.en: He remembered passing her on the stairs.
ex.cn: 他记得在楼梯上与她擦肩而过。

senses.def: one of the steps in a set of stairs

ex.en: How many stairs are there up to the second floor?
ex.cn: 上到第三层一共有多少磴楼梯？

senses.def: in the part of a house where the servants lived in the past
a set of stairs inside a building including the posts and rails (= banisters) that are fixed at the side

ex.en: a marble/stone/wooden staircase
ex.cn: 大理石／石头／木楼梯

senses.def: a piece of equipment in the form of a seat that sb can sit on to be moved up and down stairs, used by people who find it difficult to walk up and down stairs without help
senses.chn: 座椅式升降器（供无法步行上下楼的人使用）

senses.def: a set of stairs inside or outside a building
the space in a building in which the stairs are built
senses.chn: 楼梯井（建筑物内楼梯占用的空间）

senses.def: a wooden or metal post that is pointed at one end and pushed into the ground in order to support sth, mark a particular place, etc.
a wooden post that sb could be tied to in former times before being burnt to death (= killed by fire) as a punishment

ex.en: Joan of Arc was burnt at the stake.
ex.cn: 圣女贞德被处以火刑。

senses.def: money that sb invests in a company

ex.en: a 20% stake in the business
ex.cn: 那家公司 20% 的股份

senses.def: an important part or share in a business, plan, etc. that is important to you and that you want to be successful
senses.chn: （在公司、计划等中的）重大利益，重大利害关系

ex.en: She has a personal stake in the success of the play.
ex.cn: 这出戏成功与否对她个人有重大利害关系。

ex.en: Many young people no longer feel they have a stake in society.
ex.cn: 很多年轻人不再觉得他们与社会休戚相关。

senses.def: something that you risk losing, especially money, when you try to predict the result of a race, game, etc., or when you are involved in an activity that can succeed or fail

ex.en: How much was the stake (= how much did you bet)?
ex.cn: 下了多少注？

ex.en: They were playing cards for high stakes (= a lot of money).
ex.cn: 他们当时正在打扑克，赌注很高。

senses.def: the money that is paid to the winners in horse racing
used in the names of some horse races
senses.chn: （用于某些赛马赛事的名称）…赛

senses.def: that can be won or lost, depending on the success of a particular action
senses.chn: 成败难料；得失都可能；有风险

ex.en: We cannot afford to take risks when people's lives are at stake.
ex.cn: 在性命攸关的事情上，不容我们有闪失。

ex.en: The prize at stake is a place in the final.
ex.cn: 这次如果获胜，便能进入决赛。

senses.def: to be prepared to do anything in order to defend your opinions or beliefs
senses.chn: 为坚持自己的观点（或信仰）甘冒一切危险；为维护自己的观点（或信仰）不惜赴汤蹈火

senses.def: used to say how much of a particular quality a person has, as if they were in a competition in which some people are more successful than others
senses.chn: （评论一个人的某种品质高或低）要是比…的话，论…

ex.en: John doesn't do too well in the personality stakes.
ex.cn: 论人格魅力，约翰很一般。

senses.def: to suddenly move from your house and go to live somewhere else
to risk money or sth important on the result of sth

ex.en: He staked £25 on the favourite (= for example, in horse racing).
ex.cn: 他在那匹众人看好的马上押了 25 英镑。

ex.en: She staked her political career on tax reform, and lost.
ex.cn: 她把自己的政治前程押在税制改革上，结果赌输了。

ex.en: That's him over there—I'd stake my life on it (= I am completely confident).
ex.cn: 就是那边那个人，我敢拿脑袋打赌。

senses.def: to support sth with a stake (1)

ex.en: to stake newly planted trees
ex.cn: 用木桩支撑新植的树

senses.def: to say or show publicly that you think sth should be yours
senses.chn: 公开宣布自己（对某物）的所有权；向公众表示某物应属于自己

ex.en: Adams staked his claim for a place in the Olympic team with his easy win yesterday.
ex.cn: 亚当斯昨天轻松获胜，这无异于告诉人们奥运代表队中应有他的位置。

senses.def: to clearly mark the limits of sth that you claim is yours
senses.chn: 清楚地界定自认为属于自己的东西

senses.def: to state your opinion, position, etc. on sth very clearly
senses.chn: 明确阐述自己的看法（或立场等）

ex.en: The President staked out his position on the issue.
ex.cn: 总统明确阐述了他在这个问题上的立场。

senses.def: to watch a place secretly, especially for signs of illegal activity

ex.en: Detectives had been staking out the house for several weeks.
ex.cn: 警探们已对这所房子监视了几个星期。

senses.def: a person or company that is involved in a particular organization, project, system, etc., especially because they have invested money in it
senses.chn: （某组织、工程、体系等的）参与人，参与方；有权益关系者

ex.en: The government has said it wants to create a stakeholder economy in which all members of society feel that they have an interest in its success.
ex.cn: 政府表示希望建立一种人人参与的经济模式，让社会全体成员觉得其繁荣将给每个人带来利益。

senses.def: a person who holds all the bets placed on a game or race and who pays the money to the winner
a situation in which police watch a building secretly to find evidence of illegal activities

a long pointed piece of rock hanging down from the roof of a cave, formed over a long period of time as water containing lime (= a hollow place underground), formed over a long period of time as water containing lime runs off the roof

a piece of rock pointing upwards from the floor of a cave, that is formed over a long period of time from drops of water containing lime (= a hollow place underground), that is formed over a long period of time from drops of water containing lime that fall from the roof
no longer fresh and therefore unpleasant to eat
no longer fresh; smelling unpleasant
senses.chn: 不新鲜的；（空气）污浊的；（烟味）难闻的

ex.en: stale cigarette smoke
ex.cn: 难闻的烟味儿

ex.en: stale sweat
ex.cn: 汗臭味

senses.def: something that is stale has been said or done too many times before and is no longer interesting or exciting
senses.chn: 陈腐的；没有新意的；老掉牙的

ex.en: stale jokes
ex.cn: 老掉牙的笑话

ex.en: Their marriage had gone stale.
ex.cn: 他们的婚姻已了无热情。

senses.def: a person who is stale has done the same thing for too long and so is unable to do it well or produce any new ideas
senses.chn: （因持续做某事时间太长）厌倦的，腻烦的

ex.en: After ten years in the job, she felt stale and needed a change.
ex.cn: 在那个岗位干了十年之后，她觉得腻了，需要换换工作。

senses.def: a disagreement or a situation in a competition in which neither side is able to win or make any progress
senses.chn: （辩论或竞赛中出现的）僵局，僵持局面

ex.en: The talks ended in (a) stalemate.
ex.cn: 谈判陷入僵局，无果而终。

senses.def: a situation in which a player cannot successfully move any of their pieces and the game ends without a winner
the policies and beliefs of Stalin, especially that the Communist party should be the only party and that the central government should control the whole political and economic system
a thin stem that supports a leaf, flower or fruit and joins it to another part of the plant or tree; the main stem of a plant
senses.chn: （叶）柄；（花）梗；（果实的）柄；（植物的）茎，秆

ex.en: flowers on long stalks
ex.cn: 长茎上的花

ex.en: celery stalks
ex.cn: 芹菜茎

ex.en: He ate the apple, stalk and all.
ex.cn: 他把那个苹果吃了个干净，连梗都没剩下。

senses.def: a long thin structure that supports sth, especially an organ in some animals, and joins it on to another part

ex.en: Crabs have eyes on stalks.
ex.cn: 螃蟹的眼睛长在肉柄上。

senses.def: to move slowly and quietly towards an animal or a person, in order to kill, catch or harm it or them
senses.chn: 偷偷接近，潜近（猎物或人）

ex.en: The lion was stalking a zebra.
ex.cn: 狮子偷偷接近斑马。

ex.en: He stalked his victim as she walked home, before attacking and robbing her.
ex.cn: 她步行回家时，他偷偷地接近然后下手袭击，并且抢劫了她。

senses.def: to illegally follow and watch sb over a long period of time, in a way that is annoying or frightening

ex.en: She claimed that he had been stalking her over a period of three years.
ex.cn: 她声称，三年来他一直在盯她的梢。

senses.def: to walk in an angry or proud way
senses.chn: 怒冲冲地走；趾高气扬地走

ex.en: He stalked off without a word.
ex.cn: 他一言未发，怒冲冲地走了。

senses.def: to move through a place in an unpleasant or threatening way
senses.chn: 令人厌恶地穿过；威胁地通过

ex.en: The gunmen stalked the building, looking for victims.
ex.cn: 这些持枪歹徒凶神恶煞般地打楼里走过，寻找袭击的目标。

ex.en: Fear stalks the streets of the city at night.
ex.cn: 夜间，这座城市的大街小巷笼罩着恐怖气氛。

senses.def: a person who follows and watches another person over a long period of time in a way that is annoying or frightening
a person who follows an animal quietly and slowly, especially in order to kill or capture it
the crime of following and watching sb over a long period of time in a way that is annoying or frightening
a person or thing that is used to hide the real purpose of a particular course of action
senses.chn: 用以掩人耳目的人（或物）；用以掩蔽的事物

senses.def: a politician who competes against the leader of their party in order to see how much support the leader has; a stronger candidate can then compete against the leader more seriously
senses.chn: （为试探对手支持率而推出的）掩护性候选人

senses.def: a table or small shop with an open front that people sell things from, especially at a market
senses.chn: 货摊，摊位，售货亭（尤指集市上的）

ex.en: a market stall
ex.cn: 集市上的货摊

senses.def: a section inside a farm building that is large enough for one animal to be kept in
a small area in a room, surrounded by glass, walls, etc., that contains a shower or toilet
senses.chn: （房间内的）小隔间，淋浴室，洗手间

senses.def: the seats that are nearest to the stage in a theatre

ex.en: the front row of the stalls
ex.cn: 正厅第一排

senses.def: the seats at the front of a church where the choir (= singers) and priests sit
senses.chn: （教堂内）唱诗班和牧师的座位

senses.def: a situation in which a vehicle's engine suddenly stops because it is not getting enough power
senses.chn: （车辆发动机的）熄火；（车辆的）抛锚

senses.def: a situation in which an aircraft loses speed and goes steeply downwards
to stop suddenly because of a lack of power or speed; to make a vehicle or engine do this

ex.en: The car stalled and refused to start again.
ex.cn: 汽车熄火打不着了。

ex.en: I stalled the car three times during my driving test.
ex.cn: 我考驾照时车子熄了三次火。

senses.def: to try to avoid doing sth or answering a question so that you have more time

ex.en: They are still stalling on the deal.
ex.cn: 他们仍在拖时间，而不急于达成协议。

ex.en: 'What do you mean?' she asked, stalling for time.
ex.cn: “你这是什么意思？” 她问，故意拖延着时间。

senses.def: to make sb wait so that you have more time to do sth
senses.chn: 拖住（以赢得时间做某事）

ex.en: See if you can stall her while I finish searching her office.
ex.cn: 你看能不能拖住她，我好把她的办公室搜查完。

senses.def: to stop sth from happening until a later date; to stop making progress

ex.en: attempts to revive the stalled peace plan
ex.cn: 旨在重新启动搁置了的和平计划的努力

ex.en: Discussions have once again stalled.
ex.cn: 讨论再次停顿下来。

example.en: I stalled the car three times during my driving test.
example.cn: 我考驾照时车子熄了三次火。

senses.def: a person who sells things from a stall in a market, etc.
a fully grown male horse, especially one that is used for breeding
a loyal supporter who does a lot of work for an organization, especially a political party
senses.chn: （政党等组织的）忠诚拥护者，坚定分子

senses.def: loyal and able to be relied on, even in a difficult situation

ex.en: stalwart supporters
ex.cn: 忠实的拥护者

senses.def: physically strong
a small thin male part in the middle of a flower that produces pollen and is made up of a stalk supporting an anther . The centre of each flower usually has several stamens.
the physical or mental strength that enables you to do sth difficult for long periods of time

ex.en: It takes a lot of stamina to run a marathon.
ex.cn: 跑马拉松需要很大的耐力。

senses.def: to speak with difficulty, repeating sounds or words and often stopping, before saying things correctly

ex.en: Many children stammer but grow out of it.
ex.cn: 很多小孩口吃，但长大后就改过来了。

ex.en: 'W-w-what?' he stammered.
ex.cn: “什…什…什么？” 他结巴着说。

ex.en: She was barely able to stammer out a description of her attacker.
ex.cn: 她只能勉强结结巴巴地说一说袭击她的人是什么模样。

senses.def: a problem that sb has in speaking in which they repeat sounds or words or often pause before saying things correctly

example.en: 'W-w-what?' he stammered.
example.cn: “什…什…什么？” 他结巴着说。

example.en: She was barely able to stammer out a description of her attacker.
example.cn: 她只能勉强结结巴巴地说一说袭击她的人是什么模样。

senses.def: a small piece of paper with a design on it that you buy and stick on an envelope or a package before you post it

ex.en: a 62p stamp
ex.cn: 一枚 62 便士的邮票

ex.en: Could I have three first-class stamps, please?
ex.cn: 请给我拿三张第一类邮件的邮票。

ex.en: He has been collecting stamps since he was eight.
ex.cn: 他从八岁开始集邮。

ex.en: a stamp album
ex.cn: 集邮册

senses.def: a tool for printing the date or a design or mark onto a surface

ex.en: a date stamp
ex.cn: 日期戳

senses.def: a design or words made by stamping sth onto a surface

ex.en: The passports, with the visa stamps, were waiting at the embassy.
ex.cn: 那些护照都加盖了签证章，在大使馆等待领取。

ex.en: The project has the government's stamp of approval.
ex.cn: 工程已获得政府批准。

senses.def: a small piece of paper with a design on it, stuck on a document to show that a particular amount of money has been paid

ex.en: a TV licence stamp
ex.cn: 电视收视许可证印花

senses.def: the mark or sign of a particular quality or person

ex.en: All his work bears the stamp of authority.
ex.cn: 他的一切工作都具有权威性。

senses.def: a kind or class, especially of people

ex.en: men of a different stamp
ex.cn: 另一类人

senses.def: an act or sound of stamping the foot

ex.en: The stamp of hoofs alerted Isabel.
ex.cn: 马蹄声引起了伊莎贝尔的警觉。

senses.def: to put your foot down heavily and noisily on the ground

ex.en: I tried stamping my feet to keep warm.
ex.cn: 我跺了一阵脚想暖和暖和。

ex.en: Sam stamped his foot in anger.
ex.cn: 萨姆气得直跺脚。

ex.en: The audience were stamping and cheering.
ex.cn: 观众又是跺脚，又是欢呼。

senses.def: to walk with loud heavy steps

ex.en: She turned and stamped out of the room.
ex.cn: 她扭身嗵嗵地走出了房间。

senses.def: to print letters, words, a design, etc. onto sth using a special tool
senses.chn: 在…上盖（字样或图案等）；把（字样或图案等）盖在…上

ex.en: The box was stamped with the maker's name.
ex.cn: 盒子上盖有制作者的印章。

ex.en: Wait here to have your passport stamped.
ex.cn: 请在这里等候给护照盖章。

ex.en: I'll stamp the company name on your cheque.
ex.cn: 我来给你的支票盖上公司的章。

ex.en: The maker's name was stamped in gold on the box.
ex.cn: 盒子上盖有制作者的金字印章。

senses.def: to make a feeling show clearly on sb's face, in their actions, etc.

ex.en: Their faces were stamped with hostility.
ex.cn: 他们的神情充满敌意。

ex.en: The crime had revenge stamped all over it.
ex.cn: 从各方面看这次犯罪都是复仇行为。

senses.def: to show that sb has a particular quality

ex.en: Her success has stamped her as one of the country's top riders.
ex.cn: 她的成功表明她是全国最出色的骑手之一。

senses.def: to stick a stamp on a letter or package
to cut and shape an object from a piece of metal or plastic using a special machine or tool
to put your foot down with force on sth

ex.en: The child stamped on the spider.
ex.cn: 小孩踩了那只蜘蛛一脚。

senses.def: to stop sth from happening or stop sb from doing sth, especially by using force or authority

ex.en: All attempts at modernization were stamped on by senior officials.
ex.cn: 旨在实现现代化的努力统统受到高级官员的压制。

senses.def: to make sth have an important effect or influence on sth
senses.chn: 在…上打上…印记；把…铭刻在…中

ex.en: She stamped her own interpretation on the role.
ex.cn: 她给那个角色注入了自己的诠释。

senses.def: to get rid of sth that is bad, unpleasant or dangerous, especially by using force or a lot of effort
senses.chn: （尤指通过武力或不懈努力）消除，消灭，镇压

ex.en: to stamp out racism
ex.cn: 消灭种族主义

senses.def: to put out a fire by bringing your foot down heavily on it

example.en: The box was stamped with the maker's name.
example.cn: 盒子上盖有制作者的印章。

example.en: I'll stamp the company name on your cheque.
example.cn: 我来给你的支票盖上公司的章。

example.en: Their faces were stamped with hostility.
example.cn: 他们的神情充满敌意。

phrases.filled: stamp B over, across, etc. A

example.en: The crime had revenge stamped all over it.
example.cn: 从各方面看这次犯罪都是复仇行为。

senses.def: the hobby of collecting stamps from different countries
a tax in Britain on some legal documents
an envelope on which you have written your name and address and put a stamp so that sb else can use it to send sth to you
senses.chn: （写上姓名地址且贴有邮票的）回邮信封

ex.en: Please enclose a stamped addressed envelope to get your test results.
ex.cn: 请附姓名地址邮资俱全的信封，以便把化验结果寄给你。

senses.def: a situation in which a group of people or large animals such as horses suddenly start running in the same direction, especially because they are frightened or excited
senses.chn: （人群的）奔逃，蜂拥；（兽群的）惊跑，狂奔

ex.en: A stampede broke out when the doors opened.
ex.cn: 门一开，人们蜂拥而出。

senses.def: a situation in which a lot of people are trying to do or achieve the same thing at the same time

ex.en: Falling interest rates has led to a stampede to buy property.
ex.cn: 不断下降的利率引发了一场购房热。

senses.def: to run in a stampede; to make animals do this

ex.en: a herd of stampeding elephants
ex.cn: 一群狂奔的大象

ex.en: A huge bunch of kids came stampeding down the corridor.
ex.cn: 一大群孩子顺着走廊涌了过来。

senses.def: to make sb rush into doing sth without giving them time to think about it

ex.en: I refuse to be stampeded into making any hasty decisions.
ex.cn: 我不愿仓促行事，草率作决定。

senses.def: a place that sb likes and where they often go
to put your foot down with force on sth

ex.en: The child stamped on the spider.
ex.cn: 小孩踩了那只蜘蛛一脚。

senses.def: to stop sth from happening or stop sb from doing sth, especially by using force or authority

ex.en: All attempts at modernization were stamped on by senior officials.
ex.cn: 旨在实现现代化的努力统统受到高级官员的压制。

senses.def: to make sth have an important effect or influence on sth
senses.chn: 在…上打上…印记；把…铭刻在…中

ex.en: She stamped her own interpretation on the role.
ex.cn: 她给那个角色注入了自己的诠释。

senses.def: the opinions that sb has about sth and expresses publicly

ex.en: What is the newspaper's stance on the war?
ex.cn: 那家报纸对这场战争持什么立场？

senses.def: the way in which sb stands, especially when playing a sport
senses.chn: （尤指体育运动中的）站立姿势

senses.def: a vertical pole used to support sth
to be on your feet; to be in a vertical position

ex.en: She was too weak to stand.
ex.cn: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

ex.en: a bird standing on one leg
ex.cn: 单腿独立的鸟

ex.en: Don't just stand there —do something!
ex.cn: 别光站着，干点什么！

ex.en: I was standing only a few feet away.
ex.cn: 当时我就站在几英尺远的地方。

ex.en: We all stood around in the corridor waiting.
ex.cn: 我们分散站在过道里等着。

ex.en: to stand on your head/hands (= to be upside down, balancing on your head/hands)
ex.cn: 用头／用手倒立

senses.def: to get up onto your feet from another position

ex.en: Everyone stood when the President came in.
ex.cn: 总统进来时大家都起立。

ex.en: We stood up in order to get a better view.
ex.cn: 我们站起身来以便看得更清楚。

ex.en: She was too weak to stand.
ex.cn: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

ex.en: Stand still when I'm talking to you!
ex.cn: 我跟你说话，站着别动！

ex.en: We stood talking for a few minutes.
ex.cn: 我们站着谈了几分钟。

ex.en: He stood and looked out to sea.
ex.cn: 他站着向大海望去。

senses.def: to put sth/sb in a vertical position somewhere

ex.en: Stand the ladder up against the wall.
ex.cn: 把梯子靠墙立好。

ex.en: I stood the little girl on a chair so that she could see.
ex.cn: 我让小女孩站到椅子上，好让她看得见。

senses.def: to be in a particular place

ex.en: The castle stands on the site of an ancient battlefield.
ex.cn: 那座城堡坐落在一片古战场上。

ex.en: An old oak tree once stood here.
ex.cn: 以前这儿长着一棵老橡树。

senses.def: to be in a particular condition or situation

ex.en: The house stood empty for a long time.
ex.cn: 那所房子空了好长一段时间。

ex.en: 'You're wrong about the date—it was 1988.' ' I stand corrected (= accept that I was wrong).'
ex.cn: “你把日期搞错了，是 1988 年。” “你说得对，是我搞错了。”

ex.en: You never know where you stand with her—one minute she's friendly, the next she'll hardly speak to you.
ex.cn: 你从来拿不准你和她的关系如何，她一会儿跟你亲热，一会儿连话也不大跟你说。

ex.en: As things stand, there is little chance of a quick settlement of the dispute.
ex.cn: 照目前的形势，尽快解决争端的可能微乎其微。

senses.def: to be a particular height

ex.en: The tower stands 30 metres high.
ex.cn: 塔高 30 米。

senses.def: to be at a particular level, amount, height, etc.
senses.chn: 达特定水平（或数量、高度等）

ex.en: Interest rates stand at 3%.
ex.cn: 利率为 3%。

ex.en: The world record then stood at 6.59 metres.
ex.cn: 当时的世界纪录是 6.59 米。

senses.def: to be in a particular place, especially while waiting to go somewhere

ex.en: The train standing at platform 3 is for London, Victoria.
ex.cn: 停在第 3 站台的火车开往伦敦维多利亚站。

senses.def: to remain still, without moving or being moved

ex.en: Mix the batter and let it stand for twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 搅好面糊以后，放上二十分钟。

ex.en: standing pools of rainwater
ex.cn: 雨水洼

senses.def: if an offer, a decision, etc. made earlier stands, it is still valid

ex.en: My offer still stands.
ex.cn: 我的出价仍然算数。

ex.en: The world record stood for 20 years.
ex.cn: 那项世界纪录 20 年未被打破。

senses.def: to be in a situation where you are likely to do sth

ex.en: You stand to make a lot from this deal.
ex.cn: 你很可能会从这笔生意中大赚一笔。

senses.def: to have a particular attitude or opinion about sth or towards sb
senses.chn: （对某事）持某种态度，有某一观点，采取某种立场

ex.en: Where do you stand on private education?
ex.cn: 你对私立教育持什么观点？

senses.def: used especially in negative sentences and questions to emphasize that you do not like sb/sth
senses.chn: （尤用于否定句和疑问句，强调不喜欢）容忍，忍受

ex.en: I can't stand his brother.
ex.cn: 他弟弟让我受不了。

ex.en: I can't stand the sight of blood.
ex.cn: 一看见血我就难受。

ex.en: I can't stand it when you do that.
ex.cn: 你那么做，我受不了。

ex.en: She couldn't stand being kept waiting.
ex.cn: 叫她等着，她会受不了。

ex.en: I can't stand people interrupting all the time.
ex.cn: 我不能容忍老有人打岔。

ex.en: How do you stand him being here all the time?
ex.cn: 他老在这儿，你怎么受得了呢？

senses.def: used especially with can/could to say that sb/sth can survive sth or can tolerate sth without being hurt or damaged
senses.chn: （尤与 can 或 could 连用）经受，承受，经得起

ex.en: His heart won't stand the strain much longer.
ex.cn: 他的心脏对这种压力承受不了多久。

ex.en: Modern plastics can stand very high and very low temperatures.
ex.cn: 新型塑料能承受很高和很低的温度。

senses.def: to buy a drink or meal for sb
senses.chn: 花钱请（某人喝饮料或吃饭）；买…请客

ex.en: He stood drinks all round.
ex.cn: 他请客，让大家喝了饮料。

ex.en: She was kind enough to stand us a meal.
ex.cn: 她真好，请我们吃了饭。

senses.def: to be a candidate in an election

ex.en: He stood for parliament (= tried to get elected as an MP).
ex.cn: 他竞选过议会议员。

ex.en: She stood unsuccessfully as a candidate in the local elections.
ex.cn: 她参加过地方选举，但未能当选。

senses.def: to move to one side

ex.en: She stood aside to let us pass.
ex.cn: 她站到一边让我们过。

senses.def: to not get involved in sth
senses.chn: 不参与；不介入；置身事外

ex.en: Don't stand aside and let others do all the work.
ex.cn: 不要袖手旁观，工作都让别人去做。

senses.def: to stop doing a job so sb else can do it
senses.chn: 退居一旁；让位于他人；靠边

senses.def: to move back from a place

ex.en: The police ordered the crowd to stand back.
ex.cn: 警察命令人群往后退。

senses.def: to be located away from sth
senses.chn: 位于离…有一段距离的地方

ex.en: The house stands back from the road.
ex.cn: 房子离公路有一段距离。

senses.def: to think about a situation as if you are not involved in it

ex.en: It's time to stand back and look at your career so far.
ex.cn: 现在你该从旁观者的角度来审视一下自己迄今的职业生涯了。

senses.def: to prevent sb from getting or achieving sth

ex.en: Only one game stood between him and victory.
ex.cn: 只要再赢一场比赛他就能胜出。

senses.def: to be present while sth bad is happening but not do anything to stop it

ex.en: How can you stand by and see him accused of something he didn't do?
ex.cn: 你怎么能眼睁睁看着他遭人诬陷呢？

senses.def: to be ready for action
senses.chn: 做好随时行动的准备；做好准备

ex.en: The troops are standing by.
ex.cn: 部队随时待命出动。

senses.def: to help sb or be friends with them, even in difficult situations

ex.en: her famous song, 'Stand by your man'
ex.cn: 她的著名歌曲《忠于你的男人》

senses.def: to still believe or agree with sth you said, decided or agreed earlier
senses.chn: 仍然遵守诺言（或协议等）

ex.en: She still stands by every word she said.
ex.cn: 她依旧恪守她说过的每一句话。

senses.def: to leave a job or position

ex.en: He stood down to make way for someone younger.
ex.cn: 他退下来好为年轻人让路。

senses.def: to leave the witness box
to be an abbreviation or symbol of sth

ex.en: 'The book's by T.C. Smith.' 'What does the 'T.C.' stand for?'
ex.cn: “这部书是 T.C. 史密斯写的。” “ T.C. 是什么的缩写？”

senses.def: to support sth

ex.en: I hated the organization and all it stood for (= the ideas that it supported).
ex.cn: 我厌恶那个组织，也厌恶它的一切主张。

senses.def: to not let sb do sth or sth happen

ex.en: I'm not standing for it any longer.
ex.cn: 这种事我再也不能容忍了。

senses.def: to take sb's place

ex.en: My assistant will stand in for me while I'm away.
ex.cn: 我不在期间，由我的助手代替我。

senses.def: to be much better or more important than sb/sth

ex.en: Four points stand out as being more important than the rest.
ex.cn: 有四点比其余各点更为重要。

senses.def: to be easily seen; to be noticeable

ex.en: The lettering stood out well against the dark background.
ex.cn: 那种字体在深色背景下十分醒目。

ex.en: She's the sort of person who stands out in a crowd.
ex.cn: 她是那种在人群中很显眼的人。

senses.def: be near sb and watch them

ex.en: I don't like you standing over me while I'm cooking.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢做饭时你在一旁盯着我。

senses.def: to be on your feet

ex.en: There were no seats left so I had to stand up.
ex.cn: 没有座位了，所以我只好站着。

ex.en: You'll look taller if you stand up straight.
ex.cn: 站直身子，你会显得高些。

senses.def: to deliberately not meet sb you have arranged to meet, especially sb you are having a romantic relationship with
senses.chn: （尤指恋人）故意失约使某人空等，放某人鸽子

ex.en: I've been stood up!
ex.cn: 人家让我空等一场！

senses.def: to support or defend sb/sth

ex.en: Always stand up for your friends.
ex.cn: 任何时候都要支持自己的朋友。

ex.en: You must stand up for your rights.
ex.cn: 你必须维护自己的权利。

ex.en: She had learnt to stand up for herself.
ex.cn: 她学会了自我保护。

senses.def: to remain valid even when tested, examined closely, etc.

ex.en: His argument simply doesn't stand up to close scrutiny.
ex.cn: 他的论点完全经不起仔细推敲。

ex.en: I'm afraid this document will never stand up in a court of law.
ex.cn: 恐怕这份文件在法庭上是根本站不住的。

senses.def: to resist sb; to not accept bad treatment from sb without complaining
senses.chn: 抵抗；勇敢反对；不甘忍受某人的欺负（或不公平对待）

ex.en: It was brave of her to stand up to those bullies.
ex.cn: 她不向那几个坏蛋屈服，真是勇敢。

senses.def: to remain in good condition despite rough treatment

ex.en: The carpet is designed to stand up to a lot of wear and tear.
ex.cn: 这种地毯设计得十分耐用。

senses.def: an attitude towards sth or an opinion that you make clear to people

ex.en: to take a firm stand on sth
ex.cn: 在某事上采取坚定的立场

ex.en: He was criticized for his tough stand on immigration.
ex.cn: 他因在移民问题上立场强硬受到批评。

senses.def: a strong effort to defend yourself or your opinion about sth

ex.en: We must make a stand against further job losses.
ex.cn: 我们必须采取措施，防止进一步裁员。

ex.en: the rebels' desperate last stand
ex.cn: 反叛者最后的疯狂抵抗

senses.def: a table or a vertical structure that goods are sold from, especially in the street or at a market

ex.en: a hamburger/newspaper stand
ex.cn: 汉堡包售卖亭；报摊

senses.def: a table or a vertical structure where things are displayed or advertised, for example at an exhibition
senses.chn: （展示或推介物品的）桌，台，摊位

ex.en: a display/an exhibition/a trade stand
ex.cn: 展位；展销台

senses.def: a piece of equipment or furniture that you use for holding a particular type of thing

ex.en: a bicycle/microphone/cake, etc. stand
ex.cn: 自行车停靠架、麦克风架、蛋糕座等

senses.def: a large sloping structure at a stadium with rows where people sit or stand to watch the game
the period of time in which two people who are batting (= hitting the ball) play together and score points
senses.chn: 两个击球员同时在场上并跑动得分的阶段；双人配对

ex.en: Clinch and Harris shared an opening stand of 69.
ex.cn: 克林奇和哈里斯两位击球员，比赛一开始时搭档，共得 69 分。

senses.def: a raised platform for a band, an orchestra, a speaker, etc.
senses.chn: （用于演出或演讲等的）舞台，高台，台

senses.def: a place where taxis, buses, etc. park while they are waiting for passengers
a group of plants or trees of one kind

ex.en: a stand of pines
ex.cn: 松树丛

senses.def: a piece of land that you can buy and use for building a house, etc. on

ex.en: A developer bought the land and divided it into stands.
ex.cn: 开发商买下这块土地将其分为多块建筑用地。

senses.def: to refuse to move back; to refuse to change your opinions
senses.chn: 坚定不移；不让步；坚持自己的观点

example.en: Stand still while I take your photo.
example.cn: 我给你照相，站着别动。

example.en: We stood up in order to get a better view.
example.cn: 我们站起身来以便看得更清楚。

example.en: I can't stand his brother.
example.cn: 他弟弟让我受不了。

example.en: She couldn't stand being kept waiting.
example.cn: 叫她等着，她会受不了。

example.en: I can't stand people interrupting all the time.
example.cn: 我不能容忍老有人打岔。

example.en: She was kind enough to stand us a meal.
example.cn: 她真好，请我们吃了饭。

senses.def: to be independent or not connected with other people, organizations or ideas

ex.en: These islands are too small to stand alone as independent states.
ex.cn: 这些岛屿太小，不能成为独立的国家。

senses.def: to be not near other objects or buildings

ex.en: The arch once stood alone at the entrance to the castle.
ex.cn: 拱门曾经孤零零地矗立在城堡的入口处。

senses.def: able to be operated on its own without being connected to a larger system
a level of quality, especially one that people think is acceptable

ex.en: a fall in academic standards
ex.cn: 学术水准的下降

ex.en: We aim to maintain high standards of customer care.
ex.cn: 我们的宗旨是始终以高标准为顾客服务。

ex.en: The standard of this year's applications is very low.
ex.cn: 今年的申请标准很低。

ex.en: He failed to reach the required standard, and did not qualify for the race.
ex.cn: 他未能达到所要求的标准，因而不具备参赛资格。

ex.en: Her work is not up to standard (= of a good enough standard).
ex.cn: 她的工作不合格。

ex.en: Who sets the standard for water quality?
ex.cn: 水质标准由谁来制定？

senses.def: a level of quality that is normal or acceptable for a particular person or in a particular situation
senses.chn: 正常的水平；应达到的标准

ex.en: You'd better lower your standards if you want to find somewhere cheap to live.
ex.cn: 要想找个便宜的地方住，你最好降低要求。

ex.en: It was a simple meal by Eddie's standards.
ex.cn: 在埃迪看来，那不过是一顿便饭。

ex.en: The equipment is slow and heavy by modern standards.
ex.cn: 按现代标准，那台设备又慢又笨重。

senses.def: a level of behaviour that sb considers to be morally acceptable

ex.en: a man of high moral standards
ex.cn: 道德水准高的人

ex.en: Standards aren't what they used to be.
ex.cn: 现在的行为标准和过去不一样了。

senses.def: a unit of measurement that is officially used; an official rule used when producing sth
senses.chn: 法定度量衡标准；法定含量；技术规范；产品规格

ex.en: a reduction in the weight standard of silver coins
ex.cn: 银币法定重量标准的降低

ex.en: industry standards
ex.cn: 工业标准

senses.def: a flag that is used during official ceremonies, especially one connected with a particular military group
senses.chn: 仪式上使用的旗帜；（尤指）军旗

senses.def: a song that has been recorded by many different singers
senses.chn: （很多歌手录制过的）经典曲目

senses.def: average or normal rather than having special or unusual features
senses.chn: 普通的；正常的；通常的；标准的

ex.en: A standard letter was sent to all candidates.
ex.cn: 给所有求职者均寄去了一封标准函。

ex.en: Televisions are a standard feature in most hotel rooms.
ex.cn: 电视机是多数旅馆房间里的标准设施。

ex.en: the standard rate of tax (= paid by everyone)
ex.cn: 标准税率

ex.en: It is standard practice to search visitors as they enter the building.
ex.cn: 对进入这栋建筑物的来访者进行搜查是例行做法。

ex.en: All vehicles come with a CD player as standard.
ex.cn: 所有汽车售出时通常都配有 CD 播放机。

senses.def: following a particular standard set, for example, by an industry
senses.chn: （符合）标准的；按一定规格制作的

ex.en: standard sizes of clothes
ex.cn: 服装的标准尺寸

senses.def: read by most people who are studying a particular subject
believed to be correct and used by most people

ex.en: Standard English
ex.cn: 规范的英语

senses.def: a leader in a political group or campaign
a fixed amount of money that you can earn free of tax
senses.chn: 工资免税标准；工资免税额

senses.def: the amount by which measurements in a set vary from the average for the set
a method of measuring how accurate an estimate is
senses.chn: 标准误差（用于衡量估计的准确性）

senses.def: (in Scotland) an exam in a particular subject at a lower level than Highers. Standard Grades are usually taken in a number of different subjects at the age of 16.
senses.chn: （苏格兰）标准级别考试（学生通常在 16 岁时参加）

senses.def: to make objects or activities of the same type have the same features or qualities; to make sth standard
senses.chn: 使标准化；使符合标准（或规格）

ex.en: a standardized contract/design/test
ex.cn: 标准化合同／设计／考试

senses.def: a tall lamp that stands on the floor
the amount of money and level of comfort that a particular person or group has
the official time of a country or an area
to move to one side

ex.en: She stood aside to let us pass.
ex.cn: 她站到一边让我们过。

senses.def: to not get involved in sth
senses.chn: 不参与；不介入；置身事外

ex.en: Don't stand aside and let others do all the work.
ex.cn: 不要袖手旁观，工作都让别人去做。

senses.def: to stop doing a job so sb else can do it
senses.chn: 退居一旁；让位于他人；靠边

senses.def: to be present while sth bad is happening but not do anything to stop it

ex.en: How can you stand by and see him accused of something he didn't do?
ex.cn: 你怎么能眼睁睁看着他遭人诬陷呢？

senses.def: to be ready for action
senses.chn: 做好随时行动的准备；做好准备

ex.en: The troops are standing by.
ex.cn: 部队随时待命出动。

senses.def: a person or thing that can always be used if needed, for example if sb/sth else is not available or if there is an emergency

ex.en: I always keep a pizza in the freezer as a standby.
ex.cn: 我总会在冰箱里放一个比萨饼以备不时之需。

ex.en: a standby electricity generator
ex.cn: 备用发电机

senses.def: ready to do sth immediately if needed or asked
senses.chn: 随时可以投入行动；处于待命状态；招之即来

ex.en: The emergency services were put on standby after a bomb warning.
ex.cn: 接到炸弹警报后，各应急服务机构进入待命状态。

senses.def: ready to travel or go somewhere if a ticket or sth that is needed suddenly becomes available
senses.chn: 候补座位（如临时有票或具备其他必要条件便可立即出发的）

ex.en: He was put on standby for the flight to New York.
ex.cn: 这班飞往纽约的班机，他候补待位。

senses.def: a standby ticket for a flight, concert, etc. cannot be bought in advance and is only available a very short time before the plane leaves or the performance starts
senses.chn: （机票、音乐会门票等）最后时刻出售的

senses.def: to help sb or be friends with them, even in difficult situations

ex.en: her famous song, 'Stand by your man'
ex.cn: 她的著名歌曲《忠于你的男人》

senses.def: to still believe or agree with sth you said, decided or agreed earlier
senses.chn: 仍然遵守诺言（或协议等）

ex.en: She still stands by every word she said.
ex.cn: 她依旧恪守她说过的每一句话。

senses.def: to leave a job or position

ex.en: He stood down to make way for someone younger.
ex.cn: 他退下来好为年轻人让路。

senses.def: to leave the witness box
a period when people, especially soldiers, relax after a period of duty or danger
senses.chn: 停工休息期；（尤指士兵的）休整期

senses.def: used as a command to soldiers who are already standing at ease to tell them that they can stand in an even more relaxed way
senses.chn: （对士兵的命令用语）原地休息

senses.def: a person who is standing, for example in a bus or at a concert
senses.chn: 站立者；站立乘客；站票观众

senses.def: to be an abbreviation or symbol of sth

ex.en: 'The book's by T.C. Smith.' 'What does the 'T.C.' stand for?'
ex.cn: “这部书是 T.C. 史密斯写的。” “ T.C. 是什么的缩写？”

senses.def: to support sth

ex.en: I hated the organization and all it stood for (= the ideas that it supported).
ex.cn: 我厌恶那个组织，也厌恶它的一切主张。

senses.def: to not let sb do sth or sth happen

ex.en: I'm not standing for it any longer.
ex.cn: 这种事我再也不能容忍了。

senses.def: a person who does sb's job for a short time when they are not available
a person who replaces an actor in some scenes in a film/movie, especially dangerous ones
senses.chn: （尤指影视中做危险动作的）替身演员

senses.def: existing or arranged permanently, not formed or made for a particular situation
senses.chn: 长期存在的；永久性的；常设的

ex.en: a standing army
ex.cn: 常备军

ex.en: a standing charge (= an amount of money that you pay in order to use a service, such as gas or water)
ex.cn: 长期支付的开销

ex.en: a standing committee
ex.cn: 常务委员会

ex.en: It's a standing joke (= something that a group of people regularly laugh at).
ex.cn: 那是一个活笑柄。

ex.en: We have a standing invitation to visit them anytime.
ex.cn: 他们邀请我们随时去他们家做客。

senses.def: done from a position in which you are standing rather than sitting or running

ex.en: a standing jump/start
ex.cn: 立定跳远；站立式起跑

ex.en: The speaker got a standing ovation (= people stood up to clap after the speech).
ex.cn: 演讲者赢得了听众的起立鼓掌。

senses.def: the position or reputation of sb/sth within a group of people or in an organization

ex.en: the high/low standing of politicians with the public
ex.cn: 在公众中声望高／低的政治人物

ex.en: The contract has no legal standing.
ex.cn: 那份合同在法律上没有约束力。

senses.def: the period of time that sth has existed

ex.en: a friendship of many years' standing
ex.cn: 多年的友情

senses.def: a list of people, teams, etc. showing their positions in a sports competition
senses.chn: （运动员或运动队比赛成绩的）排名，名次

senses.def: an instruction that you give to your bank to pay sb a fixed amount of money from your account on the same day each week/month, etc.
senses.chn: （客户给银行的）定期支付指示，经常性支付授权

senses.def: space for people to stand in, especially in a theatre, sports ground, etc.
senses.chn: （尤指剧场、体育场等）站立的空间

ex.en: standing room for 12 000 supporters
ex.cn: 可供 12 000 名支持者站立的地方

ex.en: It was standing room only at the concert (= all the seats were sold).
ex.cn: 音乐会只剩站票了。

senses.def: a tall vertical stone that was shaped and put up by prehistoric people in western Europe
a situation in which no agreement can be reached
a player who plays behind the scrum half
not friendly towards other people
senses.chn: 冷淡的；冷漠的；不友好的

senses.def: to behave formally

ex.en: Please don't stand on ceremony (= Please be natural and relaxed) with me.
ex.cn: 请别跟我讲客套。

senses.def: to demand to be treated with the respect that you think that you deserve
senses.chn: 要求受到应有的礼遇；保持尊严

senses.def: a person or thing that is very noticeable because they are or it is better, more impressive, etc. than others in a group
be near sb and watch them

ex.en: I don't like you standing over me while I'm cooking.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢做饭时你在一旁盯着我。

senses.def: to refuse to change your mind about a decision you have made or an opinion you have
senses.chn: 固执己见；拒不改变决定

senses.def: a pipe that is connected to a public water supply and used to provide water outside a building
senses.chn: 公用水管（用于在户外公共场所供水）

senses.def: an opinion or a way of thinking about ideas or situations

ex.en: a political/theoretical, etc. standpoint
ex.cn: 政治、理论等观点

ex.en: He is writing from the standpoint of someone who knows what life is like in prison.
ex.cn: 他从一个了解监狱生活的人的立场写作。

senses.def: a town in Fife, Scotland. It is named after St Andrew, whose bones are said to have been brought here in the 4th century, and it was an early centre of the Christian Church. Its university, established in 1412, is the oldest in Scotland. The town is also famous for the Royal and Ancient Golf Club, which is recognized as an international authority on the rules of golf.
senses.chn: 圣安德鲁斯（苏格兰法夫区城镇。以圣安德鲁命名，据说他的遗骨在 4 世纪被送到这里，此地是基督教会的早期中心。圣安德鲁斯大学建于 1412 年，是苏格兰最古老的大学。该地亦以皇家古典高尔夫俱乐部闻名，此俱乐部被公认为高尔夫球运动规则的国际权威）

senses.def: 30 November, a Christian festival of the national saint of Scotland
senses.chn: 圣安德烈节（11 月 30 日，纪念苏格兰主保圣人的基督教节日）

senses.def: to be useful or helpful to sb when needed
senses.chn: （需要时）对某人有用，对某人有利

ex.en: Your languages will stand you in good stead when it comes to finding a job.
ex.cn: 你懂得几种语言，找工作时就会显出优势。

senses.def: to deliberately not meet sb you have arranged to meet, especially sb you are having a romantic relationship with
senses.chn: （尤指恋人）故意失约使某人空等，放某人鸽子

ex.en: I've been stood up!
ex.cn: 人家让我空等一场！

senses.def: a situation in which all activity or movement has stopped

ex.en: The security alert brought the airport to a standstill.
ex.cn: 安全警戒使机场陷入停顿状态。

ex.en: Traffic in the northbound lane is at a complete standstill.
ex.cn: 北行车道的交通完全堵塞。

senses.def: to show that you are proud and able to deal with anything
to prove to be good, popular, etc. over a long period of time
the state of being ready to fight or attack
to be on your feet

ex.en: There were no seats left so I had to stand up.
ex.cn: 没有座位了，所以我只好站着。

ex.en: You'll look taller if you stand up straight.
ex.cn: 站直身子，你会显得高些。

senses.def: stand-up comedy consists of one person standing in front of an audience and telling jokes
senses.chn: （喜剧节目）单人表演的，单口的

senses.def: a stand-up argument, fight, etc. is one in which people shout loudly at each other or are violent towards each other
worn, used, etc. in a vertical position

ex.en: a stand-up collar
ex.cn: 立领

senses.def: stand-up comedy

ex.en: When did you start doing stand-up?
ex.cn: 你什么时候开始表演独白喜剧的？

senses.def: a person who performs stand-up comedy
senses.chn: 独白喜剧演员；单口相声演员

ex.en: She started out as a stand-up.
ex.cn: 她出道时是个独角喜剧演员。

senses.def: to say publicly that you support sb or you agree with sth
to resist sb; to not accept bad treatment from sb without complaining
senses.chn: 抵抗；勇敢反对；不甘忍受某人的欺负（或不公平对待）

ex.en: It was brave of her to stand up to those bullies.
ex.cn: 她不向那几个坏蛋屈服，真是勇敢。

senses.def: to remain in good condition despite rough treatment

ex.en: The carpet is designed to stand up to a lot of wear and tear.
ex.cn: 这种地毯设计得十分耐用。

senses.def: a group of lines in a repeated pattern that form a unit in some types of poem
a type of bacteria that can cause infections in some parts of the body such as the skin and eyes
senses.chn: 葡萄球菌（可感染皮肤和眼睛等身体部位）

senses.def: forming a basic, large or important part of sth

ex.en: The staple crop is rice.
ex.cn: 主要农作物为水稻。

ex.en: Jeans are a staple part of everyone's wardrobe.
ex.cn: 在每个人的衣橱里，牛仔裤是必不可少的。

senses.def: a small piece of wire that is used in a device called a stapler and is pushed through pieces of paper and bent over at the ends in order to fasten the pieces of paper together
a small piece of metal in the shape of a U that is hit into wooden surfaces using a hammer, used especially for holding electrical wires in place *
senses.chn: U 形钉；U 形电线卡

senses.def: a basic type of food that is used a lot

ex.en: Aid workers helped distribute corn, milk and other staples.
ex.cn: 救助人员协助分发谷物、牛奶及其他基本食物。

senses.def: something that is produced by a country and is important for its economy

ex.en: Rubber became the staple of the Malayan economy.
ex.cn: 橡胶成了马来亚经济的支柱产品。

senses.def: a large or an important part of sth

ex.en: Royal gossip is a staple of the tabloid press.
ex.cn: 围绕王室成员的飞短流长是小报的主要内容。

senses.def: to attach one thing to another using a staple or staples

ex.en: Staple the invoice to the receipt.
ex.cn: 把发票订到收据上。

ex.en: Staple the invoice and the receipt together.
ex.cn: 把发票和收据订在一起。

senses.def: the food that a person or an animal normally eats

ex.en: a staple diet of meat and potatoes
ex.cn: 以肉和土豆作为主要食物

ex.en: Bamboo is the panda's staple diet.
ex.cn: 大熊猫的基本食物是竹子。

senses.def: something that is used a lot
senses.chn: 家常便饭；主要内容；惯用手段

ex.en: Sex and violence seem to be the staple diet of television drama.
ex.cn: 性和暴力好像是电视剧离不开的内容。

senses.def: a device for fixing paper to walls, etc. using staples
senses.chn: 钉枪，钉钉器（用以把纸钉到墙上等）

senses.def: a small device used for putting staples into paper, etc.
a small device used for removing staples from paper, etc.
a large ball of burning gas in space that we see as a point of light in the sky at night

ex.en: There was a big moon and hundreds of stars were shining overhead.
ex.cn: 头顶是一轮明月和成百上千颗闪烁的星星。

ex.en: Sirius is the brightest star in the sky.
ex.cn: 天狼星是天空中最亮的一颗星。

ex.en: We camped out under the stars.
ex.cn: 我们露天宿营。

senses.def: an object, a decoration, a mark, etc., usually with five or six points, whose shape represents a star

ex.en: a horse with a white star on its forehead
ex.cn: 前额有一块星形白斑的马

ex.en: a sheriff's star
ex.cn: 县治安官的星徽

ex.en: I've put a star by the names of the girls in the class.
ex.cn: 我在班里女生名字旁都画了一个星号。

ex.en: a four-star general
ex.cn: 四星上将

senses.def: a mark that represents a star and tells you how good sth is, especially a hotel or restaurant

ex.en: three-/four-/five-star hotels
ex.cn: 三星级／四星级／五星级饭店

ex.en: What star rating does this restaurant have?
ex.cn: 这家餐馆是几星级的？

senses.def: a famous and excellent singer, performer, sports player, etc.
senses.chn: 歌唱（或表演）明星；体坛高手；才华出众者

ex.en: pop/rock/Hollywood, etc. stars
ex.cn: 流行音乐歌星、摇滚歌星、好莱坞影星等

ex.en: a football/tennis, etc. star
ex.cn: 足球、网球等明星

ex.en: He's so good—I'm sure he'll be a big star.
ex.cn: 他太棒了，我相信他会成为大明星的。

ex.en: She acts well but she hasn't got star quality.
ex.cn: 她演得不错，但缺少成为一个明星的素质。

ex.en: The best models receive star treatment.
ex.cn: 最优秀的模特儿会受到明星级的待遇。

senses.def: a person who has the main part, or one of the main parts, in a film/movie, play, etc.

ex.en: She was the star of many popular television series.
ex.cn: 她在许多观众喜爱的电视连续剧中担任过主角。

ex.en: The star of the show was a young Italian singer.
ex.cn: 那台节目的主角是位年轻的意大利歌唱家。

ex.en: the star role/part
ex.cn: 主角

senses.def: a person or thing that is the best of a group

ex.en: a star student
ex.cn: 最优秀的学生

ex.en: Paula is the star of the class.
ex.cn: 葆拉是班里的尖子。

ex.en: He was the star performer at the championships.
ex.cn: 他是那届锦标赛上的最佳运动员。

ex.en: The star prize is a weekend for two in Paris.
ex.cn: 特等奖是二人巴黎周末游。

ex.en: The monkey was the star attraction (= the best or most popular act) at the show.
ex.cn: 那只猴子是节目中最令人瞩目的明星。

senses.def: used to show that you feel very grateful for sth that sb has done or that you think they are wonderful

ex.en: Thanks! You're a star!
ex.cn: 多谢多谢！你真是个大好人！

senses.def: a description of what sb thinks is going to happen to sb in the future, based on the position of the stars and planets when they were born
senses.chn: 星象（根据人出生时天体的位置而描述的命运）

ex.en: Do you read your stars in the paper?
ex.cn: 你读不读报上的星座运程，看自己的运气如何？

senses.def: to see flashes of light in front of your eyes, usually because you have been hit on the head
senses.chn: （因头部被撞击等）两眼直冒金星

senses.def: if sb has stars in their eyes, they have dreams of becoming famous, especially as an entertainer
senses.chn: 成名的梦想；（尤指成为艺人的）明星梦

senses.def: to try to be successful at sth that is difficult
senses.chn: 有九天揽月之志；努力完成壮举

senses.def: to feel very grateful and lucky about sth
to have one of the main parts in a film/movie, play, etc.

ex.en: She starred opposite Cary Grant in 'Bringing up Baby'.
ex.cn: 她和加利 · 格兰特在《育婴奇谭》中联袂出演男女主角。

ex.en: No one has yet been chosen for the starring role (= the main part).
ex.cn: 主演还没选定。

senses.def: if a film/movie, play, etc. stars sb, that person has one of the main parts

ex.en: a movie starring Meryl Streep and Pierce Brosnan
ex.cn: 由梅丽尔 · 斯特里普和皮尔斯 · 布鲁斯南主演的电影

ex.en: The studio wants to star her in a sequel to last year's hit.
ex.cn: 制片厂为去年一部大获成功的影片筹拍续集，想聘她担任主角。

senses.def: to put a symbol shaped like a star (= an asterisk ) next to a word, etc. in order to make people notice it

ex.en: Treat all the sections that have been starred as priority.
ex.cn: 优先处理所有标星号的部分。

senses.def: a small fruit in the shape of a star, used in cooking as a spice
the side of a ship or an aircraft that is on the right when you are facing forward
a bright light in the shape of a star, or a shape that looks like a star exploding
senses.chn: 星状亮光；星爆般的形状

senses.def: a white carbohydrate food substance found in potatoes, flour, rice, etc.; food containing this

ex.en: There's too much starch in your diet.
ex.cn: 你的日常饮食中淀粉含量太高。

ex.en: You need to cut down on starches.
ex.cn: 你得少吃些含淀粉的东西。

senses.def: starch prepared in powder form or as a spray and used for making clothes, sheets, etc. stiff
to make clothes, sheets, etc. stiff using starch

ex.en: a starched white shirt
ex.cn: 浆过的白衬衫

senses.def: containing a lot of starch
very formal; not friendly or relaxed
not able to be happy because of bad luck or fate

ex.en: Shakespeare's star-crossed lovers, Romeo and Juliet
ex.cn: 罗密欧和朱丽叶这一对莎士比亚笔下命途多舛的恋人

senses.def: the state of being famous as an actor, a singer, etc.

ex.en: The group is being tipped for stardom (= people say they will be famous).
ex.cn: 这支乐队被誉为明日之星。

ex.en: She shot to stardom in a Broadway musical.
ex.cn: 她在一部百老汇音乐剧中一炮而红。

senses.def: a magic quality that some famous people with a great natural ability seem to have
senses.chn: （天赋很高的名人似乎拥有的）魔力

senses.def: stars that are very far from the earth and appear like bright dust in the sky at night
senses.chn: 星尘（远离地球的恒星，在夜空中看似明亮尘埃）

senses.def: to look at sb/sth for a long time

ex.en: I screamed and everyone stared.
ex.cn: 我尖叫一声，众人都盯着我看。

ex.en: I stared blankly at the paper in front of me.
ex.cn: 我茫然地看着面前那张纸。

ex.en: He sat staring into space (= looking at nothing).
ex.cn: 他坐在那儿凝视着前方。

ex.en: She looked at them with dark staring eyes.
ex.cn: 她那双深色的眼睛专注地看着他们。

ex.en: I screamed and everyone stared.
ex.cn: 我尖叫一声，众人都盯着我看。

ex.en: We all gazed at Marco in amazement.
ex.cn: 我们都惊异地注视着马可。

senses.def: to be obvious or easy to see

ex.en: The answer was staring us in the face.
ex.cn: 答案明摆在我们面前。

senses.def: to be certain to happen

ex.en: Defeat was staring them in the face.
ex.cn: 他们必遭失败。

senses.def: to be unable to avoid sth

ex.en: They were staring defeat in the face.
ex.cn: 对他们来说，失败不可避免。

senses.def: to look into sb's eyes for a long time until they feel embarrassed and are forced to look away
senses.chn: 盯得某人转移目光（或慌了神）

senses.def: an act of looking at sb/sth for a long time, especially in a way that is unfriendly or that shows surprise
senses.chn: （尤指不友好或吃惊的）盯，凝视，注视

ex.en: She gave him a blank stare.
ex.cn: 她面无表情地直视着他。

ex.en: Here, have a look at this.
ex.cn: 来，看一看这个。

ex.en: She stole a glance at her watch.
ex.cn: 她偷偷看了看表。

ex.en: She felt embarrassed under his steady gaze.
ex.cn: 她在他凝视的目光下感到很尴尬。

ex.en: She gave the officer a blank stare and shrugged her shoulders.
ex.cn: 她面无表情地盯着那个军官，耸了耸肩。

ex.en: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
ex.cn: 他在人群里一眼瞥见了她。

senses.def: to look into sb's eyes for a long time until they feel embarrassed and are forced to look away
senses.chn: 盯得某人转移目光（或慌了神）

senses.def: a flat sea creature in the shape of a star with five arms
a green or yellow tropical fruit with a shape like a star
a person who studies astrology or astronomy
looking severe and without any colour or decoration
senses.chn: 毫无修饰的；荒凉的；粗陋的

ex.en: I think white would be too stark for the bedroom.
ex.cn: 我觉得卧室里用白色未免太素了。

ex.en: The hills stood stark against the winter sky.
ex.cn: 在冬日的天空下，小山了无生气。

senses.def: unpleasant; real, and impossible to avoid
senses.chn: 严酷的；赤裸裸的；真实而无法回避的

ex.en: The author paints a stark picture of life in a prison camp.
ex.cn: 作者描绘出一幅冷酷而真实的战俘营生活画面。

ex.en: a stark choice
ex.cn: 残酷的抉择

ex.en: The remains of the building stand as a stark reminder of the fire.
ex.cn: 房子的断壁残垣是那场大火无情的见证。

ex.en: He now faces the stark reality of life in prison.
ex.cn: 他现在要面对狱中生活的严酷现实了。

ex.en: The plain fact is that nobody really knows.
ex.cn: 事实很明显，没有人真正了解。

ex.en: The simple truth is that we just can't afford it.
ex.cn: 事实很简单，我们就是付不起。

senses.def: very different to sth in a way that is easy to see

ex.en: stark differences
ex.cn: 鲜明的区别

ex.en: Social divisions in the city are stark.

ex.cn: 要想练好一种乐器，你必须持之以恒。

senses.def: an informal game similar to baseball, played with a stick and a rubber ball
senses.chn: 棍球（用棍击橡胶球，类似于棒球的非正式运动）

to do what you promised or planned to do

ex.cn: 他们决心已下，矢志不渝。

senses.def: a sticky label with a picture or message on it, that you stick onto sth

ex.en: bumper stickers (= on cars)
ex.cn: 汽车保险杠粘贴标签

ex.en: a sticker album (= to collect stickers in)
ex.cn: 粘贴标签收集册

ex.en: The washing instructions are on the label.
ex.cn: 洗涤说明在标签上。

ex.en: address labels
ex.cn: 地址签条

ex.en: He'll only wear clothes with a designer label.
ex.cn: 他只穿名牌服装。

ex.en: Everyone at the conference had to wear a name tag.
ex.cn: 所有与会者必须佩戴名牌。

senses.def: the price that is marked on sth, especially a car

senses.chn: 价格震惊（发现价格比想象的要高得多）

senses.def: a picture of a person drawn only with thin lines for the arms and legs, a circle for the head, etc.
senses.chn: 人物线条画；简笔人物画

senses.def: something that people do not agree on and that prevents progress in a discussion

ex.en: This was one of the major sticking points in the negotiations.
ex.cn: 这是谈判中主要的难点之一。

senses.def: a large insect with a long thin body that looks like a stick
a person who refuses to try anything new or exciting
senses.chn: 守旧的人；墨守成规的人

senses.def: to be remembered for a long time

ex.en: One of his paintings in particular sticks in my mind.
ex.cn: 他有一幅画我记得特别清楚。

senses.def: a small freshwater fish with sharp points on its back
a person who thinks that a particular quality or type of behaviour is very important and expects other people to think and behave in the same way
senses.chn: 非常看重（某品质或行为）的人

ex.en: a stickler for punctuality
ex.cn: 非常注重守时的人

senses.def: with glue on one side so that it sticks to sth

ex.en: stick-on labels
ex.cn: 背胶标签

senses.def: to be noticeable or easily seen

ex.en: They wrote the notice in big red letters so that it would stick out.
ex.cn: 他们用红色大字写出通知，这样会显眼一些。

senses.def: to refuse to give up until you get what you need or want
senses.chn: 坚持要求；不得到…不罢休

ex.en: They are sticking out for a higher pay rise.
ex.cn: 他们坚持要求更大幅度地提高工资。

senses.def: a decorative pin that is worn on a tie to keep it in place, or as a piece of jewellery
a handle used to change the gears of a vehicle
a vehicle that has a stick shift
to stay together and support each other
to continue doing sth despite difficulties

ex.en: She finds it impossible to stick to a diet.
ex.cn: 饮食老受限制，她觉得受不了。

senses.def: to continue doing or using sth and not want to change it
senses.chn: 坚持；维持；固守；坚持保留

ex.en: He promised to help us and he stuck to his word (= he did as he had promised).
ex.cn: 他答应过帮助我们，他没有失信。

ex.en: 'Shall we meet on Friday this week?' 'No, let's stick to Saturday.'
ex.cn: “这个星期我们星期五见面怎么样？” “不，还是照旧在星期六吧。”

ex.en: She stuck to her story.
ex.cn: 她坚持自己所说的。

senses.def: to refuse to change your mind about sth even when other people are trying to persuade you that you are wrong
senses.chn: 不听别人劝告；坚持己见；一意孤行

senses.def: to point upwards or be above a surface

ex.en: The branch was sticking up out of the water.
ex.cn: 树枝从水下伸了出来。

senses.def: made of or covered in a substance that sticks to things that touch it

ex.en: sticky fingers covered in jam
ex.cn: 粘满果酱的黏糊糊的手指

ex.en: Stir in the milk to make a soft but not sticky dough.
ex.cn: 把牛奶搅进去，和成软而不黏的面团。

senses.def: with glue on one side so that you can stick it to a surface
hot and damp
feeling hot and uncomfortable
difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: 难办的；棘手的；让人为难的

ex.en: a sticky situation
ex.cn: 棘手的局面

senses.def: so interesting and well organized that the people who visit it stay there for a long time
senses.chn: 用户黏着度高的；富有吸引力的

senses.chn: 好偷东西的；有顺手牵羊的毛病

senses.def: a difficult situation
something unpleasant that happens to sb, for example punishment or a violent death, usually because of their own actions
senses.chn: 不愉快的结局；可悲的下场

ex.en: He'll come to a sticky end one of these days if he carries on like that.
ex.cn: 如果他继续那样下去，总有一天会落得个可悲的下场。

senses.def: a small piece of sticky paper that you use for writing a note on, and that can be easily removed
a person who tries to find out information about other people's private lives in a way that is annoying or rude
senses.chn: 爱打听的人；好探听隐私的人；包打听

senses.def: to do or say sth when there is a risk that you may be wrong
senses.chn: 做不保险的事；说不保险的话；冒险

senses.def: firm and difficult to bend or move
senses.chn: 不易弯曲（或活动）的；硬的；挺的

ex.en: stiff cardboard
ex.cn: 硬纸板

ex.en: a stiff brush
ex.cn: 硬刷子

ex.en: The windows were stiff and she couldn't get them open.
ex.cn: 窗户紧，她开不了。

senses.def: when a person is stiff, their muscles hurt when they move them

ex.en: I'm really stiff after that bike ride yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天骑了那趟自行车，我觉得浑身酸痛。

ex.en: I've got a stiff neck.
ex.cn: 我脖子发僵。

senses.def: thick and almost solid; difficult to stir

ex.en: Whisk the egg whites until stiff.
ex.cn: 把蛋清打成稠的。

senses.def: more difficult or severe than usual
senses.chn: 困难的；艰难的；严厉的；激烈的

ex.en: It was a stiff climb to the top of the hill.
ex.cn: 费了好大劲才爬到山顶。

ex.en: The company faces stiff competition from its rivals.
ex.cn: 公司遇到对手的激烈竞争。

ex.en: The new proposals have met with stiff opposition.
ex.cn: 新提案遭到强烈的反对。

ex.en: There are stiff fines for breaking the rules.
ex.cn: 违反规则要受重罚。

ex.en: a stiff breeze/wind (= one that blows strongly)
ex.cn: 强风

senses.def: not friendly or relaxed

ex.en: The speech he made to welcome them was stiff and formal.
ex.cn: 他那番欢迎他们的话讲得生硬刻板。

senses.def: costing a lot or too much

ex.en: There's a stiff $30 entrance fee to the exhibition.
ex.cn: 展览会的入场费高达 30 美元。

senses.def: strong; containing a lot of alcohol

ex.en: a stiff whisky
ex.cn: 烈性威士忌

senses.def: to keep calm and hide your feelings when you are in pain or in a difficult situation
senses.chn: （面对痛苦或困境）不动声色，沉着而不外露

ex.cn: 非常厌烦／害怕／担心

senses.def: very cold and hard because the water has become ice

ex.en: The clothes on the washing line were frozen stiff.
ex.cn: 挂在晾衣绳上的衣服冻硬了。

ex.en: I came home from the game frozen stiff (= very cold).
ex.cn: 我看完比赛回到家里，都快冻僵了。

senses.def: the body of a dead person
to cheat sb or not pay them what you owe them, especially by not leaving any money as a tip
senses.chn: 诈骗；不还钱；（尤指）不给小费

senses.def: to make yourself or part of your body firm, straight and still, especially because you are angry or frightened
senses.chn: （尤指因气愤或害怕，使浑身或身体的一部分）变僵硬，变僵直，绷紧

ex.en: She stiffened with fear.
ex.cn: 她吓呆了。

ex.en: I stiffened my back and faced him.
ex.cn: 我挺直了腰杆面对着他。

senses.def: to become, or to make sth become, difficult to bend or move

ex.en: My muscles had stiffened up after the climb.
ex.cn: 爬上去以后我肌肉都发僵了。

ex.en: stiffened muscles
ex.cn: 发僵的肌肉

senses.def: to make an attitude or idea stronger or more powerful; to become stronger

ex.en: The threat of punishment has only stiffened their resolve (= made them even more determined to do sth).
ex.cn: 惩罚的威胁益发坚定了他们的决心。

senses.def: to make sth, such as cloth, firm and unable to bend

example.en: She stiffened with fear.
example.cn: 她吓呆了。

example.en: I stiffened my back and faced him.
example.cn: 我挺直了腰杆面对着他。

example.en: My muscles had stiffened up after the climb.
example.cn: 爬上去以后我肌肉都发僵了。

example.en: stiffened muscles
example.cn: 发僵的肌肉

senses.def: proud and refusing to change
an erection (1) of a man's penis
to prevent sth from happening; to prevent a feeling from being expressed

ex.en: She managed to stifle a yawn.
ex.cn: 她忍住了哈欠。

ex.en: They hope the new rules will not stifle creativity.
ex.cn: 他们希望新规则不会压制创新。

ex.en: The government failed to stifle the unrest.
ex.cn: 政府没有制止住动乱。

senses.def: to feel unable to breathe, or to make sb unable to breathe, because it is too hot and/or there is no fresh air
senses.chn: （使）窒息，无法自如地呼吸，感觉窒闷

ex.en: I felt I was stifling in the airless room.
ex.cn: 在那间闷气的房间里我感觉都快憋死了。

ex.en: Most of the victims were stifled by the fumes.
ex.cn: 多数受害者是因烟雾窒息而死的。

example.en: Most of the victims were stifled by the fumes.
example.cn: 多数受害者是因烟雾窒息而死的。

senses.def: feelings of disapproval that people have about particular illnesses or ways of behaving

ex.en: the social stigma of alcoholism
ex.cn: 酗酒在社会上的恶名

ex.en: There is no longer any stigma attached to being divorced.
ex.cn: 离婚不再是什么丢脸的事。

senses.def: the part in the middle of a flower where pollen is received

senses.chn: 圣伤，圣痕（据信出现在某些圣徒身上，与耶稣身上钉子留下的伤痕相似）

a set of steps that help people climb over a fence or gate in a field, etc.
senses.chn: （供人翻越田地等处所设的围栏、栅栏门等的）台阶，梯磴

senses.def: a woman's shoe with a very high narrow heel; the heel on such a shoe
senses.chn: 细高跟女鞋；（女鞋的）细高跟

ex.en: I wrote to them last month and I'm still waiting for a reply.
ex.cn: 我上个月给他们写了信，到现在还在等回音。

ex.en: Mum, I'm still hungry!
ex.cn: 妈，我还饿！

ex.en: Do you still live at the same address?
ex.cn: 你还住在原地址吗？

ex.en: There's still time to change your mind.
ex.cn: 你还有时间改变主意。

ex.en: It was, and still is, my favourite movie.
ex.cn: 那部影片以前是我最喜欢的，现在仍然是。

senses.def: despite what has just been said

ex.en: We searched everywhere but we still couldn't find it.
ex.cn: 我们四处找，但还是没找到。

ex.en: The weather was cold and wet. Still, we had a great time.
ex.cn: 天气又冷又潮，不过我们仍旧玩得很开心。

senses.def: used for making a comparison stronger

ex.en: The next day was warmer still.
ex.cn: 第二天更暖和了。

ex.en: If you can manage to get two tickets that's better still.
ex.cn: 要是你能设法弄到两张票，那就更好了。

senses.def: even more

ex.en: There was still more bad news to come.
ex.cn: 随后还传来了其他的坏消息。

senses.def: and certainly not

ex.cn: 连个解释都不给，就更不用说道歉了。

senses.chn: 静止的；平静的；安静的；寂静的

ex.en: still water
ex.cn: 平静的水面

ex.cn: 我给你梳头时你不要动。

ex.en: The kids found it hard to stay still.
ex.cn: 孩子们觉得待着不动很难做到。

ex.en: Can't you sit still?
ex.cn: 你就不能老老实实坐一会儿吗？

ex.en: We stayed in a village where time has stood still (= life has not changed for many years).
ex.cn: 我们待在一个时间似乎凝滞了的村子里。

ex.en: a still summer's day
ex.cn: 无风的夏日

ex.en: the still night air
ex.cn: 夜间宁静的空气

senses.def: not containing bubbles of gas; not fizzy
senses.chn: 不含碳酸气的；不起泡的

ex.en: still mineral water
ex.cn: 无汽矿泉水

senses.def: the time during the night when it is quiet and calm
senses.chn: 万籁俱寂的夜晚；夜阑人静

senses.chn: 上帝的教示；良心的呼唤

senses.chn: 静水流深；木讷寡言者也许胸藏丘壑

senses.chn: （电影或录像的）定格画面；剧照

ex.cn: 他的新电影的宣传剧照

ex.cn: 威士忌蒸馏器

senses.def: to become calm and quiet; to make sth calm and quiet

ex.en: The wind stilled.
ex.cn: 风停了。

ex.cn: 她轻声安慰受到惊吓的孩子。

ex.en: to still sb's doubts/fears
ex.cn: 消除某人的疑虑／恐惧

example.en: She spoke quietly to still the frightened child.
example.cn: 她轻声安慰受到惊吓的孩子。

senses.def: a birth in which the baby is born dead
born dead

ex.en: a stillborn baby
ex.cn: 死产儿

senses.def: not successful; not developing
the art of painting or drawing arrangements of objects such as flowers, fruit, etc.; a painting, etc. like this
the quality of being quiet and not moving

ex.en: The sound of footsteps on the path broke the stillness.
ex.cn: 小路上的脚步声打破了宁静。

senses.def: a person who seems to be quiet or shy may surprise you by knowing a lot or having deep feelings
senses.chn: 静水流深；木讷寡言者也许胸藏丘壑

senses.def: one of a set of posts that support a building so that it is high above the ground or water
senses.chn: （支撑建筑物高出地面或水面的）桩子，支柱

senses.def: one of two long pieces of wood that have a step on the side that you can stand on, so that you can walk above the ground

ex.en: a circus performer on stilts
ex.cn: 马戏团里踩高跷的演员

senses.def: not natural or relaxed; too formal

ex.en: We made stilted conversation for a few moments.
ex.cn: 我们不自然地客套了一会儿。

senses.def: a drug or substance that makes you feel more awake and gives you more energy

ex.en: Coffee and tea are mild stimulants.
ex.cn: 咖啡和茶是轻度兴奋剂。

senses.def: an event or activity that encourages more activity
to make sth develop or become more active; to encourage sth

ex.en: The exhibition has stimulated interest in her work.
ex.cn: 展览增进了人们对她作品的兴趣。

ex.en: The article can be used to stimulate discussion among students.
ex.cn: 这篇文章可用来活跃学生的讨论。

senses.def: to make sb interested and excited about sth

ex.en: Parents should give children books that stimulate them.
ex.cn: 父母应给孩子能启发他们的书。

ex.en: Both men and women are stimulated by erotic photos (= sexually).
ex.cn: 色情照片对男女都有刺激作用。

ex.en: The conference stimulated him to study the subject in more depth.
ex.cn: 这次会议促使他更深入地研究那个课题。

senses.def: to make a part of the body function
senses.chn: 促进（身体某部分）的功能

ex.cn: 那些妇女得到了促进卵巢功能的生育药。

example.en: Parents should give children books that stimulate them.
example.cn: 父母应给孩子能启发他们的书。

example.en: The conference stimulated him to study the subject in more depth.
example.cn: 这次会议促使他更深入地研究那个课题。

senses.def: full of interesting or exciting ideas; making people feel enthusiastic
senses.chn: 趣味盎然的；激励人的；振奋人心的

ex.en: a stimulating discussion
ex.cn: 饶有趣味的讨论

ex.en: a stimulating teacher
ex.cn: 能够引发兴趣的老师

ex.en: That's an interesting question, Daniel.
ex.cn: 那是个有趣的问题，丹尼尔。

ex.en: The exhibition tells the fascinating story of the steam age.
ex.cn: 展览讲述了蒸汽时代引人入胜的故事。

ex.en: Her latest book makes compelling reading.
ex.cn: 她新出的书读起来扣人心弦。

ex.en: Thank you for a most stimulating discussion.
ex.cn: 感谢你们妙趣横生的讨论。

senses.def: making you feel more active and healthy
senses.chn: 增加活力的；增进健康的

ex.en: shower gel containing plant extracts that have a stimulating effect on the skin
ex.cn: 含有对皮肤有益的植物精华的沐浴凝胶

senses.chn: 促进因素；激励因素；刺激物

ex.en: Books provide children with ideas and a stimulus for play.
ex.cn: 书不仅给孩子们提供想法，而且使他们玩得更有意思。

ex.en: The new tax laws should act as a stimulus to exports.
ex.cn: 新税法应该能促进出口。

senses.def: something that produces a reaction in a human, an animal or a plant
senses.chn: （使生物产生反应的）刺激，刺激物

ex.en: sensory/verbal/visual stimuli
ex.cn: 感官／言语／视觉刺激

ex.en: The animals were conditioned to respond to auditory stimuli (= sounds).
ex.cn: 经过训练，那些动物对声音形成了条件反射。

ex.en: I was stung on the arm by a wasp.
ex.cn: 我的胳膊给黄蜂蜇了一下。

ex.en: Be careful of the nettles—they sting!
ex.cn: 小心给荨麻扎着，荨麻有刺！

senses.def: to feel, or to make sb feel, a sharp pain in a part of their body

ex.en: I put some antiseptic on the cut and it stung for a moment.
ex.cn: 我在割破的地方抹了点抗菌剂，一时间十分刺痛。

ex.en: My eyes were stinging from the smoke.
ex.cn: 烟熏得我眼睛疼。

ex.en: Tears stung her eyes.
ex.cn: 她流泪流得眼睛疼。

ex.en: My feet hurt.
ex.cn: 我脚疼。

ex.en: Ouch! That hurt!
ex.cn: 哎哟！好疼！

ex.en: I'm aching all over.
ex.cn: 我周身疼痛。

senses.def: to make sb feel angry or upset

ex.en: He was stung by their criticism.
ex.cn: 他们的批评使他心烦意乱。

ex.en: They launched a stinging attack on the government.
ex.cn: 他们对政府进行了猛烈的抨击。

ex.en: Their cruel remarks stung her into action.
ex.cn: 他们伤人的话激怒了她，使她采取了行动。

ex.en: He was stung into answering in his defence.
ex.cn: 他被激怒了，不得不作出回应为自己辩护。

ex.cn: 我挨宰了，一顿饭吃了 100 英镑。

senses.def: to borrow money from sb

senses.chn: （昆虫的）螫针，刺；（植物的）刺，刺毛

ex.en: the sting of a bee
ex.cn: 蜜蜂的螫针

ex.en: The scorpion has a sting in its tail.
ex.cn: 蝎子尾巴上有螫针。

senses.def: a wound that is made when an insect, a creature or a plant stings you

ex.en: A wasp or bee sting is painful but not necessarily serious.
ex.cn: 被黄蜂或蜜蜂蜇一下疼是疼，但未必碍事。

senses.def: any sharp pain in your body or mind

ex.en: the sting of salt in a wound
ex.cn: 伤口上撒盐引起的剧痛

ex.en: He smiled at her, trying to take the sting out of his words (= trying to make the situation less painful or difficult).
ex.cn: 他冲她微微一笑，想使他的话不至于刺痛她。
